If the intermediate node is placed at a kth hop, the intermediate node determines a packet priority for a various hope as well as a packet priority based on a packet urgent level in a current(360). If the priorities of both a newly received packet and cue-standby packets are determined, the intermediate node transmits the packet according to the higher priority(380).
abstract_ko:
이동 애드혹 네트워크에서 지연에 민감한 데이터의 서비스 품질을 보장할 수 있고, 트래픽 부하를 전체 네트워크로 분산시킬 수 있는 이동 애드혹 네트워크에서 데이터 전송 방법 및 이동 애드혹 네트워크에서 데이터 전송 방법이 기록된 기록매체가 개시된다. 경로 긴급도에 기초하여 패킷의 전송 경로를 설정하고, 설정된 전송 경로를 통해 소스 노드가 패킷을 전송한다. 설정된 전송 경로 상에 존재하는 소정의 중간 노드가 패킷을 수신하고, 설정된 전송 경로의 전체 홉 수 정보 및 허용 가능한 최대 지연 정보에 기초하여 수신된 패킷의 패킷 우선순위를 결정한 후 결정된 패킷 우선순위에 기초하여 패킷을 전송한다. 따라서, 이동 애드혹 네트워크에서 종단간 전송 지연 시간을 최대한 만족시킬 수 있고, 이로 인해 지연에 민감한 데이터의 서비스 품질을 보장할 수 있다. 또한, 트래픽 부하를 전체 네트워크로 분산시킬 수 있다. 
       
     	애드혹, 지연, 스케줄링, 드랍, 라우팅, 홉

title_en: Method for routing in ad-hoc network
title_ko: 애드 혹 네트워크에서의 라우팅 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A routing method in an ad hoc network is provided not to select the routing path such as general case, thereby transmitting important data rapidly and safely. CONSTITUTION: An ad hoc network searches a routing route between a second nodes and a target node(201). If the emergency case occurred, the ad hoc network searches a routing path between a first nodes and the target node(203,205). The ad hoc network again searches a routing route between the second nodes and the target node. The ad hoc network searches the optimal routing route(207).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 애드 혹 네트워크(Ad-hoc Network)에 관한 것으로, 특히 애드 혹 네트워크에서 데이터를 실시간으로 통신할 수 있도록 하는 라우팅 방법에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은 애드 혹 네트워크에서 데이터 통신을 위한 라우팅 경로를 탐색하는 라우팅 방법에 있어서, 제1 노드들과 목적노드 간의 라우팅 경로를 탐색하고, 상기 제1 노드들보다 우선순위가 높은 제2 노드들과 상기 목적노드 간의 라우팅 경로를 탐색하고, 상기 제2 노드들과 상기 목적노드 간의 라우팅 경로를 우선하여 상기 제1 노드들과 상기 목적 노드 간의 라우팅 경로를 재 탐색함으로써 데이터를 실시간으로 송수신할 수 있다. 
       
     애드 혹 네트워크, 라우팅 경로, 우선순위, 채널 용량

title_en: Energy-saving AODV routing method used in Ad Hoc network environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving AODV routing method used in an Ad Hoc network environment, provides a novel energy-saving routing method by starting from the energy-saving requirement of a user and utilizing an on-demand routing protocol and topological structure analysis method. Factors such as low energy consumption of nodes, link capacity and the like are comprehensively considered. On the basis, the invention provides a network routing method based on dynamic priority factors and a single back-up route; and secondary judgment is set and factors that energy of the nodes of the user influences routing are comprehensively considered. A simulation result verifies that the method not only can save network energy, but also can postpone routing update so as to delay network fragmentation.

title_en: Communication apparatus and communication method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve robustness against variation in network state.  <P>SOLUTION: An acquisition part 110 acquires a radio cost for each path down to other communication apparatus in an ad hoc network to which a communication apparatus 100 belongs. An accumulation part 120 accumulates radio cost for each of a plurality of paths acquired at different times by the acquisition part 110. A deciding part 130 decides priority of each path, based on time correlation among paths for the radio cost of each of the plurality of paths accumulated by the accumulation part 120. A communication part 140 communicates with other communication apparatus 100 preferentially using a path having a higher priority decided by the deciding part 130.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: A road accident alarm system
title_ko: 도로 사고 발생 경보 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A road accident alarming system is provided to expand a monitoring range according to the distances between systems and the number of the systems. CONSTITUTION: A signal transmitting and receiving system(10) generates and receives periodical electric signals. A connecting line(11) transmits and receives the electric signals of the signal transmitting and receiving system and is disconnected in case of the occurrence of accidents. A connecting line attaching unit(12) attaches a connecting line to the guardrail of a road, the median strip of the road, and the collapsible ground. If the connecting line is disconnected, a road accident alarming system(21) is operated.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도로의 사고발생 경보시스템에 관한 것으로 도로상의 교통사고, 지반침하 등 도로의 사고 발생을 알지 못하고 현장에 접근하는 이에게 사고 발생을 경고하여 서행 또는 정지를 유도함과 동시에 사고발생을 원거리에 있는 관리자에게 알려줌으로써 즉각적 조치가 이루어지도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
     도로 사고발생 경보시스템의 구성은 주기적인 전기신호의 발생과 발생된 신호의 입출력을 담당하는 신호송수신시스템(10)과, 두 신호송수신시스템 간에 전기신호를 전달해주며 차량충돌, 낙교, 지반침하 등의 사고발생시 단선이 발생하는 연결선(11), 감시가 필요한 물체에 연결선(11)을 고정하는 연결선 부착창치(12), 신호송수신의 단절이 일어났을 경우 이를 인식하고 사고발생알림장치(21)을 작동시키는 위험감지시스템(20)과, 사고발생신호가 감지되었을 경우 LED 표지판의 발광, 경고음, 유무선신호송출 등으로 사고발생을 알리는 사고발생알림장치(21), 전체 장치에 전기를 공급하는 태양광집열판(30)으로 구성된다. 본 시스템을 설치할 경우 수 개의 장치만으로 긴 도로 및 다수의 위험 지역에 대한 감시가 가능하다. 
       
     신호송수신시스템(10), 연결선(11), 연결선부착장치(12), 위험감지시스템(20), 사고발생알림장치(21), 태양광집열판(30), 도로의 난간 및 중앙분리대(40), 지반붕괴구간(50)

title_en: Method for dispatching vehicular Ad Hoc network service with broadcast priority
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dispatching vehicular Ad Hoc network service with broadcast priority, and is suitable for communication of vehicles and roadside units in a vehicular Ad Hoc network. The method consists of a stage of requesting to jump the queue of a roadside unit service and a stage of serving the request, wherein the stage of requesting to jump the queue of the roadside unit service is the key point of the service dispatching method, which realizes effective arrangement to the requests on the service queue of the roadside unit; and the stage of serving the request by the roadside unit is to complete the subsequent work of the first stage, namely the roadside unit serves or abandons the request sent by the vehicle. The dispatching method improves the state of channel bandwidth waste due to the fact that the conventional simple priority policy does not consider the difference of communication modes, and cannot provide uniform service for the same request sent by a plurality of vehicles, and ensures that the channel utilization is increased and the load of the roadside unit is reduced by providing uniform broadcast service for the same request sent by the plurality of vehicles.

title_en: Apparatus and method for processing data in ad-hoc network
title_ko: 애드 혹 네트워크에서의 데이터 처리 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus and a method for processing data in ad-hoc network are provided to selectively process urgent voice data, and general data using a silence mode of a node. CONSTITUTION: A decision unit(110) decides what data to create between a first data, and a second data which has lower priority than the first data. According to the decision, if a specific data is generated, a measuring unit(120) measures a mode value related to the drive of the first node which currently has the specific data. A processing unit(130) processes the created data considering the created data content and the measured mode value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 애드 혹 네트워크 특히 MANET에서의 데이터 처리 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 (a) 제1 데이터 및 제1 데이터보다 우선순위가 낮은 제2 데이터 중 어느 하나의 데이터를 생성할 것인지 결정하는 단계; (b) 상기 결정에 따라 특정 데이터가 생성되면, 생성된 특정 데이터를 현재 보유한 제1 노드의 구동과 관련한 모드값을 측정하는 단계; 및 (c) 제1 노드가 생성된 데이터의 내용과 측정된 모드값을 고려하여 생성된 데이터를 처리하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 애드 혹 네트워크에서의 데이터 처리 방법을 제공한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 네트워크를 통한 우선순위가 높은 노드의 긴급한 음성 데이터 전달시 트래픽 경로에 대한 간섭을 제거할 수 있으며, 데이터의 전달 지연이나 전달 손실을 제거할 수 있다.
assignees: CHEON BYOUNG YOON;KIM YONG I;LIG NEX1 CO LTD;LIG NEXL CO LTD

title_en: Method for resource allocation in a mobile meshed communication network with limitation of inter-cluster interference, system and network implementing the method
abstract_en: The method involves generating a chart of configurations having different allocation priority indices for time slots of time windows of communication resources, where the indices vary from 0 to n-1, and n is strictly positive integer equal to the number of slots. The configurations are assigned to clusters (C1-C7) such that positive preset number of indices is not assigned to the same slots for adjacent clusters. The slots are allocated to intra cluster communications in the order of priorities defined in the configurations assigned to the clusters. The time windows are time division multiple access (TDMA) windows. Independent claims are also included for the following: (1) an onboard communication system embedded in a mobile node communicating within a mobile ad hoc network (2) an ad hoc network comprising a set of mobile nodes communicating with one another.

title_en: Multi-path route constructing method and system based on APDV (Ad Hoc On-demand Distance Vector)
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-path route constructing method and a system based on APDV (Ad Hoc On-demand Distance Vector). The method comprises the following steps: recording the times of a reply route response packets by a destination node or a middle node containing the newest route of the destination node; when the preset times are achieved, stopping the reply route response packets, and discarding the follow-up route request packets; judging whether the router response packets are received for the first time or not by a transmission node, if so, transferring the router reply packets, otherwise discarding the router reply packets; carrying out priority comparison on the paths constructed by the route reply packets through a source node, using the optimal path as a main path, using the suboptimal route as a backup path, and deleting other paths. In the invention, the number of the repeated route reply packets in network can be reduced, and the repeated transfer of the route reply packets can be reduced, and thus, the risk of network congestion can be decreased. The invention can adapt to the characteristic of frequent changes of Ad Hoc network topology structure, and is convenient to set up multi-path route quickly and effectively.

title_en: Methods and systems for sending messages regarding an emergency that occurred at a facility
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for sending messages regarding an emergency at a facility. The messages can be sent to an emergency response service or directly to another facility through a wireless mesh network. The wireless mesh network can comprise one or more nodes that route measurement data, such as utility meter reading data. The emergency messages can be assigned a higher priority so that they travel through the wireless mesh network more quickly. A device receiving an emergency message may identify the address of the associated facility, for example, by identifying an address associated with utility service also provided at the same facility. The address can be forwarded to an emergency response service and a confirmation or other message may be sent back to the facility. A device at a facility may receive various messages from a control center, such as a weather center, over the wireless mesh network.
assignees: CELLNET INNOVATIONS INC;CHASKO STEPHEN J;LANDIS & GYR INNOVATIONS INC;MONNERIE EMMANUEL;SHUDARK JEFFREY B

title_en: System and method for using ad hoc networks in cooperation with service provider networks
abstract_en: Systems and methods for using ad hoc networks in cooperation with service provider networks. Multi-network devices communicate with each other as peers in an ad hoc network while each accessing a service provider network. The multi-network devices may each receive the same real-time multimedia stream, be it broadcast or unicast, while sharing stream parity information. The peers may take corrective action to maintain uninterrupted playback of the real-time multimedia stream with no or minimal loss in perceived quality. The peers may further cooperate to facilitate bandwidth and power optimization, fast channel switching, and real-time mobile traffic and network analysis, displays and alerts.
assignees: CHEN JOHN ANTHONY;COUGHLIN BRIAN;FILIPPI GEOFF;GOULD KENNETH;TIME WARNER CABLE ENTPR LLC

title_en: Firmware updating method, communication unit, and program
abstract_en: Disclosed is a data updating method executed by communication apparatuses in an ad hoc network or other network which connects communication units directly or through other communication units. The gateway of the transmission source of firm data selects a predetermined number of neighboring "parent" communication units so that the ones with a low evaluation value, which includes wireless quality, are given priority, transfers the updated firm data, and executes data update. Similarly, the parent communication units in which update has been executed select a predetermined number of other neighboring "child" communication units, in which data upgrade has yet to be executed, so that the ones with a relatively low evaluation value indicating the channel quality pertaining to reachability of the final address, transfer the upgraded firm data, and execute data upgrade. Hereinafter, similar selection from the child communication units, with respect to "grandchild" communication units and "great grandchild" communication units is performed, and data transfer processing by upgraded firm data is repeated.

title_en: Failsafe Signal Transmission for Wireless Sensor Mesh
abstract_en: An apparatus is provided. The apparatus includes a plurality of transceivers arranged in a mesh network that each synchronously communicate with at least one other of the plurality of transceivers in an assigned slot of a TDMA channel, at least a first of the plurality of transceivers asynchronously transmitting a priority message on a priority channel that is different than the TDMA channel and at least a second of the plurality of transceivers that detects an information content of the asynchronous priority message on the priority channel and retransmits the detected information content synchronously on the TDMA channel to a third transceiver of the plurality of transceivers.

title_en: A sector-based method of messaging direction decision in vehicular ad hoc networks
title_ko: 차량 애드 혹 네트워크 시스템의 노드를 위한 섹터 기반 메시징 방향 판단 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르는 차량 애드 혹 네트워크 시스템의 노드를 위한 섹터 기반 방향 판단 방법은, 긴급 메시지에 자신의 위치정보 및 진행 방향 정보를 삽입하여 주변 노드들로 브로드캐스팅하는 단계; 상기 긴급 메시지가 수신되면, 긴급 메시지를 전송한 차량을 중심으로 일정 크기 간격의 기울기를 가지는 직선들로 공간을 다수의 섹터로 분할하고, 상기 긴급 메시지에 포함된 위치정보에 따른 위치에서 자신의 위치정보에 따른 위치를 나타내는 직선의 기울기가 속하는 섹터를 검출하는 단계; 상기 섹터가 상기 긴급 메시지에 포함된 진행 방향 정보에 대응되면, 상기 긴급 메시지를 처리하고 주변 노드들로 브로드캐스팅하는 단계; 상기 섹터가 상기 긴급 메시지에 포함된 진행 방향 정보에 대응되지 않으면, 상기 긴급 메시지를 삭제하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for providing mobile communication
abstract_en: The present invention provides a mobile communication system comprising a radio access network, wherein the radio access network comprises: a plurality of base stations; a smart node connected with at least one of the base stations, wherein the smart node is adapted to buffering data between the base stations and user equipments, and wherein the data comprises low priority application data with high latency budget, or real-time or an interactive application data. The present invention also provide a method for such mobile communication. The system and the method according to the present invention may reduce load of the backhaul network through handling appropriate traffic closer to end-user, i.e. the base stations and gateways. It may further reduce the peak load of the network by scheduling traffic of delay-tolerant applications for later delivery, buffering it at base stations. The computing gateway may perform data tunnelling, act as a mobility anchor and analyse the tunnelled traffic to serve mobile users' requests locally.

title_en: System and Method for Simultaneous Infrastructure and Ad Hoc Networked Communications
abstract_en: A method and a system are disclosed for maintaining a simultaneous communication between a first wireless station and both an access point and a second wireless station. The first and second wireless stations are associated with the access point, or only one of the wireless stations, but not both, is associated with the access point. The first wireless station gains an instance of medium access by using applicable medium access protocols. Once the first wireless station gains an instance of medium access, it transmits frames to the access point on an infrastructure network and to the second wireless station on the same infrastructure network or an ad hoc network. The overall air time must not exceed the maximum air time allowed for the instance of medium access. All transmitted frames must have a user priority mapped to the access category for which the instance of medium access was obtained.
assignees: HO JIN-MENG;TEXAS INSTRUMENTS INC;XHAFA ARITON E

title_en: Systems, methods, and apparatus for identifying invalid nodes within a mesh network
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatus for identifying, invalid nodes within a mesh network are provided. A routing table may be maintained by a utility meter. The routing table may include information associated with one or more devices in communication with the utility meter via a mesh network. A change in the routing table may be identified by the utility meter, and an alert message associated with the identified change may be generated by the utility meter. The generated alert may then be output by the utility meter for communication to a central controller configured to process the alert message to identify an invalid node within the mesh network.
assignees: BOOT JOHN CHRISTOPHER;GEN ELECTRIC;REE BRADLEY RICHARD

title_en: System and method for testing emergency dispatch systems
abstract_en: A system and method for testing and monitoring all critical operational aspects of a conventional, non-trunked, radio communications base radio or repeater system and alerting the dispatcher when a communication failure or error occurs. The system includes a monitor radio, a dispatch display unit, a communications link from the dispatch center to a remote base station, and a master control unit that is in communication with the monitor radio, the dispatch display unit, and an existing dispatch console.

title_en: Method for mesh networking of street lamp and apparatus thereof
title_ko: 가로등 원격 제어를 위한 메쉬 네트워킹 방법 및 이에 적용되는 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mesh networking method for remotely controlling a street lamp is provided to implement a mesh networking for controlling the turn of or off of a street lamp based on a local area communication module. CONSTITUTION: A short cut information for each via node is prepared based on inherent ID of a street lamp(213) or fixed coordinates. The information for controlling the street lamp is transmitted or each control mode for collecting event information of each street lamp are performed by the priority of transmission node list information. Transmission success list information is created by the return of ID information which successfully performs communication. A broadcast mode is performed by the transmission success list.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서 가로등의 지능형 네트워킹 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 방법은 a) 가로등의 고유 ID 및 고정 좌표를 기반으로, 각 가로등의 설치 위치에 따른 전송 가로등 좌표정보, 차기 전송가로등 좌표리스트 정보, 전송 목적지 좌표 정보를 포함하여, 상기 통신모듈의 송수신 반경 이내에서 경유 노드에 대한 최소거리 정보를 구축하는 단계; b) 최소거리 정보에 기초하여 가로등 간 통신 순서를 위한 우선순위가 결정된 전송노드 리스트 정보를 구축하는 단계; 및 c) 전송노드 리스트 정보에 의한 우선순위에 따라 가로등을 개별적으로 제어하기 위한 제어정보를 전송하거나, 각 가로등의 이벤트 정보를 수집하기 위한 개별제어 모드를 수행하며, 상기 전송노드 리스트 정보에 기초하여 노드간 통신이 이루어진 후, 통신에 성공한 고유 ID 정보를 회신하여 전송성공 리스트 정보를 생성하고, 전송성공 리스트에 의해 각 가로등(213)에 대한 일괄 제어 또는 가로등 간의 연동 제어가 이루어지는 브로드케스트 모드를 수행하는 단계;로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Video file data transmission method based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a video file data transmission method based on an Ad hoc network, which comprises the following steps: error resilient coding a video file to be transmitted; forward Error Correction (FEC) coding is used for the video file which completes the error elastic coding; performing data scheduling processing on the video file subjected to the FEC encoding processing by using a 2-path priority transmission method and a hierarchical priority scheduling method; and transmitting the video file subjected to the data scheduling processing in a physical layer based on the bit stream. The design makes the wireless network more suitable for the transmission of multimedia data; by adopting the improved 2-path transmission method, routing selection can be carried out more intelligently according to the specific requirements of services, the requirement on time delay is relatively low, and the data with relatively strict time delay can be data with small time delay; when the time delay is not large, a more reliable route can be adopted for data transmission.

title_en: Routing apparatus and method for a mobile ad-hoc network
title_ko: 모바일 애드혹 네트워크의 라우팅 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A routing device of a mobile ad-hoc network and a method thereof are provided to maintain energy balance of a mobile node by selecting a transfer path according to a priority of a message. CONSTITUTION: An order determining unit(110) determines a priority of a message which is transmitted from a source node to a destination node. A transmission path selecting unit(120) selects a path of the determined message from the source node to destination node. A message transmitting unit(130) transmits the message through the transmission path.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 애드혹 네트워크의 라우팅 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 메시지의 우선 순위에 따라 상이한 전송경로를 선택함으로써 전체적인 모바일 노드의 에너지 균형을 유지하도록 경로를 분산시킬 수 있으므로, 최적 경로에 통신량이 집중되는 정체 현상을 방지할 수 있고, 전체적인 네트워크의 성능과 수명을 효율적으로 증대시킬 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Methods and systems for a mesh-network takeover
abstract_en: Methods and systems for a mesh-network takeover are provided. In one embodiment, a first controller having a first attribute and a first group of nodes in its network receives a message from a node in the first group. The message indicates that the node in the first group received a signal from a node that is in a second group and associated with a second controller having a second attribute. Further, the message includes the second attribute. Responsive to receiving the message, the first controller compares the first attribute with the second attribute. As a result of comparing the first attribute with the second attribute, the first controller makes a determination that it has a lower priority than the second controller. Responsive to making the determination, the first controller no longer communicates with the first group, resulting in at least one node in the first group joining the second network.
assignees: DELKER JASON R;EVERSON JOHN M;NORRIS JAMES W;SPRINT SPECTRUM LP;TITUS JEREMY G

title_en: Methods and apparatus for adaptive partitioning of links
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus for efficiently scheduling links in wireless communications networks are described. Various described methods and apparatus are well suited for use in ad hoc wireless networks in which scheduling decisions are made in a distributed and/or decentralized manner. In some embodiments, the links in a network, e.g., in a peer to peer ad hoc network, are adaptively grouped based on comparable link channel gain. Exemplary signaling used, in some but not necessarily all embodiments, by devices to estimate channel gains include broadcast connection identifier signals and reverse broadcast connection identifier signals. Grouping links into sets based on comparable link channel gain, and selectively ordering the scheduling priorities of the different groups, is used to improve scheduling efficiency, e.g., decrease the likelihood that unnecessary yielding occurs.
assignees: CHANG CHRISTOPHER S;KHUDE NILESH;QUALCOMM INC;SUBRAMANIAN SUNDAR;WU XINZHOU

title_en: A low current RF alarm device mesh network
abstract_en: A wireless alarm device network (1) comprises alarm devices (A-J, L) each having a processor, a wireless communication interface, and a condition sensor. The devices are communicate by wirelessly transmitting messages, and in a learning mode, automatically register in a monitoring cluster according to received signal strengths. A device (A-J, K) recognises a device as being in its cluster if at least received signal strength exceeds a threshold. Each device is adapted to monitor each other device or devices in its cluster, and to generate an alert if it determines that a device in its cluster is not sending messages.

title_en: Multi-path radio transmission input/output devices, network, systems and methods with on demand, prioritized routing protocol
abstract_en: Devices, networks, systems and methods for coordinating industrial control and monitoring communications on multi-path radio frequency transmission mesh networks include establishing path metrics allowing a respective comparison of a plurality of available communication paths between neighboring radios communicating in the mesh network. Replies to route requests may be delayed based on the path metrics of available paths for message transmission to ensure that the best available connection routes through the mesh network can be understood and utilized.

title_en: Relay node device, ad hoc network and radio relay method therefor
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a relay node device capable of suppressing a decreased communication speed according to a communication environment, in the multistage relay connection of ad hoc communication.SOLUTION: When each of a plurality of node devices mutually performs direct radio communication in an ad hoc mode, the relay node device (radio base station 1) is used in an ad hoc network for multi-hop communication by a bucket brigade system to connect the communication. The relay node device (radio base station 1) comprises: first detection means (111) for detecting the priority of each of the plurality of relay node devices, a use communication band and a link speed between relay nodes; second detection means (112) for detecting duplication of a first and a second communication route which are different in each of the plurality of relay node devices; and when the second detection means detects the duplication of the first and second communication routes, control means (113) for changing one of the first and second communication routes, based on the detection result of the first detection means.

title_en: An anti-theft security system for atm and the anti-theft security method
title_ko: 금융자동화기기의 도난 방지용 보안 시스템 및 이를 이용한 금융자동화기기의 도난 방지용 보안 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An antitheft security method of an automatic teller machine(ATM) and an antitheft security method are provided to improve security of the ATM. CONSTITUTION: An antitheft security system of an ATM includes a wireless communication module(100), a communication modem(300) and a wired/wireless router(200). The wireless communication module is equipped into the ATM. The communication modem is installed in an extra space in the ATM and exchanges information between the ATM and a financial server through a connected communication network. The wired/wireless router is connected to the communication modem and is installed in the extra space in which the communication modem is installed. The wired/wireless router exchanges the information with the wireless communication module through wireless communication. [Reference numerals] (120) External power; (AA) Communication network
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 금융자동화기기의 도난 방지용 보안 시스템 및 이를 이용한 금융자동화기기의 도난 방지용 보안방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 통상의 금융자동화기기 내부에 구비되어 통신회선을 통해 금융자동화기기와 금융서버간의 통신을 수행하던 통신모뎀을 금융자동화기기 외부의 별도 공간에 설치하고, 통신모뎀에 유무선 라우터를 연결하여 상기 유무선 라우터와 금융자동화기기가 무선 통신하도록 구성하여, 상기 금융자동화기기의 기기 오류, 전원 차단 및/또는 도난 발생 등으로 인해 상기 금융자동화기기와 유무선 라우터간의 통신이 두절되는 경우, 상기 유무선 라우터가 이에 연결된 통신모뎀을 통해 경보신호를 금융서버로 전송함으로써, 금융자동화기기의 이상장애 또는 도난 등의 사고로 인한 통신중단과 일반적인 통신회선의 접속장애로 인한 통신중단을 용이하게 구분하여, 관리자에게 금융자동화기기의 현장 점검 및 보안 작업에 대한 편의성을 제공해주는 동시에, 발생 가능한 도난 사고에 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 하는 금융자동화기기의 도난 방지용 보안 시스템 및 이를 이용한 금융자동화기기의 도난 방지용 보안 방법에 관한 것이다.  
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 금융자동화기기 내부에 구비되는 무선통신 모듈; 금융자동화기기 외부의 별도 공간에 설치되어 연결된 통신망을 통해 상기 금융자동화기기와 금융 서버간의 정보를 교환하는 통신모뎀; 및 상기 통신모뎀에 연결되어 상기 통신모뎀이 설치된 별도 공간에 설치되며, 상기 무선통신 모듈과의 무선 통신을 통해 정보를 교환하는 유무선 라우터;를 포함하여 구성되어, 상기 유무선 라우터와 무선통신 모듈간의 통신이 단절되는 경우, 상기 유무선 라우터가 연결된 통신모뎀을 통해 금융서버로 경보신호를 전송하도록 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Multi-path qos(quality-of-service) routing method for wireless mesh network
title_ko: 무선 메쉬 네트워크에서의 다중 경로 ＱｏＳ 라우팅 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multi-path quality of service routing method in a wireless mesh network is provided to restore and select a path by using an RREQ(Route REQuest) message, an RREP(Route ResPonse) message, and an RERR(Route ERRor) message. CONSTITUTION: The reliability of paths is compared from each other in nodes. Each of the nodes selects a main path and one or more alternative paths(S520). Each of the nodes determines the priority of the paths based on the reliability(S530). Each of the nodes stores the main path, and the alternative path, and the priority in a routing table(S540). When the main path is disconnected, the disconnected node deletes the main path in the routing table(S560). The disconnected node modifies a posterior ranking path to the main path based on the priority. [Reference numerals] (AA) Disconnection of the main path is occurs; (BB) No; (CC) Yes; (S510) Searching paths satisfying QoS which is required by application services; (S520) Selecting a main path and alternative paths; (S530) Determining the priority of the paths; (S540) Storing the main path, alternative paths, and priority in a routing table; (S550) Transmitting packets through the main path; (S560) Deleting the main path from the routing table and modifying a posterior ranking path to the main path
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 메쉬 네트워크에서의 QoS(Quality of Service) 경로 선택 알고리즘에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면 다중 경로 라우팅 방법이 제공된다. 상기 다중 경로 라우팅 방법은 응용서비스(application)가 요구하는 QoS(Quality of Service)를 만족하는 복수의 경로들을 탐색하는 단계, 상기 복수의 경로들의 신뢰도를 비교하여 주 경로와 적어도 하나 이상의 대체 경로를 선택하는 단계, 상기 신뢰도에 기반하여 상기 복수의 경로들의 우선 순위를 결정하는 단계, 상기 주 경로, 상기 대체 경로 및 상기 우선 순위를 라우팅 테이블에 저장하는 단계 및 상기 주 경로에 단절이 발생하였을 경우 상기 주 경로를 상기 라우팅 테이블에서 삭제하고, 상기 우선 순위에 기반하여 후 순위 경로를 주 경로로 수정하는 단계를 포함한다. 
따라서, 무선 네트워크의 QoS(Quality of Service)를 보장하고, 높은 강건성(robustness)을 지닌 다중 경로 QoS 라우팅을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: An automatic alarm apparatus for rainfall or water level with dual communication and a method for the same
title_ko: 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic rainfall amount or water level alarm device and method are provided to prepare for the generation outrage of communication by using CDMA(code division multiple access) communications when an error is generated in VHF(very high frequency) communications. CONSTITUTION: An automatic rainfall amount or water level alarm device comprises a rainfall amount station(100), a control station(300), an alarm station(400), and a monitoring station(500). The rainfall amount station observes amount of rainfall and transmits a rainfall value to the control station in the request of the control station. The rainfall amount station transmits an alarm event signal to the control station when the rainfall value is greater than or equal to a set reference value. The control station transmits a rainfall value request signal every constant time and receives the rainfall value or the alarm event signal and transmits an alarm notice signal to the control station. The control station receives the alarm notice signal and outputs an alarm message according to the alarm notice signal. The monitoring station is connected to the control station and monitors the control station and instructs a warning command or an announcement command. [Reference numerals] (100) Rainfall amount station; (200) Water level station; (300) Control station; (400) Alarm station; (500) Monitoring station
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 강우의 양을 관측하며, 통제국의 요청 시 상기 통제국에 우량값을 전송하고, 우량값이 기 설정 기준값 이상인 경우 상기 통제국에 경보 이벤트 신호를 전송하는 우량국; 상기 우량국에 일정 시간 간격으로 우량값 요청 신호를 송신하며, 상기 우량국으로부터 상기 우량값 또는 상기 경보 이벤트 신호를 수신하고 경보국에 경보발령 신호를 전송하는 통제국; 상기 통제국으로부터 경보발령 신호를 수신하고, 상기 경보발령 신호에 따라 경보 메시지를 출력하는 경보국; 및 상기 통제국과 연결되어 상기 통제국을 모니터링하고, 경보 명령 또는 안내 방송 명령을 지시하는 감시국을 포함하되, 상기 우량국 또는 상기 경보국은, 제1 통신 방법에 의하여 상기 통제국과 통신한 뒤 기설정 시간 내에 상기 통제국으로부터 수신 확인 신호를 수신하지 못할 경우 상기 제1 통신 방법이 실패한 것으로 판단하고, 상기 제1 통신 방법이 기설정 횟수만큼 실패한 경우 제2 통신 방법을 이용하여 상기 통제국과 통신하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법에 따르면, 우량국과 통제국을 포함하는 각 구성 간의 통신을 이중화하여, 기본적으로는 VHF 통신을 사용하되 VHF 통신에 오류가 발생하면 CDMA 통신을 사용함으로써 통신 장애 발생을 대비할 수 있다. 또한 본 발명에 따른 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법은, 평시에는 통제국이 일정 시간(1시간) 간격으로 우량국에 우량값을 요청하도록 하고, 우량값이 기준값 이상인 비상 상황일 경우에는 우량국이 자체적으로 통제국에 경보를 송신할 수 있도록 하여 우량국의 전력 사용을 대폭 절감할 수 있다.

title_en: Ad-hoc network communication terminal, ad-hoc network communication terminal control method, and ad-hoc network communication system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make it possible to control communication accuracy corresponding to temporal change in the transmission priority of data in an ad-hoc network.SOLUTION: An ad-hoc network communication terminal 100 comprises: a network interface 113 for exchanging a packet with another communication terminal 101; and an arithmetic unit 111 for performing processing of calculating the transmission priority of a packet by applying a lapsed time from packet reception clock time to next packet transmission clock time at the communication terminal to a temporal change function of the transmission priority depending on a packet type indicated by the packet for each packet received from the other communication terminal 101 via the network interface 113, processing of determining earlier transmission order according to height of the calculated transmission priority per packet among packets scheduled to be transmitted, and processing of transmitting each packet scheduled to be transmitted on the basis of the determined transmission order at an arrival of the next packet transmission clock time.
assignees: FUJIHARA TORU;HARADA SATORU;HITACHI LTD;IGARASHI YUICHI;MONDEN KAZUYA;NAKANO RYO;SATOH HIROKI

title_en: Transmission control method and nodes
abstract_en: Each of a plurality of nodes, which form an ad hoc network, determines whether an identifier, which indicates data having a high priority, has been added to data received from another node. Then, if the identifier has been added to the data, each node determines whether the local node is a device that is to relay the received data to the destination thereof. Thereafter, each node, if having determined that the local node is a device that is to relay the received data to the destination thereof, transmits the received data to the destination thereof. Otherwise, each node does not perform the data transmission to any other node.
assignees: AMANO MITSUHARU;FUJITSU LTD;KAWATOKO MAKOTO;KUROGI YASUHIRO;NOMURA YAYOI;OKAMASU TAKAYUKI

title_en: device-to-device (D2D) cross-link power control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device-to-device (D2D) cross-link power control system and method. For example, a device such as a UE or WTRU may determine whether it may have simultaneous transmissions, where at least one of the transmissions may include a cross-link transmission. The device may further determine whether the aggregate transmit power of the simultaneous transmissions exceeds a maximum transmit power of the device. If a device can have simultaneous transmissions and this transmission can exceed the maximum transmit power, the device can reallocate power according to a priority or priority setting. The device may further determine a maximum cross-link power, a maximum device power, and a cross-link transmit power level, such that the device may control the power for transmission based further thereon.
assignees: INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS;INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Radio Resource Managment for Dual Priority Access
abstract_en: The present invention relates to performing radio resource management tasks in a communication system including at least a base station and a terminal. In order to avoid inconsistencies in executing the radio resource management tasks for the dual-priority devices, which may run a delay-tolerant and a normal application at the same time, when the device priority changes, the change is indicated to the base station either from the terminal or from the core network. The device priority may be indicated as an overall priority per device or as a priority per bearer configured for the device.

title_en: Reliable routing protocol used for vehicle-mounted Ad Hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliable routing protocol used for a vehicle-mounted Ad Hoc network. According to the reliable routing protocol, in a route discovery phase, a priority node judgment mechanism is introduced through extension of an RREQ message format, so that the forwarding number of an RREQ message is restricted, and flooding broadcast of the RREQ message in the network is prevented. In a route maintenance phase, if a main route loses efficacy, a source node does not need to send a routing request, instead, a backup route is directly utilized for route repair, so that the efficiency of the route repair is improved. By the adoption of the technical scheme of the reliable routing protocol, the delivery rate of data packets can be increased, routing overhead can be lowered, routing repair time after a link is disconnected can be shortened, and the performance of the vehicle-mounted Ad Hoc network is improved.

title_en: Node, method and device for setting routing in wireless mesh network
title_ko: 무선 메쉬 네트워크에서의 노드, 라우팅 설정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A node, a method for setting routing in a wireless mesh network and an apparatus thereof are provided to assure quality of jitter performance which is deemed to be most important in Quality of Service (QoS) of real-time data transmission, by setting routing by considering the jitter characteristics of a packet. CONSTITUTION: A jitter information acquisition unit (401) acquires jitter information of nodes included in multiple paths from a source node to a destination node. A routing setting unit (403) sets routing from the source node to the destination node using the acquired jitter information of the nodes. Each node calculates the jitter information differently according to the priority of the traffic coming into each node. The jitter information is calculated by using at least one of the priority of the traffic, the period of the traffic, the arrival rate of the traffic and the service rate of the traffic. [Reference numerals] (401) Jitter information acquisition unit; (403) Routing setting unit; (411) Jitter dispersion calculation unit; (413) Route selection unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 무선 메쉬 네트워크에서의 노드, 라우팅 설정 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 메쉬 네트워크에서의 라우팅 설정 방법은 소스 노드에서 목적지 노드에 이르는 다중 경로 각각에 포함되는 각 노드들의 지터 정보를 획득하는 단계(a); 및 상기 각 노드들의 지터 정보를 이용하여 상기 소스 노드에서 상기 목적지 노드로의 라우팅을 설정하는 단계(b)를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 패킷의 지터 특성을 고려하여 라우팅을 설정함으로써 실시간 데이터 전송의 OoS에서 가장 중요하게 여기는 지터 성능의 품질을 보장하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Quality of service for mesh networks
abstract_en: Quality of service for mesh networks is described. In embodiment(s), communication data can be prioritized as priority data and/or non-priority data for communication from a source node to a destination node in a mesh network. A first communication route in the mesh network can be determined to communicate the priority data from the source node to the destination node based on a minimum number of intermediate nodes via which the priority data is communicated. Additionally, a second communication route in the mesh network can be determined to communicate the non-priority data from the source node to the destination node based on a highest bit rate to communicate the non-priority data. A time duration to communicate the priority via the first communication route is less than a time duration to communicate the non-priority data via the second communication route.
assignees: BHAGWAT RAJESH SHREERAM;CHOKSHI RONAK ANJAN;MARVELL INT LTD;SHUKLA ASHISH KUMAR

title_en: Systems and methods facilitating joint channel and routing assignment for wireless mesh networks
abstract_en: Systems, methods and apparatus facilitating joint channel and routing assignment are provided. In some embodiments, a system includes nodes in a network configured to perform distributed joint channel and routing assignment of traffic through exchange of information with one another. The assignments are iteratively updated based on whether the update will result in an increase in a value of a function associated with throughput for traffic in the network. In some embodiments, the assignments are determined based on random decisions that are adopted if the function is improved utilizing the routing and channel information in the assignment. In some embodiments, the assignments are determined based on traffic prioritization in which destination nodes having a high level of traffic are assigned routes and channels having characteristics amenable to reduction of interference in the network.
assignees: UNIV HONG KONG SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV HONG KONG SCIENCE & TECHN

title_en: A kind of mobile ad-hoc network routing method on demand based on link-quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mobile ad-hoc network routing method on demand based on link-quality, the problem in the most reliable path cannot be found for the mobile ad-hoc network On-demand routing algorithm based on most billet number, by converting radio link quality to route discovery priority, and then convert route discovery time delay to, source node and each intermediate node send route requests message according to time delay to respective neighbor node, node first time forwards when receiving route requests message, the route requests message again received directly is abandoned, to ensure that the path with optimized link state can be chosen as routed path.Adopt routing discovering method of the present invention, optimum route can be found in mobile ad-hoc network.In addition, the present invention also adds the scheme that routing state is safeguarded on route discovery basis, can find that the malfunctioning node in mobile ad-hoc network enters and unstable link, so that the optimum route of real-time update.

title_en: Airliner-mounted cellular base station
abstract_en: An aircraft-mounted base transceiver station (mBTS) for providing intermittent coverage in a cellular radio network. The mBTS utilizes the existing protocol of its terrestrial counterparts, thereby avoiding dual-mode devices and enabling common usage of terminal monitoring and device management systems for devices connected to a single radio access network even when outside terrestrial coverage areas. The aircraft follows a transient flight pattern, providing intermittent flyover connectivity for remote radio device such as machine-type devices. Connectivity may be store and forward. Channel usage may be adjusted to avoid interfering with terrestrial communication cells during flyover. Doppler effects due to aircraft speed may be accounted for. The mBTS may be configured to service in-range radio devices which are outside a Doppler-inhibited region and/or to prioritize communication with devices based on expected time outside the Doppler-inhibited region. An aircraft mounted antenna may have a radiation pattern focused toward devices outside the Doppler-inhibited region.
assignees: BENNETT STEVEN JOHN;SIERRA WIRELESS INC;VOS GERALD GUSTAV

title_en: Data scheduling method and system in area-limited ad hoc network
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a data scheduling method and a system in an area-limited ad hoc network.SOLUTION: The method includes: constituting a limited area of an ad hoc network on the basis of an overlapped area of a cover range of a plurality of signal transmitters located in an ad hoc network area; dividing the limited area into a plurality of sub-areas and giving position priority to each of the sub-areas; determining the position priority given to the sub-area as a position priority of a node in the sub-area; calculating data transfer priority for each node from the acquired position priority for each node and other predetermined priorities; and transferring the data among the nodes on the basis of the calculated data transfer priority for each node.

title_en: Delegated channel switching for mesh-type networks
abstract_en: The disclosure describes is a channel switching strategy and corresponding protocol for a mesh network which comprises a segment controller (SC) and a large number of outdoor luminaire controllers (OLCs) or other network nodes. A channel switching process is initiated and managed by the SC which transmits a channel switching command to all nodes in the system. Following the actual channel switch, the SC delegate's responsibility to request an orphan node to switch to the new channel to a selected delegate node which is a neighbor node of the orphan node. The selection of the delegate node may be based on a prioritization. When an OLC does not receive any messages for a specified, prolonged period of time, it may scan available frequency bands to find the (new) channel in which the networked system operates at that time.

title_en: Prioritized queueing in a mesh network based on age of payload data
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method comprises identifying an age of payload data in a data packet by a wireless network node configured for transmitting the data packet to a multi-hop destination via a wireless mesh network; determining by the wireless network node a schedule for the data packet reaching the multi-hop destination; and the wireless network node prioritizing queuing of the data packet for Collision Sense with Multiple Access and Collision Avoidance (CSMA-CA) based wireless transmission in the wireless mesh network based on the corresponding age, relative to the schedule and respective ages of other data packets awaiting transmission by the wireless network node to the destination, where a higher-aged data packet relative to the schedule is granted have a higher priority than a lower-aged data packet relative to the schedule.

title_en: System and method for broadcasting messages to nodes within a wireless mesh network
abstract_en: A node within a wireless mesh network is configured to forward a high-priority message to adjacent nodes in the wireless mesh network by either (i) transmitting the message during successive timeslots to the largest subset of nodes capable of receiving transmissions during each timeslot, or (ii) transmitting the message on each different channel during the timeslot when the largest subset of nodes are capable of receiving transmissions on each of those channels.

title_en: Wireless Mesh network channel allocation system and wireless Mesh network channel allocation method under partially overlapped channels
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless Mesh network channel allocation system and a wireless Mesh network channel allocation method under partially overlapped channels. The system comprises a neighbor-interface binding module, a channel allocation order determination module and a greedy channel allocation module; the neighbor-interface binding module determines neighbor-interface binding relations according to the adjacent relations between nodes of a physical topology, and links which share the same interface serve as a whole and share the same channel when channels are allocated; the Rank descending order is used by the channel allocation order determination module, and the channel allocation order of each link is determined according to the principle that the link with the greatest Rank value is given priority in channel allocation; in order to minimize total interference in a network, the greedy channel allocation module uses the greedy algorithm to allocate channels to all the links in the network. The invention can effectively decrease the probability of network jamming, reduce interference in the network, increase the parallel transmission count in the network and increase the network capacity.

title_en: Stable cluster method for routing based on link-aware in vehicular ad hoc network
abstract_en: The present invention proposes stable cluster method for routing based on link-aware in a kind of vehicular ad hoc network, belongs to vehicular ad hoc network technical field.The method utilizes node similarity S in Affinity Propagation clustering method, internodal cohesion IN and Connected degree D to calculate node priority, and the node of priority maximum becomes a bunch head；After cluster, disconnect information according to the method for node link perception to crossing trigger link；Junction node calculates connected probability again according to the break-make in section in nearest k the cycle of record, and junction node utilizes again connected probability and greedy method choice optimal candidate bunch, and arrives the gateway node of optimal candidate bunch according to greedy method choice.Method shown in the present invention significantly improves the delivery ratio of packet, reduces the time delay needed for packet transmission, adds the stability of bunch head, decrease a bunch head number, reduces jumping figure and the average delay of data transmission, greatly reduces routing cost.

title_en: Vehicular safety system
abstract_en: A vehicular safety system employing an adaptive epidemic information dissemination protocol running on a wireless ad-hoc network composed by neighbouring vehicles (305, 306) and roadside stations (301). The protocol is based on collaborative storage and retransmission of messages by on-board units in vehicles; both storage time and retransmission period are adaptively adjusted in order to make information spread through the network reasonably certain. An on-board system (120) of each vehicle monitors amongst other parameters a vehicle's speed and acceleration in order to detect collisions or any other situation that might endanger road users or compromise the safety of driver and passengers; when such an event is detected a short time-stamped message that optionally identifies the vehicle and that contains its approximate location and the type of event is transmitted. A panic button is included to trigger an emergency message in case of situations that represent an immediate threat to the physical integrity of driver and passengers. Roadside stations (301) add their location to the messages they relay, making satellite or map-based positioning technologies unnecessary; they also receive messages transmitted from passing vehicles (305, 306), relaying them to law-enforcement agencies. Roadside stations (301) can also broadcast messages aimed at locating and safely disabling stolen vehicles.

title_en: Space ad hoc network flow control method and system for power emergency communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a space ad hoc network flow control method and a space ad hoc network flow control system for a power emergency communication system. The space ad hoc network flow control method comprises the steps that, a service source node allocates DSCP (Differentiated Service Code Point) corresponding to service flows according to the priority of the service flows, and then a middle node performs interrupt processing according to the transmitting behavior corresponding to the DSCP; thereby, the scheduling of resources of the network and effective bandwidth allocation are achieved, and the operating quality of the network is improved; the method is not limited by space, and can be flexibly applied to network structures of ground-ground, space-space, space-ground and other ad hoc networks in the air-ground-space integrated network.
assignees: INFORMATION COMM BRANCH OF STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: The restoration methods and system of Ad hoc networks route
abstract_en: A kind of restoration methods and system of Ad hoc networks route, by the information for obtaining the beacon message that sending node is sent, the routing table for recording multiple reachable destination routing informations is generated according to the beacon message information, at Relay Region of the next-hop node not in present node, the node for replacing next-hop node is selected to be forwarded according to the routing table.In the routing table of generation, record multiple reachable destination routing informations, via node in next-hop region is removed when causing route collapse, system can directly select the neighbor node of the higher present node of priority level as next-hop node according to the routing table, the upper hop node that FERROR messages need not be sent to it recalculates selection next-hop node, the expense of routing algorithm in itself is effectively reduced, network load is reduced, improves network performance.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY GROUP CORP NO 7 RES INST

title_en: Dynamic access class assignment and secondary public safety users offload in public safety network
abstract_en: Systems, methods, apparatuses, and computer program products for dynamic access class provisioning of devices and secondary public safety user offload are provided. One method includes receiving a trigger request and the IMSI of a UE that requires a higher priority AC from a PS application server. The trigger request may include an indication to update the AC of the UE to the higher priority AC. The method may then include initiating a MT-SMS with priority that is sent to the UE via serving nodes.
assignees: CHANDRAMOULI DEVAKI;NOKIA SIEMENS NETWORKS OY;NOKIA SIEMENTS NETWORKS OY;WONG CURT

title_en: Method and device for triggering buffer state reporting BSR
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and device for triggering Buffer State Reporting (BSR), which relate to the wireless communication field and are used to solve the problem of lacking a triggering mechanism for Device-to-Device communication Padding Buffer State Reporting (D2D Padding BSR) in the prior art. In an embodiment of the present invention, a user equipment determines the size of padding resources when organizing a Device-to-Network-link Media Access Control layer Protocol Data Unit (D2N MAC PDU), and decides whether to trigger the D2D Padding BSR or not according to the size of the padding resources and the priority of the Padding Buffer State Reporting Media Access Control layer Control Element carrying the Device-to-Device communication (D2D Padding BSR MAC CE), thereby the D2D Padding BSR triggering mechanism is achieved.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF TELECOMM TECH;CHINA ACADEMY TELECOMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for Transmission of Messages Having Different Priority Levels Between Transmitter-Receiver Nodes of an Ad Hoc Network
abstract_en:
The message transmission method for transmitting messages in an ad hoc network comprises at least two transmitter-receiver nodes that are capable of receiving and transmitting messages. The nodes communicate with each other through the despatch of messages within random access time slots organised in frames. The nodes of the network are distributed into groups in accordance with a basic distribution rule. The nodes in each group have the right to send messages in one time slot per frame of a predefined subset of frames specific to the group in accordance with the basic distribution rule. 
     The messages include at least messages having a low priority level and messages having a high priority level. Each of the nodes transmits the low priority level messages only in one time slot per frame of the predefined subset of frames specific to its own group. Each of the nodes transmits the high priority level messages in one time slot (c 1 ) per frame of the predefined subset of frames specific to its own group (T 2 ) and in at least one other time slot (c 2 , c 3 ). The node transmits any message having a high priority level a greater number of times than any message having a low priority level.

title_en: The implementation method of real-time mobile Ad hoc networks based on token passing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of implementation method of the real-time mobile Ad hoc networks based on token passing mechanism, it comprises the following steps：Step one：Whom priority arbitration stage, all nodes will count in them and hold limit priority message；Token is transmitted in a network, and will reach all nodes, and token holds limit priority message in network；Step 2：In the authorized transmissions stage, calculated in last node in priority arbitration stage by link-quality matrix and reach the shortest path for holding limit priority information node, and it is licensed to by the transmission of this path；Step 3：In the message transmission stage, the message transmission stage, the node for holding limit priority message have received mandate according to the authorized transmissions stage, and it, which is aware of, oneself holds limit priority message, initializes the frame in the stage, and message is sent to destination node.This invention ensures that data reach destination node in real time, so that there is provided preferable data transfer real-time ability.

title_en: A kind of power system network aided management system and management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system network aided management system and management method, including：Scan module, for scanning network channel, exchange, route and each item data of DHCP equipment and being interacted with other modules；Analysis module, design result is drawn for Comprehensive Correlation, analysis scan module, data-interface, administrator data input and statistical analysis；Memory module；Data-interface；Client.The network assistance management system uses B/S structures.The present invention can reach following effect：100% intranet and extranet desktop terminal access control；Network interruption caused by avoiding vrv desktop terminal ARP mechanism, solves ARP virus hidden danger；Network equipment failure Realtime Alerts；Identity network equipment, module real-time statistics；Identity network resource data is analyzed；Integrated inner-mesh network equipment management tool, raising efficiency；Obtain data in real time using multi-thread design, reach control in real time, identification, backup, recovery etc..

title_en: Apparatus for tamper proof security mechanism and tamper evident indicator
abstract_en: A system, apparatus, and method for a high degree of container security using tamper evident indicator is provided. According to one embodiment, the tamper evident indicator may be a visible alarm, an audible alarm, or their combinations. Further, the tamper evident indicator may be incorporated into a smart container monitoring system. More specifically, the tamper evident indicator may be linked to a mesh network, thus a primary container in a set of linked containers may alert inspectors to other containers that have been tampered.

title_en: Method and apparatus for enhanced navigation in a dispatch communication system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus provide enhanced navigational alerts for a vehicular two-way radio operating in a dispatch communication system. The integration and prioritization of navigational alerts with dispatch voice communication ensures that navigational alerts do not compromise mission critical voice communications. Navigational alerts in the form of navigational voice instructions and navigational tones are selectively prioritized based on predetermined parameters associated with the dispatch call.

title_en: Broadcasting method based on distance and energy balance in mobile Ad Hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadcasting method based on distance and energy balance in a mobile Ad Hoc network. A node obtains information of neighbor nodes according to groupings received from the neighbor nodes, determines the distance between itself and the neighbor nodes, and builds or updates a neighbor information table; forwarding priorities are determined according to the distance between the node and the neighbor nodes and the residual energy of the node, the node carries out time-sharing forwarding according to the forwarding priorities, and channel competition and grouping collision are reduced. A lost packet retransmission mechanism is included in the method, whether broadcasting groupings are sent successfully or not is judged according to the fact whether the same broadcasting grouping forwarded by the neighbor nodes is received or not, and the broadcasting reliability is further improved. The method can well restrain the broadcasting storm, and the broadcasting reliability is improved; meanwhile, the time delay is small, and the requirement of QoS application can be better met; the method can further balance the energy consumption of the nodes in the network better, and the service life of the network is prolonged.

title_en: Network assisted device to device discovery
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for network selection and traffic routing are disclosed herein. User equipment (UE) is configured to store an access network selection and detection function (ANDSF) management object (MO). The ANDSF MO may include network selection rules indicating relative priority based on a specific radio access technology (RAT) types of different access networks. The UE is configured to identify one or more available access networks. The UE is configured to establish a connection with an access network of the one or more available access networks. The UE establishes the connection with an access network having a RAT with a highest relative priority of the one or more available access networks based on the network selection rules.

title_en: Pre-emption and resource allocation prioritization for d2d communications
abstract_en: A network node assigns resources for use in wireless communication based on priority. The network node receives, from a wireless communication device, a service request message that requests connection of a communication session. The network node determines a priority level for the requested communication session. The priority level comprises a cellular layer admission priority of whether the network node can preempt cellular resources of an existing communication session in order to admit the requested communication session on the cellular layer, and a device-to-device (D2D) layer admission priority of whether the network node can preempt D2D resources of an existing communication session in order to admit the requested communication session on the D2D layer. The network node assigns resources based at least in part on the priority level. The resources are used for D2D communication or cellular communication.
assignees: ERICSSON TELEFON AB L M;ERICSSON TELEFON AB L M (publ)

title_en: Method of and system for controlling communications over a public safety network
abstract_en: A public safety (PS) device has a channel operating configuration during communications over a PS network. A key term associated with a PS incident is registered on the PS network. The PS network identifies any communication on the PS network that refers to the registered key term, modifies the channel operating configuration in response to such identification, and alerts a PS person operating the PS device to an identified communication by transmitting the identified communication to the PS person via the modified channel operating configuration.

title_en: User equipment and method for distributed channel access for d2d communications
abstract_en: Embodiments of a system and method for distributed channel access for device-to-device (D2D) communication in a wireless network are generally described herein. User equipment (UE) may transmit a connection identifier (CID) code at a beginning of a contention window to request channel access for a D2D transmission to a receiving device. Links for D2D transmissions from a transmitting device to a receiving device are identified by a CID that is mapped to a CID code. The UE may receive a bandwidth grant from the receiving device during the contention window, along with bandwidth grants for other CIDs, in an order based on a priority level of the CID. The UE may transmit data after reception of the bandwidth grants in time-frequency resources indicated in an associated one of the bandwidth grants. In some embodiments, spatial-reuse and variable resource size allocation are supported.

title_en: Systems, methods, and devices for distributed scheduling for device-to-device interference mitigation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and devices for device-to-device (D2D) distributed scheduling are disclosed herein. User equipment (UE) is configured to measure a received power level for a reference signal received from a target UE and measure received power levels for reference signals received from one or more non-target UEs. The UE is configured to generate a resource usage map for the target UE and the one or more non-target UEs. The UE is configured to determine a priority, with respect to the target UE, for each resource element group based on the resource usage map and an anticipated signal-to-interference ratio (SIR). The UE is configured to transmit data to the target UE during one or more resource element groups with the highest priorities for the target UE.

title_en: Distribution-area integrated-reading-system dynamic ad hoc network method based on wireless sensor network technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution-area integrated-reading-system dynamic ad hoc network method based on a wireless sensor network technology, and compared with the prior art, the disadvantage that a conventional wireless-sensor-network ad hoc network method is not applicable to large-scale network is solved. The method comprises preprocessing regard information, powering on wireless sensor nodes, setting an information-sending time interval T according to network situation, and establishing self regard information of each wireless sensor node; performing update processing on the regard information, sending the regard information by each wireless sensor node, and updating the regard information of the node by a neighbor node according to received regard information; establishing a communication network according to the updated regard information; and performing optimization selection on a network path, utilizing the received regard information to judge the data transmission priority of a friendly node, and selecting an optimum path from multiple pieces of routing information to send data. The method only needs to update the friendly node routing information of each wireless sensor node, so that the hold-up time of a same regional channel is reduced.

title_en: Prioritized synchronization signals and mechanism for distributed device-to-device systems
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein relate generally to a user equipment ("UE") that is to transmit and receive signals associated with synchronization. The UE may be receive signals associated with synchronization from a plurality of synchronization sources, such as an evolved Node B ("eNB"), a global navigation satellite system ("GNSS"), or another UE. The UE may synchronize to a signal received from a synchronization source based on a priority associated with that synchronization source and/or signal. However, if the UE does not receive any signals associated with synchronization, the UE may generate and transmit a signal that indicates a request for synchronization.

title_en: Early warning method and system for landslide and rock fail using wireless mesh network and location tracking
title_ko: 무선 메쉬 네트워크와 위치추적을 이용한 산사태 및 낙석 조기 경보 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an early warning method and system for landslide and rock fail using a wireless mesh network and location tracking. The early warning method and system for landslide and rock fail using a wireless mesh network and location tracking according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a first step of performing location analysis by using a real time location system access point (RAP) for location tracking according to a predetermined period; a second step of detecting the location displacement of each tag; and a third step of checking the location of landslide and rock fail through the location of the detected tag. More particularly, in an aspect of the present invention, the early warning method and system for landslide and rock fail using a wireless mesh network and location tracking can include other embodiments.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 메쉬 네트워크와 위치추적을 이용한 산사태 및 낙석 조기 경보 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 제 1 측면은, 위치추적용 억세스포인트(RAP)가 무선 메쉬 네트워크를 통해 선형 부재(Lm)로 연결된 제 1 태그 내지 제 n 태그(n은 2 이상의 자연수)의 위치 분석을 미리 설정된 주기 마다 수행하는 제 1 단계; 상기 위치추적용 억세스포인트가 산사태 또는 낙석에 의한 각 태그의 위치 변위 감지를 수행하는 제 2 단계; 및 적어도 하나 이상의 태그에 대한 위치 변위가 감지되는 경우, 상기 위치추적용 억세스포인트가 위치 변화가 감지된 태그의 위치를 통해 낙석 및 산사태 위치 파악을 수행하는 제 3 단계; 를 포함하는 무선 메쉬 네트워크와 위치추적을 이용한 산사태 및 낙석 조기 경보 방법을 제공한다.  
본 발명의 제 2 측면은 무선 메쉬 네트워크를 통해 선형 부재(Lm)로 연결되며 각각이 충전 배터리로 동작하는 제 1 태그 내지 제 n 태그(n은 2 이상의 자연수); 및 상기 각 태그의 위치 분석을 미리 설정된 주기 마다 수행한 뒤, 산사태 또는 낙석에 의한 각 태그의 위치 변위가 감지되면, 위치 변화가 감지된 태그의 위치를 통해 낙석 및 산사태 위치 파악을 수행하는 위치추적용 억세스포인트(Real time location system Access Point:RAP); 를 포함하는 무선 메쉬 네트워크와 위치추적을 이용한 산사태 및 낙석 조기 경보 시스템을 제공한다.  
이에 의해, 낮은 단가로 형성가능한 태그와 위치추적용 억세스포인트(RAP) 간의 통신과 선형 부재(Lm)를 활용해 태그의 위치 정보 획득하여 낙석 및 산사태의 위치 파악이 신속하게 가능한 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Cellphone ad-Hoc network location information collecting method for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a cellphone ad-Hoc network location information collecting method for emergency rescue. By taking the advantages of non-mobility and low energy consumption of cellphones of people to be rescued and combining hierarchical network routing and left power of the cellphones, location information of the cellphones of the rescued people is collected into ad-Hoc network cellphones by the aid of the ad-Hoc network. Message formats are simplified, and times of message transmission of the cellphones in the network is controlled, so that average routing hops and total whole-network message transmission energy consumption are low, message transmission load of low-power cellphones is alleviated, and arrival success rate of messages is increased. Compared with a conventional routing algorithm, the cellphone ad-Hoc network location information collecting method has the advantages that routing maintenance energy consumption and average hops are remarkably improved; destination addresses are selected according to the routing hops and partition priority of power, energy consumption load during message transfer of the low-power cellphones is decreased, and message collection success rate is increased.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a frame structure of a MAC protocol in a multi-hop vessel communications network supporting vessel-to-vessel ad hoc communications. The frame structure is equipped with: real-time reservation slots that are assigned to be used for performing real-time ad hoc communications; and non-real-time reservation slots that are assigned to be used for performing non-real-time ad hoc communications. A frame is made up of multiple subframes, and the subframe is made up of real-time reservation slots and non-real-time reservations slots. The present invention provides a frame structure that assigns resource priority to a real-time usage node in order to reduce end-to-end delay time and achieve a desired transmission rate, thereby improving service quality of the real-time usage node. In addition, the present invention allocates resources adaptively by reflecting the distribution of real-time and non-real-time usage nodes, thereby providing an efficient integrated service.

title_en: Method for calculating bandwidth and distributing bandwidth in wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the bandwidth and distributing the bandwidth in a wireless ad hoc network. The method includes the TDMA-based bandwidth calculation method in the wireless ad hoc network and the bandwidth distribution scheme based on the service priority, wherein the TDMA-based bandwidth calculation method in the wireless ad hoc network includes the bandwidth calculation method under the condition of not considering a hidden terminal and the bandwidth calculation method under the condition of considering the hidden terminal. The available bandwidth information between any two nodes is obtained, and a source node can select the routing, meeting the bandwidth requirement, to the target node and can be used for deciding whether to allow new connection to be accepted or not. According to the self-adaption bandwidth distribution mechanism based on the service priority, the emergency degrees of service requirements of different services are taken into consideration, application is flexible, implementation is easy, and the method is feasible.

title_en: Method and apparatus for selecting proximity service group in wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for selecting a device-to-device (D2D) group in a wireless communication system is provided. A User Equipment (UE) detects at least two D2D groups and, if the UE does not have the capability to support at least two D2D groups, the UE selects one D2D group of the at least two D2D groups based on at least one of measurement results from the at least two D2D groups or a group priority of each of the at least two D2D groups.

title_en: Uniform UE initialization procedure for both in-coverage and out-of-coverage D2D communications
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and computer program products for providing uniform user equipment initialization procedure for both in-coverage and out-of-coverage device-to device communications are disclosed herein, incorporating a novel tri-timer design: an initial timer, a search timer, and an active timer. In a method a determination is made regarding a user equipment as being a clusterhead candidate which can act as a clusterhead of a cluster. The user equipment searches for a suitable cell or cluster to join. If a suitable cell or a cluster is not found, the user equipment is selected to be a clusterhead which will act as the clusterhead of its own cluster. After selecting the user equipment to be a clusterhead and establishing its cluster, the user equipment transmits a discovery signal which alerting other user equipment to the clusterhead, to which the other user equipment can join. The user equipment as clusterhead then maintains the cluster.

title_en: Method and apparatus for implementing a device-to-device (d2d) service in a wireless communication system
abstract_en:
A method and apparatus of for implementing a D2D service are disclosed. The method includes the UE receiving an indication to prohibit a transmission of a RRC (Radio Resource Control) connection request message for requesting a D2D dedicated resource for transmission. The method further includes the UE deciding whether to prohibit the transmission of the RRC connection request message at least based on the indication. 
     The indication to barr RRC connection requests may differentiate on requests to transmit mobile originated signaling, delay tolerant access and may be included in a system information. The indication may be sent to the UE from the network (preferrably from an eNB) in order to prevent the repeated attempts from the UE to get dedicated resources when the cell is congested. In this way the signalling overhead and UE power consumption is reduced, and moreover, access with high priority can be served properly. In case of barring of requesting dedicated resources, the UE may use D2D contention-based resources. Furthermore, the UE may ignore the prohibition if the transmission is for the purpose of public safety.

title_en: Method and apparatus for handling a missed group call in a public safety communication session
abstract_en: A communication system is provided that alerts a public safety officer to missed Push-to-Talk (PTT) group calls. The communication system allows a public safety officer's radio to record a last stop working time. A public safety network then can search a missed call list associated with the public safety officer and automatically push a notification of missed PTT group calls to the public safety officer's radio when the radio re-joins the public safety network. Based on the notification, the public safety officer can choose to review or replay any missed calls to avoid missing important information.

title_en: Collaborative scheduling of last hop cellular traffic
abstract_en: An eNodeB or other cell access point device can receive demand data from mobile devices served by the cell. The demand data can represent an estimate of demand over a future period for network resources (e.g., bandwidth). The cell can aggregate this demand data and determine price data for the time period or for various intervals of the time period, then transmit the price data to the mobile devices. The price data can operate as a collaborative approach to scheduling traffic. For example, data (e.g., delay tolerant data) can be shifted (e.g., delayed for a few seconds) based on an examination of the price data in conjunction a determined priority of the data. Such can be applicable to data traffic not traditionally thought of as delay tolerant such as streaming video or web browsing, and can be accomplished without negatively impacting the quality of service or experience of the client.

title_en: Device and Method of Handling Device-to-Device communication
abstract_en: A communication device for handling a device-to-device (D2D) communication comprises a storage unit for storing instructions and a processing means coupled to the storage unit. The processing means is configured to execute the instructions stored in the storage unit. The instructions comprises determining whether to transmit a Cell Radio Network Temporary Identifier (C-RNTI) or data of an uplink common control channel (UL-CCCH) to a network according to a priority of the C-RNTI or the data of the UL-CCCH; determining whether to transmit a device-to-network (D2N) buffer status report (BSR) to the network according to a priority of the D2N BSR; determining whether to transmit a D2N power headroom report (PHR) to the network according to a priority of the D2N PHR; and determining whether to transmit a D2D BSR to the network according to a priority of the D2D BSR.

title_en: Method and system of distributed sensing for reducing spectrum sensing overhead in cognitive radio adhoc networks
title_ko: 인지 무선 애드훅 네트워크에서의 주파수 검출 부하 감소를 위한 분산 센싱 방법 및 시스템
