title_en: Method and apparatus for device-to-device terminal for transceiving signal in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 장치 대 장치 단말의 신호 송수신 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An embodiment according to the present invention, with respect to a method for a device-to-device (D2D) terminal for transceiving a signal, comprises the steps of: receiving a D2D discovery resource structure; and determining a time resource for transmitting a D2D discovery signal on the basis of the D2D discovery resource structure, wherein if the time resource for transmitting a D2D discovery signal overlaps with the time resource for transmitting an uplink or the time resource for transmitting D2D communication, then the signal to be transmitted from the time resource is determined in the order of priority of a) an uplink signal, b) a D2D communication signal, and c) a D2D discovery signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 무선통신시스템에서 D2D(Device-to-Device) 단말이 신호를 송수신하는 방법에 있어서, D2D 디스커버리 자원 구성을 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 D2D 디스커버리 자원 구성에 기초하여 D2D 디스커버리 신호를 전송할 시간 자원을 결정하는 단계를 포함하며, 상기 D2D 디스커버리 신호를 전송할 시간 자원이 상향링크 전송을 위한 시간 자원 또는 D2D 커뮤니케이션 전송을 위한 시간 자원과 오버랩되는 경우, 상기 시간 자원에서 전송될 신호는, a) 상향링크 신호 b) D2D 커뮤니케이션 신호 c) D2D 디스커버리 신호의 우선순위로써 결정되는, 신호 송수신 방법이다.

title_en: Method for alleviating synchronization conflict of control channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for alleviating a synchronization conflict of a control channel. The method is applied to vehicular ad-hoc network multi-channel transmission to alleviate the synchronization conflict of the control channel. A variety of messages transmitted on the control channel are divided according to the priority; and a transmission mechanism of the control channel is clarified and improved to ensure that a safe message is transmitted with priority and to reduce the collision and message packet loss in the message transmission process, thereby effectively alleviating the synchronization conflict. When the node density in the network is too high, the synchronization conflict problem becomes more serious; therefore, the invention further provides an adaptive channel load distribution algorithm; the node can determine whether to transmit messages immediately via the algorithm according to the current channel load status; the more serious the channel congestion is, the less the number of the nodes having the transmission chance is; the collision and the conflict between the messages can be relatively alleviated. The performance of the method in aspects of the acceptance rate and the average transmission delay of the messages are improved.

title_en: Terminal apparatus, base station apparatus, communication system, notification method, and integrated circuit
abstract_en: A terminal apparatus according to one aspect of the present invention constitutes and reports an amount-of-transmission-buffer report to be notified to a base station apparatus, based on first transmission data to the base station apparatus, which is prepared in a transmission buffer of the terminal apparatus itself, second transmission data for device-to-device data communication, and a priority level of each piece of transmission data.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining priorities of buffer status reports in wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for determining priorities of buffer status reports (BSRs) in a wireless communication system is provided. A user equipment (UE) generates a BSR for uplink transmission to a network and a proximity-based services (ProSe) BSR for device-to-device (D2D) transmission between UEs, and prioritizes the BSR for uplink transmission over the ProSe BSR.

title_en: System and method for control plane of D2D communication
abstract_en: To provide a system and method for controlling and managing device-to-device (D2D) communication in a network.SOLUTION: A method for user equipment (UE) which executes device-to-device (D2D) communication includes: a step for generating a D2D buffer situation report (BSR) of a D2D communication link between the UE and second UE for providing information on amounts of D2D data which can be used for transmission, therein the D2D BSR includes a D2D BSR logical channel identifier (LCID); a step for transmitting the D2D BSR by a control element; a step for receiving resource allocation of the D2D link; and a step for transmitting the D2D data on the allocated resource.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13B

title_en: Utility-based cross layering
title_ko: 유틸리티-기반 크로스 레이어링
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system that facilitates a large-scaled mobile ad hoc network to adapt to specific needs of wireless nodes in a mobile wireless network.SOLUTION: An intermediate node 114 receives one or more packets that indicate microutility and relevance, where the microutility is based on a utility function specific to an application, and where the relevance indicates a priority of the one or more packets. The intermediate mobile node 114 combines the relevance of the one or more packets. The intermediate mobile node aggregates the microutility and the relevance for the one or more packets and determines the value of the one or more packets based on the aggregation of the microutility and the relevance. The intermediate mobile node also determines an action to the one or more packets based on the determined value of a respective packet.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1B
abstract_ko: 한 실시예는 대규모 이동 애드혹 네트워크가 이동 무선 네트워크에서의 무선 노드들의 특별한 요구에 용이하게 적응하도록 하는 시스템을 제공한다. 동작 동안, 중간 노드는 마이크로 유틸리티(microutility) 및 렐러번스(relevance)을 나타내는 1개 이상의 패킷들을 수신하며, 상기 마이크로 유틸리티는 어플리케이션에 특정한 유틸리티 기능에 근거하고, 상기 렐러번스는 상기 1개 이상의 패킷들의 우선순위를 나타낸다. 상기 중간 노드는 상기 1개 이상의 패킷들의 렐러번스를 결합한다. 상기 중간 노드는 상기 1개 이상의 패킷들에 대한 상기 마이크로 유틸리티 및 상기 렐러번스를 종합하며, 상기 마이크로 유틸리티 및 상기 렐러번스의 종합에 근거하여 상기 1개 이상의 패킷들의 값을 결정한다. 상기 중간 노드는 또한 각각의 패킷의 결정된 값에 근거하여 상기 1개 이상의 패킷들에 대한 조치를 결정한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmitting buffer status report in wireless communication system supporting device to device communication
title_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 버퍼상태보고 전송 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for transmitting a buffer status report in a wireless communications system supporting device to device communications. A method for transmitting a buffer status report in a wireless communications system supporting device to device communications includes a step of performing the triggering of a buffer status report when at least two logical channel groups (LCG) having data to be transmitted exist and at least one LCG has data to be transmitted to the D2D communications of the LCG, a step of producing a truncated buffer status report based on the number of LCG and the amount of uplink resource allocated from and the base station, and a step of transmitting the truncated buffer status report with the format of a media access control (MAC) control factor to the base station. The truncated buffer status report may include the identification information (LCG ID) of the LCG including a logical channel having the highest priority among the logical channels having data to be transmitted to the uplink, and buffer size information corresponding to the LCG including a logical channel having the highest priority.
abstract_ko: 단말간 통신(D2D: Device to Device)을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 버퍼상태보고 전송 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.  단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말에 의한 버퍼상태보고 전송 방법은 전송할 데이터를 가지는 논리 채널 그룹(LCG: Logical Channel Group)이 둘 이상 존재하고 상기 LCG 중 적어도 하나의 LCG가 상기 D2D 통신으로 전송할 데이터를 가지는 경우 버퍼상태보고(Buffer Status Report)의 트리거링을 수행하는 단계, 상기 LCG의 개수와 기지국으로부터 할당받은 상향링크 자원량을 기초로 절단된(truncated) 버퍼상태보고를 생성하는 단계 및 상기 절단된 버퍼상태보고를 MAC(Media Access Control) 제어요소의 포맷으로 상기 기지국에 전송하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 절단된 버퍼상태보고는 상향링크로 전송할 데이터를 가지는 논리 채널 중 가장 높은 우선 순위를 가지는 논리 채널을 포함하는 LCG의 식별 정보(LCG ID) 및 상기 가장 높은 우선 순위를 가지는 논리 채널을 포함하는 LCG에 해당하는 버퍼 크기 정보를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent household wireless ad-hoc network communication system, networking method and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent household wireless ad-hoc network communication system. The intelligent household wireless ad-hoc networking communication system comprises a host connected with intelligent equipment and a plurality of slave computers connected with household electrical appliances, wherein the host comprises a host interface, a host control module and a host data transmission module, and each slave computer comprises a slave computer control module, a slave computer route module, a slave data transmission module and a slave computer interface. The invention further discloses an intelligent household wireless ad-hoc network networking method. The host is adopted for actively connecting the slave computers into a network, the slave computers actively apply for networking, and the slave computers are networked according to a priority selection mode. The invention also discloses a working method of networked slave computers in an intelligent household wireless ad-hoc network. After the slave computers are networked, the slave computers perform corresponding operation according to host commands for themselves and can also serve as routers for forwarding data from the host or other slave computers. According to the invention, the networking operation is simple, the equipment can be automatically connected to a local area network once the equipment is powered on, and the problem that equipment of different brands fails to communicate normally due to incompatibility is solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN QINQI ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Devices and methods for d2d transmission
abstract_en: A method performed by a first device, for sending data in a Device-to-Device, D2D, transmission to a second device is provided. After the first device has identified (301) a priority level of the D2D transmission, it maps (302) the identified priority level to a resource pool index. The resource pool index identifies a resource pool among a plurality of resource pools associated with different priority levels. The first device then sends (303) the data in the D2D transmission to the second device, using the resources in the resource pool identified by the resource pool index.
assignees: ERICSSON TELEFON AB L M;ERICSSON TELEFON AB L M (publ)

title_en: Dynamic router functionality in cellular networks
abstract_en: A wireless remote communication unit is described. The wireless remote communication unit comprises: at least one transceiver configured to communicate with a cellular network node using either a first technology employed with mesh connectivity via at least one other wireless remote communication unit or a second technology employed with a direct connection to the cellular network node; and a processor coupled to the at least one transceiver and configured to select internet connectivity using either: a first internet protocol, IP, address associated with mesh functionality to route low priority, high delay tolerant data via an edge router and the cellular network node; or a second IP address associated with direct connection to the cellular network node for high priority, low delay tolerant data.

title_en: Methods and systems for admission control in d2d communication in a wireless broadband network
abstract_en: This disclosure relates generally to wireless communication systems, and more particularly to methods and systems for admission control in D2D communication in a wireless broadband network. In one embodiment, a method is disclosed for admission control in device-to-device communication in a wireless broadband network. The method may comprise receiving, via the hardware processor, proximity-based device-to-device discovery requests; and classifying, via the hardware processor, the received proximity-based device-to-device discovery requests into bins. The method may further include determining, via the hardware processor, priority levels for the bins; and selecting, via the hardware processor, one of the bins as having a highest priority level. The method may also include identifying in a first-in-first-out manner, via the hardware processor, one of the proximity-based device-to-device discovery requests classified into the selected bin; and generating and providing, via the hardware processor, a proximity-based device-to-device discovery response to the identified proximity-based device-to-device discovery request.

title_en: Mesh network addressing
abstract_en: In embodiments of mesh network addressing, a router device receives provisioning domains that include an address prefix and an associated preference value for the address prefix. The router determines a route, based on one of the address prefixes, to use to forward a data packet to a destination. The router uses the preference values to prioritize the routing of the data packet. In other aspects, the preference values can be set based on one or more factors, and the router can use the preference values in addition to mesh network routing costs to determine a route for a data packet.

title_en: Device-to-device (d2d) data transmission method of user equipment in wireless communication system and user equipment using same method
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말의 d2d(device-to-device) 데이터 전송 방법 및 상기 방법을 이용하는 단말
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device-to-device (D2D) data transmission method of a user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system and a UE using the method. The method comprises: receiving multiple resource pools and a resource pool configuration for configuring priority order information on each resource pool; and selecting a particular resource pool to transmit D2D data among the multiple resource pools on the basis of the priority order information on each resource pool, wherein the priority order information on each resource pool indicates the priority order of D2D data capable of using each of the multiple resource pools.
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말(user equipment: UE)의 D2D(device-to-device) 데이터 전송 방법 및 상기 방법을 이용하는 단말을 제공한다. 상기 방법은 복수의 자원 풀들 및 각 자원 풀에 대한 우선 순위 정보를 설정하는 자원 풀 설정을 수신하고, 상기 복수의 자원 풀들 중에서 D2D 데이터를 전송할 특정 자원 풀을 상기 각 자원 풀에 대한 우선 순위 정보에 기반하여 선택하되, 상기 각 자원 풀에 대한 우선 순위 정보는 상기 복수의 자원 풀들 각각을 사용할 수 있는 D2D 데이터의 우선 순위를 지시하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for intuitive packet buffering and adaptive paging
abstract_en: The solution introduces a flexible mechanism to avoid paging a delay-tolerant UE prematurely by buffering its high frequency, low priority data for a time duration set according to the UE's current and historic activity data, thereby increasing radio resource and network efficiency, and reducing UE batter drainage. A method of managing frequent low priority downlink data transmissions comprises receiving a downlink data packet intended for a UE, buffering the received downlink data packet in response to a determination that the received downlink data packet is low priority, and the UE is delay-tolerant, starting a timer, the timer being set in response in response to the UE currently being in an idle state, the timer being set according to a next anticipated activity time for the UE, and transmitting the downlink data packet to the UE upon the expiration of the timer.

title_en: Apparatus and method for distributed processing of train monitoring traffic based on hierarchical wireless sensor network
abstract_en: Provided is an apparatus for distributed processing of train monitoring traffic based on a hierarchical wireless sensor network, the apparatus including: a wireless sensor node configured to generate sensor data by measuring states of a train; a wireless mesh network (WSN) manager configured to classify the sensor data into priority data and non-priority data according to change characteristics, and to transmit the priority data to a sensor monitoring center through a wireless communication network and the non-priority data to wireless mesh nodes through a wireless mesh network; and one or more wireless mesh nodes configured to be spaced apart at predetermined intervals on a railway side, and to transmit the non-priority data, received from the WSN manager, to the sensor monitoring center.

title_en: Apparatus and method for distributed processing of train monitoring traffic based hierarchical wireless sensor network
title_ko: 계층적 무선센서망 구축을 통한 열차 감시 트래픽 분산처리 장치 및 분산처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for distributed processing of train monitoring traffic based on a hierarchical wireless sensor network, which can prevent a traffic bottleneck of sensor data which is generated in real time in a wireless sensor network over which operation state information of a train is transmitted in real time to ensure safe train operation. The apparatus for distributed processing of train monitoring traffic based on construction of a hierarchical wireless sensor network comprises: a wireless sensor node which generates sensor data by periodically measuring state information of a train; a wireless mesh network (WSN) management unit which classifies the sensor data as priority data or non-priority data by assigning the sensor data to a priority according to change characteristics, transmits the priority data to a sensor monitoring center via wireless communication, and transmits the non-priority data to a wireless mesh node via a wireless mesh network; and one or more wireless mesh nodes which are spaced apart at predetermined intervals on a railway side and transmit the non-priority data, received from the WSN management unit, to the sensor monitoring center.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 열차의 센싱 트래픽 분산처리를 위한 계층적 무선센서 망 구성장치는 열차의 상태 정보를 주기적으로 측정하여 센서 데이터를 생성하는 무선센서 노드, 센서 데이터를 변화특성에 따라 우선순위를 배정하여 우선순위 데이터 및 비우선 데이터로 구분하며, 우선순위 데이터를 무선통신을 통해 센서 감시센터로 전달하고, 비우선 데이터를 무선 메시 네트워크(Wireless Mesh Network)를 통해 무선 메시 노드로 전달하는 WSN 관리부 및 철로 주변에 소정의 간격을 이격하여 위치하며, WSN 관리부로부터 수신된 비우선 데이터를 센서 감시센터로 전달하는 하나 이상의 무선 메시 노드를 포함한다.

title_en: Selection method of remote real-time psychological and physiological information collection data transmission channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selection method of a remote real-time psychological and physiological information collection data transmission channel. The method comprises the following steps that 1, physiological and psychological characteristic data of affected people or rescuers is collected through a collecting terminal; 2, the collecting terminal automatically searches for an available wireless network in the environment; 3, according to different situations, the data transmission channel is selected on the basis of a priority strategy and a time delay strategy respectively; 4, by means of a cellular network and/or a self-organized Bluetooth mesh network, the physiological and psychological characteristic data of the affected people or the rescuers is transmitted to monitoring centers of the rear areas of rescue places. The selection method of the remote real-time psychological and physiological information collection data transmission channel has the advantages that best match for transmitting health condition data of the rescuers to the monitoring centers at different distances under different rescue scenes can be achieved.

title_en: Method and device for transmission-priority control
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a floor control method and apparatus, so as to resolve a prior-art problem: a control plane and a media plane of a POC service are not separated, and this causes difficulty in subsequent technology evolution and is not conducive to either flexible implementation of services or system extension; and there is no detailed floor control procedure after the control plane and the media plane are separated. The method includes: receiving, by a mission-critical push-to-talk MCPTT server over Long Term Evolution network, a first message that is sent by user equipment UE, where the first message includes an identifier of a group to which a talker corresponding to the UE belongs and a parameter indicating that an event type is a floor request; generating, by the MCPTT server, a second message according to the floor control policy and the first message, where the second message includes the identifier of the group to which the talker corresponding to the UE belongs and the parameter indicating that an event type is a floor request, and the second message is used to instruct the UE to notify the talker to whom the UE belongs that a floor is granted; sending, by the MCPTT server, the second message to the UE; receiving, by the MCPTT server, a response message that is of the second message and that is sent by the UE; generating, by the MCPTT server, a first instruction message according to the response message of the second message, where the first instruction message is used to instruct a media resource function entity to perform uplink voice switching on a media plane; and sending, by the MCPTT server, the first instruction message to the media resource function entity.

title_en: System and methods for a mesh network utilizing smart antennas
abstract_en: A data transmission system, comprising a first node in a wireless communications network, the node comprising a radio frequency communications system having high resistance to interference. The radio frequency communications system is configured to measure an interference potential of a second node in the wireless communications network and arrange a priority and timing structure that maximizes reuse of available frequencies. The radio frequency communications system is also configured to encode and decode data and network control signals using a multi-level frequency shift keying modulation scheme. The node also comprising a directional and steerable antenna system, wherein the directional and steerable antenna system is capable of forming a radio frequency transmission into a beam directed to a desired target and transmitting a radiating omni-directional radio frequency transmission.

title_en: Personal alert safety system for calling emergency situation and method thereof
title_ko: 응급 상황 호출을 위한 개인 경보 안전 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a motion sensor to detect movements of a user; a motion determination module to determine whether the movements of the user are not detected above a predetermined time by the motion sensor or not; an alarm signal output module to produce and output an alarm signal if it determines that the movements of the user are not detected above the predetermined time by the motion determination module; an emergency signal production module to produce an emergency signal including an ID of the user and the elapse time after the expiration of the predetermined time in real time if it determines that the movements of the user are not detected above the predetermined time by the motion determination module; and a local area communication module to periodically transmit the emergency signal produced in the emergency signal production module with a local area communication method and to receive a surrounding emergency signal with the local area communication method. According to a personal alert safety system for calling an emergency situation and a method thereof as stated above, a risk signal is mutually shared by firefighters in real time and the firefighters can recognize a risk of a surrounding co-worker and rapidly rescues the co-worker since a mesh topology or an ad-hoc network are formed between personal alert safety systems attached to a body of the firefighters.
abstract_ko: 사용자의 움직임을 감지하는 모션 센서; 상기 모션 센서에 의해 소정 시간 이상 사용자의 움직임이 감지되지 않는지 판단하는 모션 판단 모듈; 상기 모션 판단 모듈에 의해 상기 소정 시간 이상 상기 사용자의 움직임이 감지되지 않는 것으로 판단되는 경우, 알람 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 알람 신호 출력 모듈; 상기 모션 판단 모듈에 의해 상기 소정 시간 이상 상기 사용자의 움직임이 감지되지 않는 것으로 판단되는 경우, 상기 사용자의 ID, 상기 소정 시간의 만료 이후의 경과 시간을 포함하는 응급 신호를 실시간으로 생성하는 응급 신호 생성 모듈; 상기 응급 신호 생성 모듈에서 생성된 응급 신호를 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 주기적으로 송신하고, 주변의 응급 신호를 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 수신하는 근거리 통신 모듈을 구성한다.  상술한 응급 상황 호출을 위한 개인 경보 안전 시스템 및 그 방법에 의하면, 소방관들이 몸에 부착하는 개인 경보 안전 시스템들 간에 메시 토폴로지 내지는 애드-혹 네트워크를 형성하도록 구성됨으로써, 그 위험 신호를 상호간에 실시간 공유하여 현장의 소방관들이 주변 동료의 위험을 인지하고 신속하게 구조를 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for operating truncated buffer state report in wireless communication system supporting device to device communication
title_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 절단된 버퍼상태보고 운용 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provides are a method and an apparatus for managing a truncated buffer state report in a wireless communication system supporting device to device (D2D) communication. In a wireless communication system supporting D2D communication, a managing method of a buffer state report (BSR) by a terminal comprises the steps of: receiving information on an uplink resource allocation from a base station; configuring a truncated BSR containing buffer state information on at least one of the group according to a priority per group of objects to which D2D data is to be transmitted; and transmitting the truncated BSR to the base station.
abstract_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 절단된 버퍼상태보고 운용 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 단말간(D2D: Device to Device) 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말에 의한 버퍼상태보고(BSR: Buffer State Report) 운용 방법은 기지국으로부터 상향링크 자원 할당 정보를 수신하는 단계, D2D 데이터를 전송할 대상의 그룹별 우선순위에 따라 적어도 하나의 그룹에 대한 버퍼 상태 정보를 포함하는 절단된(truncated) BSR을 구성하는 단계 및 상기 절단된 BSR을 상기 기지국으로 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY LAB CO LTD;ITL INC

title_en: Routing based on length of time of available connection
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method of routing packets at a first node in an ad-hoc network is provided. The method includes receiving, at the first node, a plurality of route-alive messages corresponding to a destination, each of the plurality of route-alive messages including a route time indicating a length of time in which a communicative connection is available between the second node that sent the respective route-alive message and the destination. The method also includes determining an updated route time for each second node. The updated route time corresponds to a length of time in which a communication connection is available between the first node and the destination through the respective second node. A second node is selected for sending a packet to based on the updated route time for each of the second nodes, wherein a node having a longer updated route time is given higher priority for selection.

title_en: Mobile wireless communication unit, integrated circuit and method for routing content
abstract_en: A mobile wireless communication unit comprising: at least one short-range wireless circuit and configured to receive content in a bundle format over a delay tolerant network, using a short range wireless communication technology,-wherein the content relates to at least one of multiple quality of service priority levels; a processor operably coupled to the at least one short-range wireless circuit and configured to determine a priority level of the bundle formatted content. In response to the determined priority level, the processor is configured to: transmit at least the bundle formatted content direct to a network server over a cellular network if the determined priority level of the bundle formatted content is high; or store the bundled content in memory coupled to the processor if the determined priority level of the bundle formatted content is low and transmit at least the bundle formatted content to at least one of: another mobile wireless communication unit or a dedicated delay tolerant network gateway node, when discovered using a short range wireless communication technology.

title_en: Wireless ad-hoc network flooding mechanism to intelligently locate required responders
abstract_en: A process for locating required responders in a wireless ad-hoc network of mobile computing devices (MCDs) starts with wirelessly receiving, at a second MCD directly from a first MCD, a message indicating a requested type of responder needed and a location at which the responder is needed. The second MCD then compares the requested type of responder needed to a locally stored type of responder associated with a current user. If a match is found, the second MCD alerts the current user provides a response mechanism. The second MCD then makes a forwarding determination of whether or not the message should be forwarded directly to one or more other mobile computing devices. The second MCD one of further directly wirelessly transmits and refrains from further transmitting the message to the one or more other mobile computing devices as a function of the forwarding determination.
assignees: GAZDZIAK MATEUSZ;JEDRZEJEWSKI PAWEL ARKADIUSZ;MOTOROLA SOLUTIONS INC;TRZUPEK DOMINIK

title_en: Method and apparatus for processing priority in d2d communication system
title_ko: Ｄ２ｄ 통신 시스템에서 우선 순위를 처리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for processing a priority for transmission by a user equipment (UE) in a device-to-device (D2D) communication system are provided. The method includes receiving a priority for a packet to be transmitted from a higher layer, mapping the packet to a logical channel based on the priority and a destination to which the packet is to be transmitted, receiving a grant for the transmission of the packet from a base station, and transmitting the packet.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 LTE와 같은 4G 통신 시스템 이후 보다 높은 데이터 전송률을 지원하기 위한 5G 또는 pre-5G 통신 시스템에 관련된 것으로서, 특히 D2D 통신 시스템에서 전송을 위한 우선 순위를 효율적으로 처리하는 방법 및 장치에 대한 것이다. 본 개시의 방법은, 상위 계층으로부터 전송될 패킷에 대한 우선 순위를 수신하는 과정과, 상기 패킷이 전송될 목적지와 상기 우선 순위를 근거로, 상기 패킷을 논리 채널에 매핑하는 과정과, 기지국으로부터 상기 패킷의 전송을 위한 그랜트를 수신하고, 상기 패킷을 전송하는 과정을 포함한다.

title_en: Method carried out by terminal for determining transmission priority in wireless communication system and terminal utilizing the method
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말에 의해 수행되는 전송 우선 순위 결정 방법 및 상기 방법을 이용하는 단말
abstract_en: Provided is a method for a device-to-device (D2D) action carried out by a terminal in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps of: determining priorities for a first D2D action and a second D2D action; on the basis of the determined priorities, determining the D2D action to be carried out from among the first D2D action and second D2D action; and on the basis of the determined D2D action to be carried out, carrying out any one D2D action from among the first D2D action and second D2D action.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말에 의해 수행되는 D2D(device-to-device) 동작 방법에 있어서, 제1 D2D 동작 및 제2 D2D 동작에 대한 우선 순위를 결정하는 단계, 결정된 상기 우선 순위에 기반하여, 상기 제1 D2D 동작 및 상기 제2 D2D 동작 중 수행할 D2D 동작을 결정하는 단계 및 상기 수행할 D2D 동작의 결정에 기반하여, 상기 제1 D2D 동작 또는 상기 제2 D2D 동작 중 어느 하나의 D2D 동작을 수행하는 단계를 포함하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting/receiving data in wireless communication system that supports device-to-device communication
title_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 데이터를 송수신하기 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a device for transmitting data by a first device in a wireless communication system that supports direct device-to-device communication, wherein one or more messages are received from multiple devices, at least one message among the one or more messages is transmitted to a second device on the basis of priority, and the priority is determined in such an order that a message having the lowest first received signal strength has the highest priority, the first received signal strength indicating the received signal strength of the one or more messages.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 단말 간 직접 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서, 제 1 디바이스가 데이터를 전송하기 위한 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로써, 다수의 디바이스들로부터 하나 또는 그 이상의 메시지를 수신하고, 상기 하나 또는 그 이상의 메시지 중에서 우선 순위를 기초로 적어도 하나의 메시지를 제 2 디바이스로 전송하되, 상기 우선 순위는 상기 하나 또는 그 이상의 메시지의 수신 신호 세기를 나타내는 제 1 수신 신호세기가 낮은 순서로 결정되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling relay traffic in wireless communication system supporting D2D communication
title_ko: D2d 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 중계 트래픽 제어 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or pre-5G communication system for supporting a higher data rate beyond a 4G communication system such as LTE. A method for controlling relay traffic by a base station in a wireless communication system supporting device to device (D2D) communication according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises checking whether received traffic is relay traffic; if the received traffic is the relay traffic, identifying a port number in each cluster of the relay traffic; determining the priority of the relay traffic according to the port number; and transmitting, to a relay terminal, a packet based on the determined priority.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 LTE와 같은 4G 통신 시스템 이후 보다 높은 데이터 전송률을 지원하기 위한 5G 또는 pre-5G 통신 시스템에 관련된 것이다. 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 방법은, D2D(device to device communication) 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서의 기지국에서 중계 트래픽 제어 방법에 있어서, 수신된 트래픽이 중계 트래픽인지 여부를 확인하는 과정; 중계 트래픽일 경우, 상기 중계 트래픽의 각 클러스트 내 포트 넘버를 확인하는 과정; 상기 포트 넘버에 따라서 상기 중계 트래픽의 우선순위를 결정하는 과정; 및 상기 결정된 우선순위가 반영된 패킷을 중계 단말로 전송하는 과정을 포함한다.

title_en: Node-characteristic-based clustering method in ad-hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a node-characteristic-based clustering method in an ad-hoc network, comprising steps of dividing default clusters and distributing cluster ID and appointing cluster heads based on cluster identity characteristics and distributing intra-cluster IDs on the basis of node identity characteristics and node priority. Each cluster occupies a public control area to broadcast the cluster information and monitors information of the adjacent cluster; the intra-node of each cluster occupies an intra-cluster control area to broadcast the node information and monitors information of the adjacent node; the node enters an isolation state after leaving the cluster; and the node in the isolation state obtains cluster information around, chooses a target cluster and accesses through monitoring the cluster broadcast or the node broadcast.

title_en: Method for realizing wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for realizing a wireless ad hoc network. The wireless ad hoc network is used for dividing in-cluster and inter-cluster control information to different areas in a wireless frame structure. Furthermore a control area and a data area which are specialized for each broadcast service are divided in the wireless frame structure. The method realizes overall scheduling on different types of services with different priorities through a specific frame structure. Furthermore through reserving a specialized control resource area and a data resource area for the high-priority broadcast service, service priority insurance is realized.

title_en: Clustering method based on node identity characteristic in ad-hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clustering method based on a node identity characteristic in an ad-hoc network. The clustering method comprises steps of dividing default clusters based on node identity characteristics and distributing cluster ID and appointing a cluster head, determining a node priority and a cluster priority based on a node identity characteristic. The node has an only node ID of the whole network and an only intra-cluster ID in the cluster; the intra-cluster ID is distributed by the cluster head where the intra-cluster ID is positioned based on the node identity characteristic and a node priority; each cluster occupies a public control area to broadcast cluster information and monitors adjacent cluster information; the cluster information at least comprises: a cluster ID and the intra-cluster ID of the cluster head; the intra-node of each cluster occupies an intra-cluster control area to broadcast the node information and monitor the adjacent node information; and the node information at least comprises the intra-cluster ID.

title_en: Speaking right preemption method of cluster service in ad-hoc network
abstract_en: The invention provides a speaking right preemption method of a cluster service in an ad-hoc network. The method comprises the following steps of a calling node sends a speaking right preemption message before initiating the cluster service; other nodes receive the speaking right preemption message and forward; and the calling node successfully preempts a speaking right if the calling node does not receive the speaking right preemption messages of other calling nodes in a period of time. By using the method of the invention, a conflict of the cluster service in the ad-hoc network where a center node does not exist can be avoided; during a speaking right preemption process, a proper priority determination mechanism is applied to realize speaking right guarantee of a high priority node under the condition that there is no center scheduling node or realize that several nodes with the same priority acquire a speaking right priority in a time sharing mode.

title_en: Method and apparatus for operating buffer state report in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 버퍼상태보고 운용 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus to operate periodic buffer state report in a wireless communication system that supports device to device (D2D) communication are provided. The method to operate buffer state report by a terminal in a wireless communication system that supports D2D communication comprises: a step of receiving an uplink grant from a base station; a step of controlling a priority of proximity based service (ProSe)-BSR media access control (MAC) control elements if there is no available data to be able to be transmitted through a sidelink; a step of configuring the ProSe-BSR MAC control elements based on the controlled priority; and a step of transmitting the configured ProSe-BSR MAC control elements to the base station.
abstract_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 주기적 버퍼상태보고 운용 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 단말간(D2D: Device to Device) 통신을 지원하는 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말에 의한 버퍼상태보고(BSR: Buffer State Report) 운용 방법은 기지국으로부터 상향링크 그랜트(uplink grant)를 수신하는 단계, 사이드링크(sidelink)를 통해 전송 가능한 데이터가 존재하지 않는 경우, ProSe(Proximity based Service)-BSR MAC(Media Access Control) 제어요소의 우선순위를 조절하는 단계, 상기 조절된 우선순위를 기반으로 상기 ProSe-BSR MAC 제어요소를 구성하는 단계 및 상기 구성한 ProSe-BSR MAC 제어요소를 상기 기지국으로 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: High-density WI-FI covering method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-density WI-FI (Wireless Fidelity) covering method, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises a WI-FI module group, wherein the WI-FI module group comprises a microprocessor and a WI-FI module, and an ad-hoc network wireless communication module is also arranged on the WI-FI module group. The WI-FI module feeds situations of channel bandwidth back to the microprocessor in real time after a WI-FI terminal is connected to the WI-FI module group, the microprocessor allows the WI-FI terminal to be connected to a network directly through the WI-FI module if the channel bandwidth is expedite, and the microprocessor transfers data of the WI-FI terminal to the ad-hoc network wireless communication module if the channel bandwidth is crowded; and the ad-hoc network wireless communication module sorts WI-FI terminals automatically, and allows the WI-FI terminals to sequentially access the network according to priority values. In comparison with the prior art, the method is applicable to a WI-FI high-density scenario, and when a large number of WI-FI terminals need network connection, the ad-hoc network wireless communication module manages the WI-FI terminals to allow the WI-FI terminals to be connected orderly, keep a WI-FI channel to be expedite, and allow a large number of WI-FI terminals to access the network rapidly in batches.
assignees: NINGBO YINZHOU FUCHUANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless communication system
abstract_en: Provided is a wireless communication system having a destination device, a transmission source device for transmitting data to the destination device and supporting device-to-device (D2D) communication, and a plurality of terminal devices supporting D2D communication. The transmission source device transmits a discovery signal to the plurality of terminal devices. Each of the plurality of terminal devices calculates a priority value on the basis of at least one of the received electric power of the discovery signal transmitted from the transmission source device, the received electric power of a reference signal transmitted from the destination device, the remaining battery capacity of the host device, the number of D2D nodes adjacent to the host device, and the interference received from the D2D nodes adjacent to the host device. Each of the plurality of terminal devices transmits the respective priority values to the transmission source device. The transmission source device selects a terminal device for relaying data from among the plurality of terminal devices on the basis of the priority value received from the one or more terminal devices.

title_en: Led illumination system and method for controlling them
title_ko: 엘이디 조명 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light emitting diode (LED) lighting system and a control method thereof, capable of operating an LED lighting system irrespective of position by using a user terminal. According to the present invention, the system comprises multiple LED lamps including: an LED array including one or more LEDs interlocked with input power to emit light; a power management unit controlling supply power to input the supply power to the LED array; a control unit to control the power management unit in response to a user setting signal through a user terminal; an wireless communication module to transmit a received wireless communication signal to the control unit and transmit information received from the control unit through a wireless communication signal. Each wireless communication module of each LED lamp forms a mesh node for forming a wireless mesh network and a bridge mode is activated in one or more mesh nodes among the mesh nodes. The mesh mode in the activated bridge mode transmits a distance from the user terminal and ranking information for connection with the user terminal corresponding to an own traffic in response to a control signal received from the user terminal and compares ranking information received from the surrounding mesh nodes in the activated bridge mode with the own ranking information to generate a rank. The mesh mode in the activated bridge mode excludes itself from the ranking for the connection with the user terminal when the generated ranking is not a priority ranking, and is operated as a bridge node for connecting the user terminal and the wireless mesh network when the generated ranking is the priority ranking.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력 전원에 연동하여 광을 조사하는 하나 이상의 엘이디 소자로 이루어지는 엘이디 어레이, 공급 전원을 제어하여 엘이디 어레이로 입력하는 전원 관리부, 사용자 단말을 통한 사용자 설정 신호에 대응하여 전원 관리부를 제어하는 제어부, 및 수신되는 무선통신 신호를 제어부로 전송하며, 제어부로부터 수신되는 정보를 무선통신 신호로 송출하는 무선통신 모듈을 포함하는 다수의 엘이디 램프로 구성되며, 엘이디 램프들의 각각의 무선통신 모듈은 무선 메시 네트워크를 형성하기 위한 메시 노드를 형성하고, 메시 노드들 중 적어도 하나 이상의 메시 노드는 브리지 모드가 활성화되며, 브리지 모드가 활성화된 메시 노드는, 사용자 단말로부터의 제어 신호에 대응하여 사용자 단말과의 거리 및 자신의 트래픽에 대응하는 사용자 단말과의 접속을 위한 순위 정보를 송출하고, 주변의 브리지 모드가 활성화된 메시 노드로부터 수신되는 순위 정보를 자신의 순위 정보와 비교하여 순위를 생성하며, 생성된 순위가 우선 순위가 아니면 사용자 단말과의 접속을 위한 순위에서 자신을 제외하고, 생성된 순위가 우선 순위이면 사용자 단말과 무선 메시 네트워크의 접속을 위한 브리지 노드로 동작하는 것을 특징으로 하는 엘이디 조명 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Smart home system
abstract_en: A method for managing transmission priority of data transmission from a base node in a mesh network, having a plurality of neighboring nodes, to a destination, is provided. The method includes receiving data at the base node the data including execution data and destination data, the destination data being related to the destination of the execution data; transmitting the data from the base node to each of the neighboring nodes, the transmitting can be carried out by a dedicated transmission mode for each of the neighboring nodes in an order determined in accordance with a transmission rating of each of the neighboring nodes, the transmission rating being related to previous transmissions; receiving at the base node a receipt acknowledgment from a neighboring node which successfully delivered the data to the destination; and adjusting the transmission rating of the neighboring node in accordance with the delivery acknowledgment.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing service in a wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for providing a service in a wireless communication system are disclosed. The method and apparatus are directed to converging a 5th-generation (5G) communication system for supporting higher data rates beyond a 4th-generation (4G) system with a technology for Internet of things (IoT). The apparatus includes a terminal in the wireless communication system. The terminal includes a transceiver configured to transmit and receive a signal, and a processor configured to receive a first service request related to mission critical push to talk over LTE (MCPTT) over long term evolution (LTE), determine whether a first service corresponding to the first service request and a second service request being currently performed are simultaneously provided, and process the first service and the second service based on a priority of each of the service, services if the first service and the second service are not simultaneously provided.

title_en: A kind of adaptive scheduling optimization method based on MIMO heterogeneous ad hoc network
abstract_en: Adaptive scheduling optimization method based on MIMO heterogeneous ad hoc network, by distributed scheduling algorithm respectively in connection with centralized SCMA algorithm and distribution SCMA algorithm, so that distributed scheduling algorithm is not only the priority transmission considered between node during considering link transmission data, channel status, antenna number, the information such as data flow are sent to select different transmission modes, moreover it is contemplated that interference of the link after selecting different transmission modes during transmitting data between link, find the optimal scheme of each link transmission with the race condition difference of other links during transmission according to each link, to be better able to guarantee the reliability of transmitting data stream, improve communication quality.

title_en: Method of managing resources of public safety network
title_ko: 재난 통신망의 자원 관리 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a resource management method of a disaster communication network and a device thereof. The resource management device comprises the following steps of: calculating importance of at least one user terminal in a predetermined region by using at least one of a class of a user, activity content, and a distance from a disaster occurrence region; calculating a priority of each user terminal based on the importance of the user terminal and a resource requirement amount; and sequentially allocating resources to the user terminal within the range of a resource capacity of a base station based on the priority.
abstract_ko: 재난 통신망의 자원 관리 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 자원 관리 장치는 사용자의 계급, 활동 내용 및 재난 발생 지역과의 거리 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 일정 지역 내 적어도 하나 이상의 사용자 단말의 중요도를 산출하고, 사용자 단말의 중요도와 자원 요구량을 기초로 각 사용자 단말의 우선순위를 산출한 후, 우선순위를 기초로 기지국의 자원 용량의 범위 내에서 순차적으로 사용자 단말에게 자원을 할당한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing service in a wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for providing a service in a wireless communication system are disclosed. The method and apparatus are directed to converging a 5th-generation (5G) communication system for supporting higher data rates beyond a 4th-generation (4G) system with a technology for Internet of things (IoT). The apparatus includes a terminal in the wireless communication system. The terminal includes a transceiver configured to transmit and receive a signal, and a processor configured to receive a first service request related to mission critical push to talk over LTE (MCPTT) over long term evolution (LTE), determine whether a first service corresponding to the first service request and a second service request being currently performed are simultaneously provided, and process the first service and the second service based on a priority of each of the service, services if the first service and the second service are not simultaneously provided.

title_en: Resource distribution method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention relates to the wireless communication technology field, in particular to a resource distribution method and device used for solving the problem in the prior art that by a resource distribution mode of the device-to-device (D2D) communication base station scheduling, the data packet priority scheduling based on D2D communication can not be realized. According to the embodiment of the present invention, a network-side device notices the first correspondence relation of the priority per packet (PPP) and the LCG ID of each destination address to a terminal, and according to the first correspondence relation, the PPP corresponding to the LCG ID of each destination address in a sidelink buffer status report (BSR) MAC CE is determined; according to the determined PPP and the buffer status information corresponding to the LCG ID of each destination address in the sidelink buffer status report (BSR) MAC CE, resources are distributed to each destination address of the terminal. According to the embodiment of the present invention, the situation that resources are distributed to each destination address of the terminal according to the PPP, is realized, thereby improving the performance of a system.

title_en: Method for transmitting information on priority for d2d link with relay ue in wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract_en: A method for transmitting a protocol data unit (PDU) by a user equipment (UE) via a device to device (D 2 D) link at a relay user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system is disclosed. The method includes steps of receiving the PDU from a remote UE via the D 2 D link; identifying a priority of a service data unit (SDU) from a payload included in the PDU; allocating the SDU to a bearer corresponding to the priority; and transmitting the SDU via the allocated bearer to a network.

title_en: Method and apparatus for securing a facility
abstract_en: Method and apparatus for a security alert system for communicating a security event to users by means of a full mesh network topology. The mesh network includes a plurality of remote units, receiver units, emergency box units, and teacher/hallway units strategically placed throughout a facility. Each remote unit has a plurality of buttons thereon wherein a button is designated for a specific type of problem, for example, an intruder, a gun carrying intruder, a medical emergency, or a fight. If a user presses one of the designated buttons the other members of the mesh network, including a receiver unit being monitored by security personnel, are immediately notified of the type and the location of the problem within the facility.

title_en: Vehicle communication system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vehicle communication system capable of suitably relaying transmission data even when a communication failure has occurred in the course of relay operation for the transmission data.SOLUTION: A relay candidate communication terminal 10, when having determined that transmission of transmission data is successful, raises priority of a priority table T. One relay candidate communication terminal 10, when having determined that another relay candidate communication terminal 10's transmission of transmission data is successful, lowers priority of a priority table T of the one relay candidate communication terminal 10. Thereby, when a communication failure has occurred in a communication path between a transmission source communication terminal 10 and a transmission destination communication terminal 10, it is made to be possible to preferentially use a communication path having high communication possibility from a plurality of communication paths for performing relay bypassing a communication path in which the communication failure has occurred.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Disaster indoor communication system with wireless communication network and the communication method thereof
title_ko: 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part and an indoor disaster communication method, which enable indoor disaster communication to be performed without discontinuation of communication even in a disaster situation, such as sinking or fire of a structure having a complex indoor constitution, such as a ship or a building. The indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part comprises a wireless network part which includes a plurality of wireless network nodes configured to selectively perform radio wave communication and sound wave communication in order to switch communication to the sound wave communication when flooding occurs during performance of the radio wave communication and which provides local area communication service inside a structure. In case of occurrence of a disaster, such as flooding or fire inside a ship or a large-sized building, communication is prevented from being discontinued inside a structure, a location and situation of a rescuee can be identified by a rescuer via a gesture or emergency message, and stable local communication service can be provided in case of a disaster by configuring the wireless network part by using an infrastructureless ad hoc network, thereby providing an effect of considerably facilitating rescue of human lives in case of occurrence of a disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 또는 건물 등의 복잡한 실내 구조를 가지는 구조물의 침몰, 화재 등의 재난 상황에서도 통신의 단절 없이 실내에서의 재난 통신을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법에 관한 것으로, 
상기 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재잔 통신 시스템은, 무선전파통신을 수행하는 과정 중 침수가 발생한 경우 음파통신으로 통신을 변경하도록 무선전파통신과 음파통신을 선택적으로 수행하는 다수의 무선네트워크노드들을 구비하여 구조물 내에서의 로컬영역 통신서비스를 제공하는 무선네트워크부;를 포함하여 구성되어, 
선박 또는 대형 건물 내에서의 침수, 화재 등의 재난 발생 시, 구조물 실내에서의 통신 단절을 방지하고, 제스처 또는 응급메시지를 통해 요구조자의 위치 및 상황을 구조자가 확인할 수 있도록 하며, 무선네트워크부를 인프라스트럭처를 구비하지 않는(infrastructureless) 애드 혹(ad hoc) 네트워크로 구성하는 것에 의해 재난 시에도 안정적인 국지적 통신서비스를 제공하며, 이에 의해 재난 발생 시의 인명 구조를 현저히 용이하게 하는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Video frame structure and D2D communication based video multicast method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video frame structure and D2D (Device-to-Device) communication based video multicast method. The video frame structure and D2D communication based video multicast method comprises steps that a base station announces a video multicast service, and all the interested users in a cell join in the service to form a multicast cluster; the base station carries out video stream multicast for the users in the cluster by regarding the transmission time of one basic unit GOP (Group of Pictures) in a video code as a cycle; the users check received information and report sequence numbers of frames having packet loss in the GOP to the base station after the multicast sub time slot is ended; the base station after receiving feedback information of the users establishes a sequence list based on the priorities of to-be-restored frames and establishes a CQI matrix of a D2D link between target frames ACK-devices and NACK-devices; relay selection and grouping are performed based on the CQI matrix and the time Tm required for transmission of the target frame m is calculated; and after the transmission is finished, the sequence number of the current target frame in the sequence list is deleted. The video frame structure and D2D communication based video multicast method efficiently overcomes the problem that the multicast rate in the multimedia multicast is always affected by the worst fading channel in the cluster, and greatly improves the video quality within limited spectrum resources from the perspective of the user.

title_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선통신 시스템에서 단말의 무선자원 운용 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus for operating a radio resource of a terminal in a radio communication system for supporting device-to-device communication. The method comprises the processes of: setting a priority for each packet based on an application; checking a radio bearer (RB) by setting the priority; forming a logical channel by considering the checked RB; forming a buffer state report (BSR) on the logical channel, and transmitting the BSR; and transmitting data by receiving resource allocation information on the BSR.
abstract_ko: 단말간 통신을 지원하는 무선통신 시스템에서 단말의 무선자원 운용 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Mission critical push to talk services
abstract_en: A method for enabling Mission Critical Push to Talk (MCPTT) services in a telecommunications network (5) is presented. The method is performed by a mobile terminal (MT) and comprises receiving (S100) an imminent peril or emergency MCPTT call from at least one other MT, the call indicating an emergency state for the at least one other MT, determining (S110) a number of MTs indicating an emergency state, and raising (S120) an MCPTT emergency alert if the determined number of MTs indicating an emergency state exceeds a threshold. An MT, an escalation server, a computer program, and a computer program product are, also presented.

title_en: VANET Warning Message Propagation Method for Electric Wave Blind Area
title_ko: 전파 음영지역에서의 vanet 경고 메시지 전달 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicular ad-hoc network (VANET) warning message transmission method which can be used in a radio wave shadow area. More specifically, the present invention relates to a VANET warning message transmission technology using routing information and dividing the state of a node into a direct mode and a redirect mode to execute an operation. According to the present invention, the VANET warning message transmission method, which can be used in a radio wave shadow area, includes the steps of: receiving an initial warning message from an emergency occurrence node; checking whether a node is in an intersection area by checking whether the weight of the intersection is one or not; operating in redirect- mode when the weight of the intersection is not one; checking whether there is only a single node when the weight of the intersection is one; transmitting a warning message when there is only one node; checking which node has higher transmission priority when there is more than one node; and executing a warning message transmission process upon checking the node with the higher transmission priority and making other nodes with lower transmission priority wait.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 라우팅 정보를 이용하면서 노드의 상태를 다이렉트 모드와 리다이렉트 모드로 이원화하여 동작하게 하는 VANET 경고 메세지 전달 기술에 관한 것이다. 

본 발명에 따른 전파 음영지역에서의 VANET 경고 메시지 전달 방법은 긴급 상황 발생 노드로부터 최초 경고 메시지를 수신하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1인지 확인하여 상기 노드가 교차로 영역에 있는지 확인하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1이 아닐 경우 리다이렉트 모드로 진행하는 단계; 교차로 가중치가 1인 경우에 한 개의 노드만 존재하는지 확인하는 단계; 노드가 한 개만 존재하는 경우, 경고 메시지를 전달하는 단계; 노드가 한 개만 존재하지 않는 경우, 높은 전달 우선순위인지 확인하는 단계; 높은 전달 순위로 확인되면 경고 메시지 전달 과정을 수행하고 높은 전달 순위가 아니면 대기하는 단계;로 진행되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Interference management in wireless mesh networks
abstract_en: A unified frame structure for communicating in a synchronous and slotted mesh network is provided. Nodes within the mesh network are designated as primary and secondary nodes. For each transmission, a primary node may first send scheduling information to secondary nodes associated with the primary node. The receiver of the scheduled link may send a clear-to-send signal. For uplink scheduled transmissions, the receiver is the primary node. For downlink scheduled transmissions, the receiver is a secondary node. The transmitter of the scheduled link may receive the CTS signal from one or more proximate receivers, including a receiver associated with the scheduled transmission as well as other receivers not associated with the scheduled transmission. The transmitter of the scheduled link may estimate the signal to interference-plus-noise ratio of other links that are of higher priority and may then determine whether to yield or power back off the scheduled transmission.

title_en: Program, communication apparatus and communication method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To use an infrastructure that is different from an associated communication system and implements emergency alert broadcasting, in order to detect occurrence of a situation in which an ad hoc network should be constructed in the communication system.SOLUTION: A program of the present invention functions a computer as: radio communication means 1 for implementing radio communications with a preset destination by controlling hardware that performs radio communications; fault detection means 2 by which, in the case where a communication with a preset destination is interrupted for a fixed time or in the case where it is confirmed fixed times that the communication with the preset destination is failed, fault occurrence is judged; ad hoc network construction means 3 for constructing a network through multihop communications by directly communicating with an external terminal in the case where the fault detection means judges the fault occurrence; and an information sharing application 4 that operates on the network and shares a surrounding disaster situation or a rescue requirement with the external terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for forming dynamic bridge node of wireless mesh network
abstract_en: A method for forming a dynamic bridge node of a wireless mesh network is provided. The method includes enabling a bridge mode of at least one of the mesh nodes in correspondence to a mutual coverage, when a signal corresponding to a connection source is received from the external network, transmitting, by the mesh node having the enabled bridge mode, rank information for connection to the external network with reference to a distance to the connection source and the mesh node's own traffic, comparing rank information received from a neighboring mesh node having an enabled bridge mode with the mesh node's own rank information, and generating an order of priority for connection to the external network. The mesh node with the highest order of priority operates as a bridge node for connection of the external network and the wireless mesh network.

title_en: Wireless temperature measurement sensor network for transformer substation and networking working method thereof
abstract_en: A wireless thermometric sensor network for a substation, the apparatus comprising: the system comprises bottom temperature measurement sensor nodes, upper routing nodes, a gateway and a monitoring station. Data collected by the bottom wireless temperature measuring sensor node are sent to the routing node through the bottom ad hoc network, and the routing node sends the data to the gateway through the ZigBee network for corresponding processing so as to complete data acquisition and processing. The bottom layer ad hoc network adopts a SUB-G frequency band ad hoc network protocol, a ZigBee network is adopted among the router nodes, and in order to reduce the times of backoff required for the successful access of a single sensor node to a channel, the nodes adopt a CSMA/CA channel access mode based on a time slot division mechanism. Meanwhile, in order to find the optimal path in the ZigBee protocol network, a path priority routing algorithm with the lowest packet loss rate is adopted, and the shortest routing path is determined according to the packet loss rate of the total path.

title_en: A kind of Long Term Evolution LTE public safety networks admittance control method and device
abstract_en: The embodiments of the invention provide a kind of Long Term Evolution LTE public safety networks admittance control method and device, the first incremental loading produced by the user's call request for determining to receive to communication system；The channel quality of channel and the present load of communication system are used further according to user's call request, first incremental loading is modified, obtain the second incremental loading revised to the first incremental loading, channel quality is lower, the present load of communication system is higher, the amendment amplitude for correcting the first incremental loading is bigger, and revised second incremental loading is bigger compared to the first incremental loading；When the present load of the second incremental loading and communication system and, during less than or equal to predetermined threshold value, accessing user's call request；So as to the preferable call request of priority access channel quality, it is to avoid the poor call request of channel quality takes limited Radio Resource and causes the wasting of resources, improves the utilization rate of limited wireless resources, improves the saturation of communication system.

title_en: Outdoor lighting network as an emergency connection infrastructure
abstract_en: An Outdoor Lighting Network (OLN) is disclosed as a complementary or emergency communication infrastructure for smart city systems. The OLN may integrate light points within the network as receivers that are switched from a standard OLN communication protocol to a D2D-based protocol when the primary smart city system communication network is switched off, wherein each communication protocol includes a respective message prioritization method. The disclosed aspects additionally include methods and apparatus for implementing an outdoor lighting network that can act as a D2D network in the event of a primary communication failure to pass messages from smart city system field devices through a converted D2D OLN network and to a smart city system central manager for proper processing and distribution of smart city system field device communications.

title_en: Worker safety system
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for providing locating and exposure monitoring includes receiving data indicating a safety event and a first location from a first device and receiving a second location from a second device. The method includes transmitting an alert and the data indicating the safety event to the second device when the second location is within a predetermined distance from the first location, wherein the second device relays the alert and/or a gas reading to at least one peer device in a mesh network joined by the second device.

title_en: A kind of urgent call warning system and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of urgent call warning system and method, can conveniently be matched with existing communication terminal, enhancing and expansion distress signal, realizes actively timely call alerts.Said system includes some warning devices, and warning device includes processor, and antenna, bandpass filter, reception of wireless signals unit, wireless signal transmitting element, holder, data exchange interface, signal, which is sent, to be switched.The above method includes：System initialization；Warning message is sent out by initiative alarming device；Warning message is sent at setting object by corresponding communication terminal；Standby warning device receives warning message in warning system, is automatically controlled by corresponding processor and opens wireless signal transmitting element, forwards the warning message received；At least three warning devices for receiving warning message form ad-hoc network in warning system, position initiative alarming device by alarm signal, complete alarm.

title_en: Alert and disaster management system and method for operating such a system
abstract_en: The alert and disaster management system (100) comprises: at least one radiocommunication terminal (105), the terminal comprising: a means (106) for communicating, via a data network, with a central computer system, - a sensor (110) for sensing a value of a physical variable that is representative of the operation of the network connected to the terminal, a means (115) for determining a network failure according to the captured value, a transmitter (120) of radio signals in the event a failure is determined and - the central computer system (300), connected via the data network to at least one terminal, comprising: a memory (304) of geographical positioning information of at least one terminal, a detector (305) for detecting network connection anomalies between the computer system and at least one terminal, a means (310) of providing an alert in the event of an anomaly, a means (315) of providing a piece of information that represents the stored positioning of at least one said terminal having a network connection anomaly and at least one mobile radiocommunication receiver (125) configured to receive the radio signals transmitted by at least one terminal.

title_en: Methods and systems for transmission control in network supporting mission critical services
abstract_en: A method and a system for transmission control in a network supporting MC services are provided. The method includes associating a predefined priority to a data transmission request from a communication device, availing MC services, based on type of the data transmission request. The type of the data transmission request is classified in at least one arbitration category. Further, the method includes managing flow of data associated with the data transmission request in the network based on the associated predefined priority.

title_en: Network topology self-healing method based on dynamic priority
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of broadband ad hoc networks, and relates to a network topology self-healing method based on dynamic priority, which comprises the following steps: a1, starting the nodes, constructing a TDMA star network taking the main node as the center, starting a self-healing priority evaluation and generation mechanism by the main node, and initializing self-healing priorities by the child nodes; a2, the main node broadcasts self-healing priority parameters to all the child nodes in each superframe; a3, the child node loads the broadcast timeout timer value; a4, the child nodes count down the broadcast overtime, and simultaneously monitor the broadcast signals, if the timer is overtime, the child nodes do not receive the broadcast signals of the main node, and the child nodes start a self-healing mode; and A5, the child node receives the broadcast signal, analyzes the broadcast signal, extracts and updates self-healing priority information, and the step A3 is carried out. The invention realizes the effectiveness and reliability of the candidate master node, reduces the possibility of network runaway when the network master node fails, and can be widely used in a broadband Mesh network.
assignees: HUNAN WISECOM TECH CO LTD;NAT UNIV DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY PLA

title_en: Apparatus and methods to provide communications to aerial platforms
abstract_en: Apparatus, systems and methods for the provision of high data rate and high throughput communications link for drones, in a bandwidth efficient manner. One set of embodiments describe apparatus and methods to mitigate interference from other systems when using the unlicensed radio frequency bands such as the Industrial Scientific and Medical (ISM) bands. Apparatus and methods are also described to enable association of the drone radio sub-system with an “optimal” cell site, such as when the drone uses a directional antenna beam to maximize system throughput. Configurations of a mechanically steerable directional antenna aperture are also disclosed. Other embodiments describe systems and methods to mitigate excessive amounts of interference, and to provide a reliable communications link for signaling and other mission-critical messages.

title_en: Autonomous, power-dictated message routing for multi-hop mesh network outage communications
abstract_en: Methods and devices for facilitating communications in an ad-hoc multi-hop wireless network during outage conditions are described herein. In one exemplary embodiment, an initiating device attempts to send a communication to a target destination by first sending a synchronization request to an intermediate device using a unicast transmission. If the initiating device determines that the first synchronization request failed, a second synchronization request is sent to any potential candidate device neighbors using an anycast transmission protocol. The initiating device receives an acknowledgment message from at least one of those devices. The transmission of acknowledgment messages by potential candidate responders are prioritized in a self-organizing manner relating to priority indicator information conveyed in the anycast transmission. The acknowledgment message indicates that a device has accepted the anycast synchronization request and, after synchronizing with that device, the initiating device sends a communication to the destination via the responding device using a unicast transmission protocol.
assignees: COOPER TECHNOLOGIES CO;EATON INTELLIGENT POWER LTD

title_en: Hybrid mesh network construction method, data transmission method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a hybrid mesh network and a data transmission method according to the hybrid mesh network. When data transmission is carried out, the priority of each mesh network is determined according to the link parameters of each mesh network in the mixed mesh network, the target mesh network with the highest priority is determined, and the data message is transmitted to the destination address according to the target mesh network. Therefore, a mesh network is no longer used for data transmission, and during data transmission, the mesh network with the highest transmission efficiency is selected for data transmission. Therefore, the influence of signal interference on the mesh network is reduced, and the data transmission efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sound-responsive Repeater Device and System
abstract_en: A Sound-responsive Repeater Device, System, and Method. The device can be programmed to recognize audible sounds and then responsively trigger an action. The triggered actions are local visual and audible alerts, such as flashing lights and audible sirens or beeps. Each device may be capable of recognizing the unique alert tone of another device so that each device will trigger on the audible alert being generated by another device without the need for user programming. This will create a “domino effect” of cascading alerts from device to device. Each device will have onboard backup power, as well as at least one removeable flashlight that will provide a user with emergency lighting at each device, and the ability to take a flashlight with them in order to escape the building. There will be versions of the device that interconnect with conventional Home Automation gateways, either via conventional Home Automation communications protocol (e.g. zigbee, zwave, etc.), or by WiFi. These interconnected devices should not only be able to generate triggers for the HA gateway, but they should also be able to receive Home Automation triggers from the gateway. Receipt of these triggers should generate audible and/or visual alerts at the devices, depending upon their programming. Each device can be converted from a non-interconnected to an interconnected mode by exchanging a detachable module, such as the flashlight module, with an interconnectable module.

title_en: Based on the special frequency point self-organizing network electroacoustic alarm control system of people's air defense
abstract_en: The present invention relates to one kind based on the special frequency point self-organizing network electroacoustic alarm control system of people's air defense, it is made of wireless ad hoc network signal processing center, electroacoustic alarm module, man-machine interactive platform, wireless data transmission module, electric power system；Realize the networking request of alert node and the networking request of processing next stage node in the wireless ad hoc network signal processing center；A 600W power amplification interface is configured in the electroacoustic alarm module, realizes the granting of alert message；The wireless data transmission module realizes the granting and reception of the wireless signal of the special frequency point of people's air defense；The electric power system provides stable, reliable supply network for entire self-organizing network electroacoustic alarm control system.The present invention proposes one kind based on the special frequency point self-organizing network electroacoustic alarm control system of people's air defense, using the Routing Protocol of Ad Hoc networks, can improve the reliability and survivability of people's air-defence warning's network.
