title_en: Vehicular intelligent traffic safety control technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Vehicular intelligent traffic safety control technologies, it provides one kind and car-to-car data network communication is established based on two priority classes ad hoc network, utilize the dynamic space coordinate of vehicle, driving purpose, motion state and motion change intent information data do parameter, pass through real-time interaction communication object between movement interference possibility algorithm establishment vehicle, movement state information of driving a vehicle in real time between realization vehicle interactively communicates, achieve the purpose that vehicle timely and effectively obtains the motion state and motion intention change information of the other vehicles of surrounding, and then realize the technical solution of Cooperative Security thermoacoustic prime engine function between vehicle, the present invention utilizes calculation processing and data communication based on dynamic travelling data between vehicle, solves the technical issues of existing Vehicular intelligent traffic safety control technology can not effectively carry out Cooperative Security thermoacoustic prime engine between vehicle.

title_en: Intelligent sequencing of multiple wireless nodes for transfer between wireless mesh networks in a process control system
abstract_en: A method of sequencing a logical transfer of wireless nodes between wireless mesh networks includes iteratively evaluating each wireless node in a first set of wireless nodes to be transferred. Each evaluation includes a predictive analysis of a source wireless mesh network which tests communications between the gateway of the source wireless mesh network and each of the remaining wireless nodes, and a predictive analysis of the wireless node under evaluation in a destination wireless mesh network which tests communications between the gateway of the destination wireless mesh network and the wireless node under evaluation. The wireless node under evaluation is appended to a second set of wireless nodes to be transferred in response to the first predictive analysis of the source mesh network, and the predictive analysis of the wireless node under evaluation. The wireless nodes are structured in the second set in order of priority of transfer.

title_en: Method and apparatus for securing a facility
abstract_en: Method and apparatus for a security alert system (10) for communicating a security event to users (32) of a facility (12) by means of a full mesh network (26). The mesh network (26) includes a plurality of remote units (14), receiver units (20), emergency box units (16), and teacher/hallway units (18) strategically placed throughout a facility (12). Each remote unit (14) has a plurality of buttons (82-88) thereon wherein a button (82-88) is designated for a specific type of problem, for example, an intruder (90), a gun carrying intruder (92), a medical emergency (96), or a fight (94). If a user (32) presses one of the designated buttons (82-88) the other members (28) of the mesh network (26), including a receiver unit (20) being monitored by security personnel, are immediately notified of the type and the location of the problem within the facility (12).

title_en: Wireless network access point to select a device-to-device communication master for a device-to-device communication group
abstract_en: A wireless network access point and User Equipment (UEs) communicate over Base Station-to-Device (BS2D) traffic links. The wireless network access point receives status reports from the UEs that form a Device-to-Device (D2D) communication group. The wireless network access point filters the UEs in the D2D communication group based on a signal strength threshold and a buffer capacity threshold to identify a candidate set of the UEs. The wireless network access point further prioritizes the candidate set based on buffer status reporting frequency of the UEs to select one of the UEs as the D2D communication master for the D2D communication group.

title_en: A kind of ad hoc network evacuation indication system and method based on wireless mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ad hoc network evacuation indication system and method based on wireless mode, including presentation of information transmitting device, radio network gateway, wireless monitor module and backstage monitoring system, the wireless monitor module distribution multiple corners indoors, obtain the mobile phone signal of personnel nearby, the wireless monitor module by signal is by jumper connection or is directly connected to radio network gateway, and the radio network gateway signal link information shows transmitting device；Described information shows that transmitting device connects backstage monitoring system by network transmission module, backstage monitoring system signal connection trapped person's mobile phone and rescue personnel's terminal, operation principle of the present invention is simple, the position of trapped person can be positioned in real time, by ad hoc network cascade system data transmission to background system, when alert occurs, evacuation Way guidance can be sent to personnel near alert generation area by background system, and trapped person position is sent to rescue personnel.

abstract_en: The invention belongs to broadcasting equipment technical fields, disclose a kind of broadcast system of the intelligent wireless ad hoc network based on zigbee, are provided with communication alert Consultation Center, wired or be wirelessly connected to PC machine by internet；It is described that N number of outdoor active speaker is connected to by communication protocol by communication alert Consultation Center, N number of classroom active audio amplifier is connected to by communication protocol, by being wirelessly connected with mobile phone, administrative staff's mobile phone is connected to by communication protocol.The present invention is quick for installation, of low cost, it is simple to safeguard；Can in wired broadcast system dilatation, without development bottleneck；Can be achieved it is point-to-point, point-to-area, choose at random broadcast；Stable work in work, scalability are strong；System takes into account audio broadcasting and infrared equal warning functions.

title_en: Emergency Guide System Using Intelligent Type Exit Guide Lighting
title_ko: 지능형 유도등을 이용한 종합 피난 유도 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a comprehensive evacuation guide system using an intelligent guide light. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the comprehensive evacuation guide system using an intelligent guide light integrates an exit guide light installed near an entrance and a plurality of passage guide lights into a group form to realize an evacuation guide service, and provides an evacuation guide by voice and image information on a smartphone of a user by real-time communication between beacons via a Bluetooth mesh-based network. Therefore, according to an embodiment of the present invention, even if a view is bad due to communication disruption, smoke or the like and it is impossible to obtain a location of an exit guide light, a location of an exit can be obtained by a smartphone, a voice warning or the like to evade a dangerous situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지능형 유도등을 이용한 종합 피난 유도 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일실시 예에 따른 지능형 유도등을 이용한 종합 피난 유도 시스템은 출입구 근처에 설치된 피난구 유도등과 복수의 통로 유도등을 구성한 그룹 형태로 통합하여 피난 유도 서비스를 구현하고, 블루투스 메쉬 기반 네트워크를 통한 비콘 간의 실시간 통신으로 이용객의 스마트폰에 음성과 영상 정보로 피난 유도를 안내하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명의 일실시 예에 따르면, 통신 두절이나 연기 등으로 시야가 불량하고, 피난구 유도등의 위치 파악이 불가능한 경우에도 스마트폰이나, 음성 경보 등으로 피난구의 위치를 파악할 수 있어 위험한 상황을 벗어날 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of method, first terminal and the second terminal of access network
abstract_en: A kind of method, first terminal and the second terminal of access network, to solve the problems, such as how terminal accesses the self-organizing network under the occupied scene of the time slot in self-organizing network.Method includes：When the time slot in the self-organizing network that first terminal to be accessed is occupied, first terminal occupies unappropriated emergent time slot in self-organizing network；First terminal sends message of meeting an urgent need on emergent time slot, which is used to indicate priority in first terminal self-organizing network to be occupied and is less than the time slot that other terminals of first terminal occupy；When, there are when the time slot that other terminals discharge itself occupancy, first terminal occupies the time slot being released, with Ad hoc network in self-organizing network.

title_en: Mixed type time slot reservation method in Distributed T DMA agreements
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mixed type time slot reservation method in Distributed T DMA agreements, mainly solve the problems, such as to be difficult to ensure delay requirement under business load situation of change in wireless self-organization network.Its scheme is：Fixed time slot is distributed for node, to meet basic service demand；If load is higher, fixed time slot not enough uses, then carries out the reservation of dynamic slot；Because dynamic slot reservation process needs more time, it is unfavorable for burst service transmission, so when thering is high load burst service, node to occupy free timeslot using competitive way, while introducing prioritized contention and reservation negotiation mechanism and reducing competition conflict.The present invention divides fixed time slot, dynamic slot is preengage, the burst transfer of non-reservation is combined together, provide the data transmission capabilities of self-adapting load variation, the stability that ensure that Time Delay of Systems, improves slot efficiency, can be used in the TDMA agreements of mobile ad-hoc network.

title_en: Communication terminal in wireless ad-hoc network, communication method, and communication program
abstract_en: A communication terminal provided with: a control information sharing means which notifies an adjacent terminal of control information including at least the number of adjacent terminals as information, and which acquires from the adjacent terminal the control information of the adjacent terminal; a relay terminal selection means which, on the basis of the control information, selects as a relay terminal a communication terminal capable of directly communicating with all communication terminals in a wireless ad-hoc network; a transmission power control means which adjusts transmission power in accordance with the result of selection by the relay terminal selection means; a reselection necessity determination means which determines whether another communication terminal should become a new relay terminal, and which, upon determining that another communication terminal should become a new relay terminal, computes the priority of the communication terminals in the wireless ad-hoc network; and a relay terminal reselection request means which performs, in accordance with the priority, a relay terminal reselection request process for transmitting a relay terminal reselection request included in the control information. The control information sharing means delivers the relay terminal reselection request, and the transmission power control means adjusts the transmission power on the basis of the relay terminal reselection request.

title_en: Personal tactical system and network
abstract_en: A personal tactical system including a ballistic load-bearing garment, a pouch with one or more batteries enclosed in the pouch, an electronic processor, a communication device, and at least one camera. The camera is incorporated into or removably attachable to the load-bearing garment, the pouch is removably attachable to the load-bearing garment and the one or more batteries are operable to power the camera and communication device. The processor runs image recognition software operable to identify approaching objects and alert the user. A plurality of personal tactical systems is operable to form an ad hoc network to share images and other information for determining object direction, location, and movement.

title_en: System and method for warning disaster by ultrasound modulation and bluetooth ad-hoc network
title_ko: 초음파 변조와 블루투스 애드혹 네트워크를 이용한 재난 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster warning system and method using ultrasonic modulation and a Bluetooth ad-hoc network. The disaster warning system includes an ultrasonic modulation output unit for synthesizing a packet to be transmitted with an ultrasonic-modulated signal and an audio signal and outputting the synchronized result, and an ad-hoc network constructing unit for performing demodulation and inspection by passing through an ultrasonic band from the received signal, advertising the packet, and generating and transmitting a packet scanned from a neighboring terminal as an advertisement packet again. According to the present invention, battery consumption can be reduce by not only transmitting a disaster warning to a long distance through the ad-hoc network but also controlling an advertisement transmission period. Also, the present invention can be used as the most appropriate communication method in a disaster situation where a base station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 초음파 변조와 블루투스 애드혹 네트워크를 이용한 재난 경보 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 전송하고자 하는 패킷을 초음파 변조한 신호와 오디오 신호를 합성하여 출력하는 초음파 변조 출력부와, 수신된 신호로부터 초음파 대역을 통과시켜 복조 및 검사하고 패킷을 광고함과 아울러, 이웃 단말로부터 스캔된 패킷을 다시 광고 패킷으로 생성하여 반송하는 애드혹 네트워크 구성부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 애드혹 네트워크를 통해 먼 거리까지 재난 경보를 전달할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 광고 발송 주기를 조절함으로써 배터리 소모를 줄일 수 있다. 또한, 기지국이 없는 재난 상황에서 가장 적절한 통신 방법으로 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: Remote water softener monitoring system
abstract_en: A device for monitoring the level or amount of a material within a container is provided. The device includes a detection mechanism that can be a direct detection mechanism or an indirect detection mechanism. When the detection mechanism senses an upper level of the substance in the container that is below a predetermined lower limit for the substance, the mechanism operates an alarm mechanism to emit an alarm to alert an individual to the low level of the substance within the container. The alarm can wirelessly communicate a salt level state to a wireless network or a device on a wireless network that can transmit the status through the Internet to any remote location. In one aspect, the alarm can be sent on a mesh network with a device that can transmit the status and other conditions through the Internet and to an application executing on a mobile device.

title_en: Priority and locking mechanism for network modules
abstract_en: A method for coordinating performance of functions within an ad hoc network is disclosed, the network comprising a plurality of network parameters, a controller, a locking mechanism having a processor and a memory and in communication with the controller, and a plurality of modules configured to operate on the network parameters, wherein each of the plurality of modules is assigned a respective priority. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a request for a lock from at least one of the modules; and providing the lock to the module having the highest priority level relative to the plurality of modules requesting the lock. The method also includes receiving a request at the locking mechanism from the module with the lock and enabling the module with the lock to make a change to a network parameter of the plurality of network parameters, wherein the change includes at least one of a steady state change, a transient change, and a temporary change.

title_en: Methods and devices for device-to-device communications

title_en: A kind of Campus Broadcasting System of intelligent wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to broadcasting equipment technical field, discloses a kind of Campus Broadcasting System of intelligent wireless ad hoc network, is provided with communication alert Consultation Center, wired or be wirelessly connected to PC machine by internet；It is described that N number of outdoor active speaker is connected to by communication protocol by communication alert Consultation Center, N number of classroom active audio amplifier is connected to by communication protocol, by being wirelessly connected with mobile phone, administrative staff's mobile phone is connected to by communication protocol.The utility model is quick for installation, of low cost, maintenance is simple；Can in wired broadcast system dilatation, without development bottleneck；Can be achieved it is point-to-point, point-to-area, choose at random broadcast；Stable work in work, scalability are strong；System takes into account audio broadcasting and infrared equal warning functions.

title_en: Routing method for adaptively reducing node load in mobile ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a routing method for adaptively reducing node load in a mobile ad hoc network, which is used in the field of MANET network routing protocol optimization. Load information and residual energy information of all nodes are periodically acquired at a time interval T, and a central node is determined; generating a predicted delay time, a request value and a negative priority, and forming a request packet; sending the request packet to a first upstream node directly connected with the central node to request for reducing the load; the first upstream node generates a random value, and if the random value is greater than the request value, the route from the first upstream node to the destination node keeps the original path for transmission; otherwise, the redundant route replaces the original route to forward the data, the priority of the original route is changed according to the negative priority in the request packet, and the priority of the original route is changed at a time interval T 1 Periodic updates are made. The invention can not only reduce the delay of the network and increase the survival time of the nodes, but also reduce the number of central nodes and improve the safety of the whole network.

title_en: Systems and methods for improving alert messaging using device to device communication
abstract_en: A method, apparatus and computer program product are provided in accordance with an example embodiment in order to initiate a message and communication on behalf of one or more tracking devices or initiate a request for location information associated with one or more tracking devices. In the context of a method, the method includes pairing at least a first device with at least one tracking device that is associated with a user; wherein the first device is configured to interact with the at least one tracking device. The method further includes detecting an alert condition with respect to the at least one tracking device and initiating a message request to the at least one tracking device. The method further includes causing an alert message comprising the location information associated with the at least one tracking device to be transmitted.

title_en: A kind of Distribution Network Failure artificial intelligence analysis method

title_en: The method for preventing joint network from attacking in Tactical Mobile ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses the methods for preventing joint network from attacking in Tactical Mobile ad hoc network, are used for Tactical Mobile ad-hoc network security fields.Whether the method is attacked using two kinds of mechanism identification radio station of active detecting and passive monitoring, radio station increases the presence of the identification of function malicious node of period certification by the method for active detecting, and can be determined using the malice value record being arranged in advance attack by the method passively monitored；Using route-caching mechanism history route stand-by, so that radio station can normally send data under joint network attack.Make full use of this special existing node of middle control node in Tactical Mobile ad-hoc network, the Exception Type that radio station will test is reported to middle control node, middle control node analyzes the geographical location of all report abnormal nodes, the approximate location of backward tracing attacker, and send alert message to the radio station in the region and play the role of the safety of enhancement information and isolate to attack node.

title_en: System and method for bottom-up invocation of control signal repeaters in a mesh lighting network
abstract_en: Example embodiments of the invention efficiently organize, control and prioritize a distributed lighting network. A mesh lighting network is organized from the bottom up into groups of lighting devices with control signal repeaters fanning out control signals to each group. Each lighting device is capable of forwarding control signals to additional lighting devices. During build-out of the mesh network, as new lighting devices are installed, the control network automatically selects a device whose repeater function will provide the most reliable and efficient distribution of control signals to the new group of devices being installed.

title_en: A kind of credible cooperating service method of sea wireless Mesh netword
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of credible cooperating service methods of marine wireless Mesh netword, this method is by introducing node credit rating mechanism, motivate node cooperation, construct the virtual cooperative service system based on Mesh network and credible evaluation, complete the credible reliable transmission of network task, specifically use the degree of belief of node, contribution degree, available bandwidth, computing capability, the characteristic attribute as characterization node such as link-quality, in a manner of task-driven, the node of cooperation with service is selected based on the evaluation of the service ability of node and collaboration services migration priority by MRC node, construct virtual cooperative service system, realize resource rapid fusion, reliability services are provided for user.Emulation experiment shows the problem of mentioned virtual cooperation with service tissue model can effectively solve congestion under the environment of ocean island in wireless cooperation communication network, single point failure, data distribution low efficiency, improves the service quality of Mesh network.

title_en: Mobile ad hoc network management method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for managing a mobile ad hoc network, and relates to the field of mobile ad hoc networks. After the mobile terminal executes the corresponding service, the mobile ad hoc network management device judges whether the confirmation information sent by the target node is received, and if the confirmation information sent by the target node is received, the corresponding record value in the record table is correspondingly updated according to the service. The invention updates the corresponding record value according to the services such as sending and forwarding executed by the mobile terminal in the mobile ad hoc network, and effectively solves the fairness problem caused by asynchronous mobile terminal ad hoc network requirements through the management of the record value because the record value is associated with the priority of the mobile terminal applying for the mobile ad hoc network resources.

title_en: Supporting low-latency traffic over a wireless mesh network
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A central access node (CAN) may manage and schedule resources for a wireless mesh network. The CAN may transmit a first message to a relay access node (AN) to expedite transmission of a priority communication in the wireless mesh network. The first message may provide configuration information for modifying a preconfigured schedule to expedite the transmission of the priority communication. For example, the first message may provide configuration information to modify a preconfigured schedule to allow a first network node to transmit the priority communication to a second network node during a reserved time period. The relay AN may generate a second message regarding the modified schedule and transmit the second message to the second network node.

title_en: Single-channel Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) satellite cluster ad hoc network time slot resource allocation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time slot resource allocation method of a single-channel Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) constellation ad hoc network. When the satellite node accesses the network, a quick access mechanism is provided for a new access node based on the time slot occupation information of the satellite node in the one-hop transmission range, and the occupation process of high-priority time slot resources is realized; when the satellite node sends load dynamic change, broadcasting dynamic time slot information to be occupied to all satellite nodes in a one-hop transmission range based on the current load and the use condition of the satellite node time slot in the one-hop transmission range, carrying out conflict detection on the broadcasted dynamic time slot information by all satellite nodes in the one-hop transmission range, and completing a dynamic change process of time slot resources along with the load by the dynamic time slot application nodes according to the applied time slot information and the conflict time slot information contained in the applied time slot information.

title_en: Ad hoc network communication method and ad hoc network communication system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ad hoc network communication method and an ad hoc network communication system, wherein the ad hoc network communication system comprises a plurality of wireless nodes for networking, a communication base station and a cloud server, single-hop information transmission is carried out among the wireless nodes, when the wireless nodes are positioned in the communication radius range R of the communication base station, the wireless nodes positioned in the communication radius range R wirelessly transmit information to the cloud server end through the communication base station, return the information through the cloud server and transmit the information among the wireless nodes, thereby realizing the ad hoc network communication, the wireless nodes adopt an improved target site numbering distance vector DSDV protocol for networking, the main improvement is that the traditional target site numbering distance vector DSDV protocol is combined to construct a multi-tree topology for networking, and the nodes exchange information with the adjacent nodes through a RIP routing information protocol, the method comprises the following steps: initializing; establishing a route between nodes; a priority assignment step; the higher the transmission priority, the higher the priority of the route is, the higher the transmission priority of the route is, and the higher the transmission priority of the data is, and the higher the transmission priority of the network communication is realized.
assignees: JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: UAV ad hoc network timeslot scheduling algorithm based on service priority and channel interruption probability
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of UAV ad hoc network timeslot scheduling algorithm based on service priority and channel interruption probability, the channel time slot distribution of the node is adjusted by the size of the outage probability value of prediction, if the outage probability of node is smaller, channel time slot is distributed for the node；If the outage probability of node is larger, suspends the non-slotted channel distribution of the node in next frame, restore to distribute again after node interrupts probability reduction；If the outage probability of node falls between, judged according to the outage probability of former frames.The probability that data send failure is reduced by the channel assignment strategy that probability is fed back, improves the utilization rate of channel.

title_en: Competitive time division multiple access method for data and voice simultaneous transmission of wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless transmission, and discloses a competitive time division multiple access method for data and voice simultaneous transmission of a wireless self-organizing network, which comprises the following steps: starting up all nodes, and firstly carrying out initial network access; then, each node enters a service sending state, and each node independently maintains a same service frame; when the service packet to be transmitted by a certain node reaches a competition threshold, initiating dynamic voice time slot competition, and if the competition is successful, transmitting the data service packet by using the voice time slot after the competition until the service is lower than the competition threshold or a voice service arrives; when a certain node has a voice service, a voice service reservation flow is initiated, and after the reservation is successful, the node sends a voice service packet in a voice time slot until the voice service is sent completely or a node with higher priority performs voice service reservation. The invention can guarantee the time delay requirement and the service quality requirement of the time delay sensitive service, improve the transmission efficiency of the system and improve the transmission experience of users.

title_en: New service types and congestion control
abstract_en: The current invention introduces new service types like delay tolerant access type, low priority access type and background data access type to the Service Request procedure and also proposes congestion control for the proposed new service types.

title_en: A kind of business scheduling method suitable for wireless TDMA ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses the business scheduling method in a kind of wireless TDMA ad hoc network, includes the following steps: the multiple service queues of each node M AC layers of internal maintenance in ad hoc network, arrange distribution from high to low by message priority；In node operational process, the data or control information for receiving or generating for MAC layer are classified, then be according to priority added in corresponding service queue by type of service；When the one's own sending time slots of node arrive, then data are chosen from above-mentioned service queue by preset scheduling rule and be scheduled transmission；Priority is recalculated to message in remaining first biography data service queue to be sent and is ranked up, deletes and reaches the business that maximum retransmission still fails.The method of the present invention classifies type of service and by importance real-time priority ranking, and the influence factor of many aspects is then comprehensively considered in data service scheduling, so that MAC layer data, which are sent, has lower time delay and preferable throughput guarantee.
assignees: HUNAN ZHILING COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of methods, devices and systems of the mobile ad hoc network information back towards field
abstract_en: The methods, devices and systems of the invention discloses a kind of mobile ad hoc network information back towards field.Described device is made of proximity communication module and telecommunication module；The system is by described device, data collecting end device and cloud database composition；The retransmission method includes being polymerize to form localized ad hoc network at random with TDMA (time division multiple acess) mode combined according to min/max ID algorithm, broadcast communication collision problem is solved simultaneously, secondly, different passback strategies is taken according to the service priority of back information, different business priority is adapted to for delay requirement, finally, failed cluster member upload information in consolidated network is passed through into other member's upload server ends in the net by way of ad hoc network, it realizes multipath return path, effectively reduces important messages passback time delay.

title_en: Vehicle radio communication system
abstract_en: To reduce traffic by efficiently using network resources and thereby shorten a communication delay time when a mesh network is formed by installing a large number of radio communication terminals on a vehicle.SOLUTION: When each radio communication terminal transmits data, a vehicle radio communication system determines priority according to a type of transmission target data, selects a wide-area radio communication function if the priority is high, selects a narrow-area radio communication function if the priority is low, and performs radio communication. The high or low priority of each piece of data is variable according to a change in situation such as emergency. Also in the case where each radio communication terminal relays data, the vehicle radio communication system determines priority according to a type of data, and selects either wide-area radio communication or narrow-area radio communication. The wide-area radio communication and narrow-area radio communication are different in communication format from each other. The priority of data changes according to destinations.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Smart fire detector
title_ko: 스마트 화재감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart fire detector capable of notifying a fire occurrence in real time even in the middle of the night and absence and enabling rapid escape by checking an accurate ignition position, by coupling a wireless ad-hoc network module to a single type fire alarm to allow fire information to be shared in real time between devices. The smart fire detector comprises: a fire detection module for detecting fire; a sensor module for acquiring a monitoring image, voice information and ignition position information; a fire information sharing means for acquiring the ignition position information, the monitoring image, and the voice information through the sensor module when a fire is detected by the fire detection module, generating fire occurrence information by combining the acquired fire position information, the monitoring image, the voice information, and the fire detection information, controlling the fire occurrence information to be wirelessly transmitted to a nearby smart fire detector by using a bio-mimetic ad-hoc network algorithm, and generating fire alarm by receiving the fire occurrence information transmitted from surroundings; and a control module for wirelessly transmitting the fire occurrence information generated in the fire information sharing means, and receiving the fire occurrence information wirelessly received to transmit the same to the fire information sharing means.
abstract_ko: 단독형 화재경보기에 무선 애드혹 네트워크(Ad hoc network) 모듈을 결합하여 기기 간에 화재 정보를 실시간으로 공유하도록 함으로써, 심야 및 부재시에도 화재발생사실을 실시간 통보하고, 정확한 발화위치 확인으로 신속한 대피가 이루어지도록 한 스마트 화재감지장치에 관한 것으로서, 화재를 감지하는 화재감지모듈, 감시 영상과 음성 정보 및 발화 위치정보를 획득하는 센서모듈, 화재감지모듈에 의해 화재가 감지되면, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해 발화 위치 정보와 감시 영상 및 음성 정보를 획득하고, 획득한 발화 위치 정보와 감시 영상과 음성 정보 및 화재 감지 정보를 조합하여 화재발생정보를 생성하고, 생체모방 애드혹 네트워크 알고리즘을 이용하여 화재발생정보를 주변 스마트 화재감지기에 무선 전파하도록 제어하며, 주변에서 전파된 화재발생정보를 수신하여 화재 경보를 발생하는 화재정보 공유수단 및 화재정보 공유수단으로부터 생성된 화재발생정보를 무선으로 전송하고, 무선으로 수신한 화재발생정보는 수신하여 화재정보 공유수단에 전달하는 관제 모듈을 포함하여 스마트 화재감지장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network node based on software definition and data transmission method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a wireless ad hoc network node based on software definition and a data transmission method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data to be sent through an application layer according to an application programming interface pre-configured in a software configuration mode and transmitting the target data to a control layer; packaging the target data by using transmission parameters pre-configured by a control layer in a software configuration mode to generate a first message and transmitting the first message to a base layer; the transmission parameters comprise transmission priority and/or transmission routing mode; the message header comprises a target node and a receiving node; and controlling the transmission time slot configured by the base layer at the control layer through the control layer according to the transmission priority and/or the transmission routing mode of the first message, and sending the first message to the receiving node in the first message through the wireless port. The wireless ad hoc network adopting the technical scheme can be flexibly suitable for various scenes and various different applications of compatible butt-joint users, and meets the individual requirements of different users on the wireless ad hoc network.

title_en: More radio frequency multi-channel wireless network method for channel allocation
abstract_en: The invention discloses the method for channel allocation in a kind of more radio frequency multi-Channel Wireless Mesh Networks, this method is based on minimum weight link interference and establishes an integral linear programming model, not only consider to minimize network interferences, network load flow is had also contemplated, while also guaranteeing network connectivty as far as possible.By introducing node priority and link load weight, by the node in network according to the minimum hop count divided rank of off-network artis, and allocation order is determined according to link load weight.Using greedy heuritic approach solving model, the circulation channel distribution of network is realized using the method for traversal, obtains optimal channel assignment scheme, it is very simple and be easily achieved, it has a good application prospect.

title_en: Sidelink quality of service management in autonomous mode for a wireless communication system and related methods and apparatus
abstract_en: A method of operating a user equipment, UE, for device-to-device, D2D, communication is disclosed. The method includes receiving subscription information from another UE. The subscription information identifies resources that another UE is subscribing to for transmission by the other UE and also includes priority information. The method also includes selectively transmitting preemption signaling based on whether the received priority information indicates a lower priority than local priority information associated with a transmission to be scheduled by the UE. The preemption signaling indicates the UE's preemption for using the resources identified by the subscription information. The method also includes scheduling the UE to transmit using the resources identified by the subscription information.

title_en: A kind of railway freight-car operating status wireless monitor system
abstract_en: The railway freight-car operating status wireless monitor system of the utility model, including sensing node, aggregation node, communication network, Zhou Wen data center, Railway Bureau and car transfer center, sensing node or aggregation node are provided on the bearing cap of railway freight-car, sensing node is sent to aggregation node comprising the information including temperature for acquisition in the form of ad hoc network, and aggregation node sends data to Zhou Wen data center, Railway Bureau through communication network；The data of the received Railway Bureau's car transfer center of Zhou Wen data center, Railway Bureau, are issued to aggregation node and sensing node through communication network.The wireless monitor system of the utility model, realize the on-line monitoring to railway freight-car operational process middle (center) bearing temperature, and the data of acquisition can be uploaded to Zhou Wen data center, Railway Bureau and car transfer center, when the bearing temperature for train occur is more than given threshold, then alert, so that field personnel detects, repairs, the generation of safety accident is avoided.

title_en: Wireless smoke alarm and smog alert system based on Mesh networking technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of wireless smoke alarm based on Mesh networking technology, belong to fire-fighting equipment technical field, including wireless smoke alarm main body, Smoke Detection module, signal processing module, wireless communication module, micro-control unit, sound and light alarm module, Smoke Detection module is embedded to be arranged in wireless smoke alarm main body, Smoke Detection module and signal processing module communicate to connect, micro-control unit respectively with signal processing module, wireless communication module, sound and light alarm module communication connection, the wireless communication module of wireless communication module and other wireless smoke alarms can carry out Mesh networking by Mesh networking technology, form Mesh network.The laying of smoke alarm is avoided to be routed and the limitation of hosi wireless communication range by Mesh network.Wireless smoke alarm and smog alert system provided by the utility model based on Mesh networking technology has the advantages that equipment cost is low, builds and later maintenance is convenient, system reliability is high.
assignees: FOSHAN GUANHENG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of communication means based on the proprietary frequency range intelligence ad hoc network of 230MHz electric power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of communication means based on the proprietary frequency range intelligence ad hoc network of 230MHz electric power, are related to the electric power data acquisition communications field.Linear topology structure is mainly used between electric power data acquisition equipment at present, that there are the coverage areas of networking is small, transmission range is close, network address distributes challenge.The invention includes the following steps: replying response after other nodes in transmission range coverage area receive networking application；After sending the path data that the node for networking and applying receives multiple adjacent nodes returns, sorts by the few priority rule preferential, that the identical then signal of level is strong of central node level, successively send networking checking request to each path；If the node for sending the verifying that networks receives central node authentication successful message, completes to network, and update routing table, current routed path is set as defaulting.The technical program is solved the problems, such as because ensure that effective building of wireless network apart from can not far carry out point-to-point direct wireless telecommunications.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUAYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Peer to peer location updates
abstract_en: Systems, methods and computer-readable media are obtaining location updates of a tracking device via peer to peer communication with other nearby devices where obtaining such update is otherwise not possible. In one aspect, a method includes receiving, at a device, a first location update from a network component; determining, by the device, if a triggering condition is met for determining a second location update; activating, by the device, device-to-device communication for receiving the second location update from nearby devices in vicinity of the device when the triggering condition is met receiving the second location update from at least one of the nearby devices via the device-to-device communication; and sending the second location update to a server for the server to determine an arrival alert for alerting a destination of an amount of time remaining until the device reaches the destination.

title_en: Intelligent transmission method for monitoring data of power distribution network based on mesh structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent transmission method for monitoring data of a power distribution network based on a mesh structure, which comprises the following steps: each monitoring terminal in the power distribution network is regarded as a node, and each node adopts a mesh structure to form a network; dividing a plurality of networking nodes into node clusters in a mesh network; if the multi-hop network exists in the node cluster, the data is transmitted by adopting a learning networking, and if the multi-hop network does not exist, the data is transmitted by adopting a polling mode; determining the priority of the information transmission of the core node according to the grading of the core node; the gateway gathers the uploaded data of the core node and transmits the data to a background server for information processing; the mesh network structure is widely used in a power distribution network in the prior art, however, as the scale of the mesh network structure is continuously enlarged, the multi-hop mesh structure also has the problems of bandwidth reduction, network delay and the like.

title_en: Method and apparatus for prioritizing mission critical push to talk traffic during an emergency
abstract_en: Methods and apparatuses for prioritizing Mission Critical Push to Talk Traffic during an emergency. Embodiments disclosed herein relate to wireless communication networks, and more particularly to mission critical services in Long Term Evolution (LTE) communication networks. Embodiments herein disclose a channel sensitive MCPTT prioritization scheduling method and system to increase the download/upload speeds for MCPTT users during the emergency situations. Embodiments herein methods and systems for prioritizing traffic for connected User Equipments (UEs) over idle UEs.

title_en: Personal tactical system and network
abstract_en: A personal tactical system including a ballistic load-bearing garment, a pouch with one or more batteries enclosed in the pouch, an electronic processor, a communication device, and at least one camera. The camera is incorporated into or removably attachable to the load-bearing garment, the pouch is removably attachable to the load-bearing garment and the one or more batteries are operable to power the camera and communication device. The processor runs image recognition software operable to identify approaching objects and alert the user. A plurality of personal tactical systems is operable to form an ad hoc network to share images and other information for determining object direction, location, and movement.
assignees: LAT ENTPR INC D/B/A MEDIPAK ENERGY SYSTEM;LAT ENTPR INC D/B/A MEDIPAK ENERGY SYSTEMS

title_en: Apparatus and method for routing of wireless ad-hoc network
title_ko: 무선 애드 혹 네트워크의 라우팅 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for routing a route from a wireless ad hoc network to a destination node. The present invention comprises: a receiver for receiving wireless signals from neighboring nodes; a transmitter for transmitting the wireless signals to the neighboring nodes; and a controller for transmitting a specific message to the neighboring nodes according to a preset period, and receiving the specific message from each of the neighboring nodes, calculating the loss probability and low quality rate of the specific message received for a certain period of time, calculating first and second cost vectors corresponding to the routes to each neighboring node based on the calculated loss probability and low quality rate, setting the route corresponding to each of the neighboring nodes by giving priority to the route having a small first cost vector, and generating a routing table including node identification information of a next hop according to a set route. Accordingly, more stable and reliable routing is performed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선 애드혹 네트워크에서 목적지 노드까지의 경로를 설정(routing)하는 장치 및 방법에 대한 것으로, 인접한 이웃 노드들로부터 무선 신호를 수신하는 수신부와, 상기 이웃 노드들에 무선 신호를 전송하는 송신부 및, 기 설정된 주기에 따라 상기 이웃 노드들에 특정 메시지를 전송 및 상기 이웃 노드들 각각으로부터 특정 메시지를 수신하며, 일정 시간동안 수신된 상기 특정 메시지의 손실확률과 저품질률을 산출 및, 산출된 손실확률과 저품질률에 근거하여 각 이웃 노드까지의 경로에 대응하는 제1 및 제2 비용벡터를 산출하고, 작은 값의 제1 비용벡터를 가지는 경로를 우선하여 상기 이웃 노드들 각각에 대응하는 경로를 설정하며, 설정된 경로에 따라 다음 홉의 노드 식별정보를 포함하는 라우팅(routing) 테이블을 생성하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Content cachhing mehtod using mobile cache
title_ko: 이동성을 갖는 캐시를 활용한 콘텐츠 캐싱 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a method for caching content by using at least one mobile helper with mobility in a wireless communication cell coverage by a base station. Here, the mobile helper provides content through a device to device (D2D) communication in a relation between a plurality of general communication terminals existing in the cell coverage. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for caching content can comprise the steps of: (a) dividing a requested content into chunk units; (b) calculating D2D communication coverage for each chunk by considering content consumption time; (c) rearranging content preferences in chunk units by reflecting the calculated D2D communication coverage for each chunk; and (d) determining a priority for each chunk to be stored in a cache of the mobile helper based on the content preferences rearranged in chunk units.
abstract_ko: 기지국에 의한 무선 통신 셀 커버리지 내에서 이동성을 갖는 적어도 하나의 모바일 헬퍼를 이용하는 콘텐츠 캐싱 방법이 제공된다. 여기서, 상기 모바일 헬퍼는 상기 셀 커버리지 내에 존재하는 다수의 일반 통신 단말과의 관계에서 D2D(Device to Device) 통신을 통한 콘텐츠 제공을 수행하다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 콘텐츠 캐싱 방법은, (a) 요청된 콘텐츠를 청크(chunk) 단위로 구분하는 단계; (b) 콘텐츠 소비 시간을 고려하여 청크 별 D2D 통신 커버리지를 계산하는 단계; (c) 계산된 청크 별 D2D 통신 커버리지를 반영하여 콘텐츠 선호도를 청크 단위로 재정렬하는 단계; (d) 청크 단위로 재정렬된 콘텐츠 선호도에 기초하여 상기 모바일 헬퍼의 캐시에 저장할 청크 별 우선순위를 결정하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Enhanced procedures for sending emergency messages to multiple mobile devices
abstract_en: In a method of device-to-device communication, a user device initially sends an emergency message repeatedly at a first repeating frequency. When a specified number acknowledgement (ACK) messages are received, the user device sends the emergency message repeatedly at a reduced repeating frequency. The repeating frequency may be further reduced when more ACK messages are received.

title_en: Wireless resource-allocation system and method
abstract_en: A wireless resource-allocation system applied in a Wi-Fi mesh network is provided. The wireless resource-allocation system includes a target device, a first wireless access device, a second wireless access device, a third wireless access device, and a server. The first wireless access device obtains address information of the target device from the probe request from the target device. The third wireless access device receives the address information of the target device from the first wireless access device and sends a confirmation response. The confirmation response is generated according to the address information. Responsive to that the confirmation response indicates that the target device passes authentication, the first wireless access device and the third wireless access device provide the target device with a highest priority in the Wi-Fi mesh network.

title_en: Mission-critical user priority-based random access method and apparatus for collision resolution in coexisting PS-LTE and LTE-M network
abstract_en: Proposed are a mission-critical user priority-based random access method and apparatus for a collision resolution in a coexisting PS-LTE and LTE-M network. The MCHP-RA method includes broadcasting information as part of a system information block (SIB) 2 in order for an eNB to allocate a random access channel (RACH) slot in a network environment in which an LTE-based public safety (PS-LTE) network and an LTE-based marine (LTE-M) network coexist, selecting an emergency slot as a next RACH slot when the number of mission-critical high priority-based user equipments (MCHP UEs) is greater than a predefined threshold and processing the MCHP UEs during a random access procedure, and selecting a normal slot as a next RACH slot when the number of MCHP UEs is smaller than a predefined threshold and processing the MCHP UEs, wherein the eNB may allocate the RACH slot based on configurations in order to prevent a preamble collision.

title_en: Ad hoc network route determining method based on link quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-organizing network route determining method based on link quality, firstly, maintaining an effective adjacent node set through all nodes in the self-organizing network; then, route maintenance is carried out based on the adjacent node set, and forwarding nodes of the next hop in the route forwarding process are determined according to the packet loss rate of the adjacent nodes in the route maintenance stage; each node in the adjacent node set stores a HELLO message queue, and when an optimal route of the route is selected, the more adjacent nodes in the HELLO message queue are defined, the higher the priority in the route selection process is. The method has the advantages of high delivery rate of the data packet, capability of improving the network throughput of the ad hoc network, reducing the transmission delay and reducing the transmission delay jitter.

title_en: Parental control for bluetooth mesh devices
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for controlling mesh network devices are described. The method includes receiving, by an automation device, a first message from a control device, adding, by the automation device, the identifier of the first user device to a priority list of the automation device based on receiving the first message, and controlling, by the automation device, access to operations of the automation device based on the identifier in the priority list after adding the identifier of the first user device. In some cases, the first message includes an identifier of a first user device and an add command.

title_en: Congestion control and priority handling in device-to-device (d2d) communications
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a first wireless communication device may iterate a value of a channel access counter (CAC) to a trigger value based at least in part on configuring the value of the CAC. In some aspects, the first wireless communication device may utilize a channel access mechanism to select a set of time-frequency resources for a transmission of a packet based at least in part on iterating the value of the CAC to the trigger value. In some aspects, the first wireless communication device may transmit the packet to a second wireless communication device via the set of time-frequency resources based at least in part on utilizing the channel access mechanism to select the set of time-frequency resources for the transmission. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Network access synchronization method and device for nodes in ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network access synchronization method and a network access synchronization device for nodes in an ad hoc network, which are used for solving the problem that the existing scheme is not suitable for the network access scenes of the nodes with different clock sources. The method comprises the following steps: the first node determines the synchronization priority of the first node according to the availability of an external clock source; when the synchronization priority of the first node is a first priority and the first node senses a synchronization signal broadcast by a second node, acquiring the synchronization priority of the second node, wherein the second node is a neighbor node of the first node; and when the synchronization priority of the second node is the first priority, the first node executes a network access synchronization process according to the synchronization signal of the second node.
assignees: Datang mobile communications equipment co ltd

title_en: Air-ground integrated police ad hoc network system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air-ground integration is alert with from network deployment system, this system have used modified Mesh to equip from network deployment, Mesh equip from network deployment include Mesh wireless network module, with the network communication module that Mesh wireless network module output is connected, respectively with HDMI module, the standard interface module that network communication module input is connected have realized supporting functions such as HDMI audio and video access, support national standard (GB/T28181-2016) standard. The unmanned aerial vehicle air investigation audio and video stream can be transmitted into the Mesh ad hoc network equipment through an HDMI interface in real time, and the equipment is in butt joint with a system in a public security video network according to a national standard protocol, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle investigation audio and video can be transmitted into the public security video network through a city monitoring video pole, and finally, video investigation air-ground integrated commanding and scheduling are realized. The equipment can meet the task requirements of large-scale activity security, group events, urban emergency rescue and disaster relief and the like.
assignees: VIDEO CRIMINAL INVESTIG DETACHMENT WUHAN MUNICIPAL PUBLIC SECURITY BUREAU

title_en: Help calling system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distress system, including total accuse basic station, back field communication device, repeater and the device of calling for help that is equipped with ad hoc network wireless communication module, the device of calling for help includes calling for help ware and arm package, and the calling for help ware includes first to fourth task pilot lamp and first to fourth alarm button, and wherein first to fourth task pilot lamp is the flashing lamp of different colours respectively, and first to fourth alarm button respectively has the three-dimensional button of the different shapes of a normally bright lamp in the middle of for the third. The task pilot lamp of a plurality of colours can realize that voice broadcast and light warning combine, accomplishes the information reception under the complex environment better, and three-dimensional alert feelings button also is favorable to the fire fighter in time to send the rescue signal or send the safety degree affirmation signal of self to the back commander under various dangerous condition, and the arm package formula design also makes the saving alarm can wear fast simultaneously, facilitates the use, is difficult for dropping.
assignees: XIAMEN WUZHILIAN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-powered smart alarm system
title_ko: 자가발전이 가능한 스마트 알람 경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart alarm system. According to the present invention, signal transmission is performed by R/F wireless communication and power line communication for performing transmission with a communication signal included in a commercial power line so that a complex wired connection configuration can be replaced with a simple wireless configuration or a simple power line configuration. In addition, communication is performed by one or both of the power line communication and the R/F wireless communication depending on communication-restricted zones so that an accident attributable to communication loss can be prevented. Each alarm device is provided with a human body detection sensor unit and thus it is possible to prevent a worker′s or inspector′s hearing loss by automatically reducing a siren or electronic horn sound in the event of worker or inspector detection around the alarm device. A separate remote controller is provided so that the alarm device installed at a height out of a person′s reach fulfills a test function so that wired or wireless connection and control are possible therebetween. As a result, when crew members and users perform regular tests and equipment inspection, the present invention provides efficient functions to efficiently manage a product and prevent the risk of falling.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트형 알람 경보시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 상용 전력선에 통신 신호를 포함하여 전송하는 전력선 통신 및 알에프 무선 통신으로 신호를 전달함으로써, 복잡한 유선 연결 구성을 무선 혹은 전력선으로만 간단하게 구성하며, 통신 제약 지역에 따라 전력선 통신, 알에프 무선 통신 중 적어도 어느 하나 이상으로 통신하도록 함으로써, 통신 두절에 따른 사고를 방지할 수 있으며, 알람경보장치마다 인체감지센서부를 구성하여 알람경보장치 주변에서 작업자 혹은 검사자가 감지되면 사이렌 혹은 전자혼 소리를 자동으로 낮추어 작업자 혹은 검사자의 청각 손실을 방지할 수 있도록 하며, 사람의 손이 닿지 않는 높이에 설치된 알람경보장치의 테스트 기능을 수행하기 위하여 별도의 리모컨을 구성하여 이들 간에 유선 또는 무선으로 연결하여 컨트롤할 수 있도록 함으로써, 선원들 및 사용자들로 하여금 정기적으로 테스트 수행 및 장비 점검시 효율적인 기능을 제공하여 제품의 효율적인 관리 및 낙상 사고의 위험을 방지할 수 있는 스마트형 알람 경보시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: L oRa technology-based pneumatic hammer wireless automatic control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a L oRa technique-based pneumatic hammer wireless automatic control system, including the field control device, central control unit and pneumatic hammer, the field control device is connected and is located the pneumatic hammer on scene, field control unit carries out remote communication with central control unit, adopt one of RS-485 communication and L oRa communication between field control unit and the central control unit as main communication module, select the module that the speed of response data is faster as main communication module, this pneumatic hammer wireless automatic control system adopts L oRa protocol to transmit control signal and obtain equipment operating mode, avoided pulling the signal line in large scale, adopt the ad hoc network, avoided using the signal instability that mobile network brought, and adopt the polling mode to obtain equipment state, adopt the highest priority level to carry out operating instruction, ensure that equipment normally works, the equipment quantity controlled, the throughput who limits in main control unit can satisfy the needs of most scenes.

title_en: Managing interrupt detection and reporting
abstract_en: Systems and methods for detecting node outages in a mesh network are disclosed. A tracking node in a mesh network detects a set of signals originating from tracked nodes in the mesh network. The set of signals includes beacons and communication messages transmitted by the tracked nodes. The tracking node determines that a threshold number of active beacon intervals have elapsed since the last signal was received from the tracked node. The tracing node then outputs a probe to the traced node, which requests a response to the probe. When no response to the probe is received from the tracked node, the tracking node sends an outage alert message to the next topologically higher layer of the mesh network, the outage alert message including an identification of the tracked node.

title_en: Border-gateway-based method and system for migrating task of underwater ad hoc network
abstract_en: Disclosed are a border-gateway-based method and system for migrating a task of an underwater ad hoc network. The technical solution thereof comprises: selecting a border gateway used for task migration management; adding sensor node information to a resource manager of the border gateway; the border gateway arranging the sensor node information so as to form a priority ranking of nodes in a resource queue; the border gateway arranging task information of an original sensor node in descending order according to task priorities and placing the task information in a task queue of a task manager, and selecting the optimal task cooperation node; and migrating a task to the task cooperation node by means of the border gateway for task calculation, and sending a calculation result to the original sensor node. By means of the present invention, a node of an underwater ad hoc network sends collected subsea heterogeneous data to the nearest border gateway; and the border gateway also migrates a task of a resource-constrained node to a resource-rich node to cooperatively complete the task, such that the network load is balanced, the energy consumption of nodes is reduced, and the observation efficiency of ocean data is improved.
assignees: INST OCEANOGRAPHIC INSTR SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Dynamic ad hoc network mobile cloud computing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic ad hoc network mobile cloud computing system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the mobile cloud service device comprises terminal nodes used for data acquisition, storage and calculation processing, a terminal ad hoc network module which is in signal connection with the terminal nodes and realizes terminal ad hoc network and communication, a layered and graded cloud computing architecture is adopted to realize data naming, encryption forwarding and calculation, and calculation processing nodes are distributed according to tasks with different priorities and complexity as required. The layered and graded cloud computing architecture is adopted, resources are allocated according to tasks and applications with different priorities and complexity as required, transverse and longitudinal expansion and load balance of mobile cloud computing capacity are easy to achieve, overall computing efficiency of the system is improved, and therefore real-time, efficient and accurate processing of various tasks is guaranteed.

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable intelligent fire prediction IoT sensor kit using wireless mesh and AI. As soon as power is applied, a sensor node composes a sensor network which can immediately transmit device information, measurement values, or the like of a sensor node itself to all the sensor nodes and intelligent connection nodes at low power through all adjacent sensor nodes and a wireless mesh network. When the sensor network is configured, the sensor node transmits measured sensor data through another sensor node or directly transmits to the intelligent connection node at a certain period or the moment when the data occurs in accordance with types. The intelligent connection node receives all the sensor data transmitted by the sensor node, stores the sensor data in a database of the control unit, and transmits the sensor data to a backend system. The control unit generates and modifies an artificial intelligence algorithm for predicting and determining the occurrence of fire through the sensor, location, and node information data in the database. Since fire detection, analysis, and prediction are possible by the sensor data, sensor data errors are removed, corrected, and accurate data is accumulated, so that an optimal prediction algorithm is generated and utilized.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적으로 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다. 
      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SOC, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: Methods and systems for detecting and distributing encoded alert data
abstract_en: A method for detecting and distributing alert data based upon both receiving alert data encoded in a terrestrial television broadcast transmission and receiving an identification of a location of a device includes receiving, by a first device in a plurality of devices in a mesh network, a terrestrial broadcast signal including at least one datacast packet. A second device in the plurality of devices receives a satellite transmission identifying a location of the second device. The method includes confirming, by a notification engine executed by a third device in the plurality of devices in the mesh network, receipt of both the satellite transmission and alert data encoded in the terrestrial broadcast signal. The method includes activating, by the notification engine, at least one alert module in the mesh network, upon confirmation of the receipt of both the satellite transmission and the alert data encoded in the terrestrial broadcast signal.

title_en: Method for improving transmission efficiency of wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the transmission efficiency of a wireless ad hoc network, wherein communication nodes report parameters related to transmission priority to a central control node, and the central control node calculates the transmission priority of each communication node according to the acquired parameters and a preset algorithm; selecting candidate nodes meeting a threshold to form a candidate node set according to a preset transmission priority threshold; selecting a candidate node with the highest priority as a mandatory sending node, and scheduling the mandatory sending node by the central control node to send data in a transmission time slot # n; judging whether the other candidate nodes except the optional sending node can be used as the optional sending node according to a preset judgment rule and the transmission priority from high to low; the central control node schedules the optional transmitting node to transmit data in transmission time slot # n. According to the invention, two or more concurrent transmissions in the network are coordinated through the scheduling method, so that the problem that the concurrent transmissions cannot be carried out due to co-channel interference is avoided, and the network transmission efficiency is improved.

title_en: Communication method of centerless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication method of a centerless ad hoc network, which comprises the following steps: s1: setting the identification code of each node and the priority of the identification code; s2: dynamically allocating time slot sequence and adaptively adjusting transmission rate according to the sequence of each node of the access network and the priority of the identification code; s3: each node receives and transmits data according to the time slot sequence, only one node transmits data in the same time slot, the other nodes receive the data, and the data is transmitted in a broadcasting mode. The invention specially designs a universal time slot structure, which is convenient for receiving and transmitting control and information identification at the network nodes and quick response when the nodes are increased or decreased; the time slot sequence of each node is dynamically distributed, and the time slot sequence is redistributed to be expanded to a centerless ad hoc network of a plurality of nodes, so that the information intercommunication and interconnection among the nodes can be realized; by adopting the MSK modulation mode, the time slot length can be divided more flexibly, and the method is suitable for the centerless ad hoc network communication of hundreds of narrow-band networking nodes or more than ten broadband networking nodes.

title_en: Police unmanned aerial vehicle cluster investigation combat equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a police unmanned aerial vehicle cluster investigation combat equipment, which is formed by refitting a police unmanned aerial vehicle, adding an external MCU control module, a Mesh ad hoc network module and an RF-Link module, and realizing the ad hoc network cooperative communication of a plurality of police unmanned aerial vehicles so as to form a cluster; and data are transmitted to the ground station through the RF-Link wireless communication module and then transmitted to the background server through the data conversion module, and finally the command control management terminal can check and control the police unmanned aerial vehicle to realize the function of cluster reconnaissance combat. The utility model discloses combine together secondary flight control technique, Mesh from network deployment communication technology, RF-Link wireless communication technique, cooperate corresponding backend server and command control management terminal, realize that it is alert with unmanned aerial vehicle cluster investigation combat equipment, have fine application prospect and spreading value.
assignees: VIDEO CRIMINAL INVESTIG DETACHMENT WUHAN MUNICIPAL PUBLIC SECURITY BUREAU

title_en: Apparatus and method for performing scheduling in ad hoc networks
title_ko: 무선 애드혹 네트워크에서 스케줄링을 수행하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided are an apparatus for performing scheduling in a wireless ad hoc network and a method thereof. According to the present invention, each node can exchange messages with 1-hop adjacent nodes, and determine the priority of each node based on the number of 2-hop adjacent nodes and random values included in the messages. Moreover, each node can allocate a slot for each node in accordance with the priority, and schedule each node based on the slot corresponding to each node. Therefore, the present invention is capable of reducing wasted time caused by a collision during a slot scheduling procedure.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 애드혹 네트워크에서 스케줄링을 수행하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.  
본 발명에서는, 각 노드들이 1-홉 이웃노드들과 메시지를 교환하고, 메시지에 포함된 2-홉 이웃노드 수 및 랜덤 값에 기초하여 각 노드들의 우선순위를 결정할 수 있다. 또한, 우선순위에 따라 각 노드들에 대한 슬롯을 할당하고, 각 노드들에 대응되는 상기 슬롯에 기초하여 상기 각 노드들을 스케줄링할 수 있다.

title_en: Mission-critical user priority-based cooperative resource allocation schemes and apparatus for multi-layer next-generation public safety networks
title_ko: 다층 구조의 차세대 공공안전통신망을 위한 위기임무 사용자 우선권 기반 협력 자원 할당 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a scheme and an apparatus for mission-critical user priority-based cooperative resource allocation for a multi-layer next-generation public safety network. The scheme includes: a step of identifying an attacker eNB and a user in need of CoMP through a CoMP scheduler and performing storage in a CoMP set; a step of determining scheduling regarding an LTE-R network user (U_R) with respect to the CoMP site (S_R) attacker eNB in an LTE-R network; and a step of determining scheduling regarding the rest of the users (U_P and U_M) in each CoMP site in PS-LTE and LTE-M networks in accordance with competition rules.
abstract_ko: 다층 구조의 차세대 공공안전통신망을 위한 위기임무 사용자 우선권 기반 협력 자원 할당 방법 및 장치가 제시된다. 본 발명에서 제안하는 다층 구조의 차세대 공공안전통신망을 위한 위기임무 사용자 우선권 기반 협력 자원 할당 방법은 CoMP 스케줄러를 통해 CoMP를 필요로 하는 사용자와 해당 공격자 eNB를 식별하여, CoMP 세트에 저장하는 단계, LTE-R 네트워크에서의 CoMP 사이트(S R ) 공격자 eNB에 대하여 LTE-R 네트워크의 사용자( U     R   )에 대한 스케줄링을 결정하는 단계 및 PS-LTE 및 LTE-M 네트워크에서의 각 CoMP 사이트 내의 나머지 사용자( U     P    및  U     M   )에 대한 스케줄링을 경쟁 규칙에 따라 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for RF tripwire based intrusion detection
abstract_en: Systems and methods for detecting a presence of a target such as a vehicle, an animal, a person, or another object in a monitored area without the use of sensors, are provided. Multiple RF field anomaly detection nodes may be spaced through the monitored area and connected, such as in a mesh network. The RF field anomaly detection nodes may include radio transceivers that communicate with one another and which monitor a signal strength of received signals. The nodes may compare the signal strengths to expected strength values. As a target enters a portion of the monitored area, the dielectric properties of the target cause at least one signal strength of at least one received signal to change. The RF field anomaly detection nodes may detect this change and trigger a further action or human readable alert corresponding to the presence of the target.

title_en: A fire monitoring system of automatic notification in real time and method thereof
title_ko: 실시간으로 자동 통보가 가능한 화재 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a fire monitoring system, which comprises: an IoT platform server which monitors events in real time through flame detectors and weather data collectors; and a plurality of application servers which receive a field dispatch request message for an event from the IoT platform server in the form of an SMS and are connected through a mesh network. The application server is limitedly included in a device of a participant who has received an authentication link for security. The SMS may be sequentially delivered between participants based on a predetermined priority.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 화재 감시 시스템은, 불꽃 감지기와 기상 데이터 수집기를 통해 이벤트를 실시간으로 모니터링하는 IoT플랫폼 서버; 및 IoT 플랫폼 서버로부터 이벤트에 대한 현장 출동 요청 메세지를 SMS 형태로 수신하며 메쉬 네트워크를 통해 연결되는 복수의 어플리케이션 서버;를 포함하고, 어플리케이션 서버는 보안용 인증 링크를 수신한 참여자의 디바이스에 한정되어 포함되며, SMS는 미리 결정된 우선 순위에 기초하여 참여자 사이에서 순차적으로 전달될 수 있다.

title_en: Secured distributed mesh network
abstract_en: In accordance with some embodiments, a method of operating a user-equipment (UE) gateway device to establish access for an end-point device coupled to the UE gateway device includes receiving a connection request from the end-point device; creating a registry entry with a digital identity for the end-point device in a security registry of the UE gateway device, transmitting a second registry entry derived from the registry entry to a network device coupled to the UE gateway device, recording activities with devices in communications with the end-point device into the registry entry, and locking the registry entry in the security registry after a set period of time. Security registries are recorded in network devices and communications with then end-point device may be monitored and alerts provided according to the registry entries for the end-point devices in the security registries.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster ad hoc network channel access method based on interference priority
