abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster ad hoc network channel access method based on interference priority, which sets a control information sending priority level of an unmanned aerial vehicle node correspondingly through an interference signal intensity level acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle node, adjusts a local control data sending sequence corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle node by using the control information sending priority level, and then selects and adjusts the length of a competition window by using a discrete three-dimensional Markov model and a self-adaptive random channel access method, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster adapts to different communication interference environments, the throughput of high-communication interference priority data transmission is improved, the communication delay is reduced, the energy consumption of a system is not increased, the QoS of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster ad hoc network is effectively ensured, and the survival capability of the cluster in a complex electromagnetic spectrum environment is further improved.

title_en: Small data message merging method for wireless ad hoc network data synchronization
abstract_en: The invention provides a small datagram combination method for wireless self-organizing network data synchronization, which comprises the following steps: judging whether the data is the small message data, if so, entering the next step, and otherwise, directly transmitting the data; determining a fixed transmission path from a source node to a destination node; calculating the waiting merging probability according to the priority score; sequencing the merging waiting probabilities of the relay nodes, and screening the first q subsequences as the relay nodes for merging; establishing multi-hop transmission of small message data with a target node, if the waiting merging probability of each relay node triggers merging waiting, entering the next step, otherwise, transmitting the small message data to the target node; the small message data waits for L minutes at the node, and if k small message data with the same destination address exist in the waiting time, data combination is carried out; otherwise, after any one small message data reaches the waiting time, merging all the small message data at present; the merged data message is transmitted to a destination node; after receiving the message, the destination node updates the priority score and sends the message to each source node through a confirmation message to store the updated information.
assignees: THE 7TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Prioritized communication windows in a wireless mesh network
abstract_en: A wireless network may include a server, a network, a network access device and a plurality of nodes configured to communicate wirelessly. Messages may be communicated through the network wirelessly in an uncoordinated manner. Some nodes may be assigned a first priority indicating that the node has a higher priority than other nodes assigned a second priority. During a certain time period or window, referred to as a “quality of service window,” nodes assigned the first priority may continue transmitting in the uncoordinated manner, while nodes associated with the second priority may wait to transmit their messages until after the expiration of the quality of service window. Thus, during the quality of service window, there should be less congestion since nodes assigned the second priority remain quiet, thereby increasing the likelihood that messages transmitted by the nodes assigned the first priority will be successfully communicated.

title_en: Communication method and related device of wireless self-organizing network
abstract_en: The application discloses a communication method and a related device of a wireless ad hoc network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the forwarding node of the wireless self-organizing network judges whether the service quality priorities of a plurality of groups of data streams to be forwarded are the same; if yes, the current route hop count of each group of data flows to be forwarded is obtained; based on the current route hop count of each group of data flows to be forwarded, the data flows to be forwarded are selected to be forwarded preferentially, and by the mode, a service flow forwarding mechanism can be further improved, and the priority forwarding of the high-priority service flows is guaranteed.

title_en: Methods for dynamically optimizing a flying ad-hoc network
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for dynamically optimizing a Flying Ad-Hoc Network (“FANET”). A server that manages the FANET can receive information relating to the network activity of user devices connected to the FANET. Examples of the type of information included can include the user devices' locations, network connection quality, and network traffic volume dedicated to a Unified Endpoint Management (“UEM”) system of an enterprise. The server can analyze the network activity information based on a set of rules to prioritize the user devices connected to the FANET. The server can instruct unmanned aerial vehicles (“UAVs”) in the FANET to reposition themselves to provide the best connection for higher priority user devices.
assignees: ALUVALA SUMAN;PANCHAPAKESAN RAMANI;SHETTY ROHIT PRADEEP;VMWARE INC

title_en: Cluster talkback talk right seizing method and device for mesh ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cluster talkback talk right seizing method and a device for a mesh ad hoc network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a plurality of terminals are connected to a mesh ad hoc network, acquiring identity information of the plurality of terminals, wherein the identity information comprises: user name and speech right holding state; before the speaking right seizing terminal initiates the cluster service, a seizing message is sent to the speaking right owning terminal; if the speaking right owner terminal does not speak currently, sending successful speaking right preemption information to the speaking right preemption terminal; and if the speaking right owning terminal is speaking currently and the priority of the speaking right owning terminal is lower than that of the speaking right preempting terminal, sending speaking right preempting success information to the speaking right preempting terminal. According to the preemption method provided by the invention, the speech right preemption terminal directly negotiates with the speech right owning terminal, namely an end-to-end negotiation mode, so that the interaction times can be reduced, and the signaling is easily ensured.
assignees: JIANGSU HUAIYE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and System for Urgent Message Service Using BLE
title_ko: Ｂｌｅ를 이용한 긴급 메시지 서비스 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for an emergency message service using Bluetooth low energy (BLE). The method according to the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving a BLE advertiser packet including emergency message content; checking whether the received BLE advertiser packet is firstly received; displaying, when the BLE advertiser packet is firstly received, the emergency message content included in the BLE advertiser packet on an emergency message chat window; and advertising the BLE advertiser packet. According to the present invention, emergency messages can be exchanged even in a network disconnection situation in which mobile data communication such as 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, etc. or Wi-Fi communication is not performed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 BLE(Bluetooth Low Energy)를 이용한 긴급 메시지 서비스 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 방법은 긴급 메시지 내용를 포함하는 BLE 애드버타이저 패킷을 수신하는 단계, 수신된 BLE 애드버타이저 패킷의 최초 수신 여부를 확인하는 단계, BLE 애드버타이저 패킷이 최초 수신된 것이면, BLE 애드버타이저 패킷에 포함된 긴급 메시지 내용을 긴급 메시지 대화창에 표시하는 단계, 그리고 BLE 애드버타이저 패킷을 애드버타이징(advertising) 하는 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G 등의 이동 데이터 통신이나 와이파이 통신이 되지 않는 네트워크 단절 상황에서도 긴급 메시지를 교환할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for dynamic mesh network discovery
abstract_en: A system and method for dynamic mesh network discovery is disclosed. In embodiments, the system assigns each network asset (e.g., unmanned or manned aircraft or like mobile nodes) a unique asset number. Each asset has a controller coupled to a datalink including antenna elements and a memory for storing an asset table. Each asset periodically broadcasts an asset status message including the asset number. When a status message is received, the receiving asset compares the received asset number to its own asset number. If the received asset number is higher (e.g., of lower priority) than its own asset number, the receiving asset establishes a bidirectional mesh network connection to the broadcasting asset. Assets on the receiving end of a network connection interrogate the establishing asset for its asset number, such that assets on both sides of the connection know the identity of the other and update their asset tables accordingly.

title_en: Relay node guided multi-hop mobile ad hoc network MAC layer communication method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-hop mobile ad hoc network MAC layer communication method guided by relay nodes, wherein the relay nodes are the guide of the whole protocol program, the protocol is initiated by the relay nodes, any node can become other nodes to inquire the relay nodes in a transmission path, after the relay nodes collect the information to be transmitted, the priority transmission meeting the exchange transmission condition between the two nodes is selected, and then the transmission is carried out according to the first-in first-out principle; after the transmission is completed, the broadcast informs the neighboring nodes to delete the successfully transmitted information from the transmission sequence to the neighboring nodes. The invention changes the original relay node to only undertake the auxiliary or cooperative function, and sets the relay node as the leader of the whole protocol program, solves the problems of high time delay and low throughput of the original unidirectional transmission mode taking the transmission node as the leading factor, and can maintain the network stability, reduce the transmission delay, and improve the network throughput and the transmission efficiency particularly under the condition of more nodes.

title_en: Method and system for providing priority communication in a mission-critical push-to-talk (mcptt) service
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to method performed by a mission critical push-to-talk (MCPTT) server, the method comprises: receiving, from a first user equipment (UE), a request for a connection to communicate with one or more second UEs, wherein the request includes at least a first priority score associated with a type of the connection; determining, based on the request, a second priority score corresponding to the first UE, wherein the second priority score is associated with a type information; and performing based on the first priority score and the second priority score one of: approving the request for the connection, or rejecting the request for the connection.

title_en: Ad-hoc communication system for intelligent transportation with simultaneous transmission and sensing
abstract_en: A broadcasting vehicular ad-hoc network in an intelligent transportation system includes the provision of a vehicle capable of sensing attributes of the network even whilst transmitting packets on that network. Beneficially, a listen-whilst-transmit system allows collisions and network congestion to be detected even when a vehicle is transmitting. Based on this knowledge, the vehicle may abort transmission, modify its retransmission process, and enable prioritisation of retransmission between multiple vehicles in dependence on numerous factors, including the operating autonomous level of the different vehicles in the network. The system may further implement a system in which both periodic and aperiodic packets are transmitted in a vehicular ad-hoc network.

title_en: Smart cache control for mission-critical and high priority traffic flows
abstract_en: A system, apparatus, method, and non-transitory computer readable medium for providing smart cache control for mission-critical and high-priority traffic flows may include a network device which is caused to, extract attributes from a network packet, determine whether to request a new flow rule from a network controller for the network packet based on the extracted attributes, transmit a new flow rule request to the network controller based on results of the determining, the new flow rule request including the extracted attributes, receive the new flow rule from the network controller in response to the new flow rule request, and store the new flow rule in at least one cache memory based on priority information of the new flow rule.

title_en: Connectivity scheduler for nb-iot devices
abstract_en: A method performed by one or more network nodes of a wireless telecommunications network to schedule intermittent connectivity of multiple narrowband Internet-of-Things (NB-IoT) devices with the network. The network node(s) can maintain a connectivity schedule that includes profiles for NB-IoT devices and cause the multiple NB-IoT devices to connect to the network in accordance with the schedule at different times based on priority levels associated with the NB-IoT devices. The network node(s) can adjust the connectivity schedule in response to detection of a condition of the network or the NB-IoT device.

title_en: Method, node, and system for reducing collisions in a time-synchronized channel hopping network
abstract_en: A method for avoiding collision between a parent node and a child node in a time-slotted-channel-hopping (TSCH) mesh network is provided. For example, each node in the TSCH network can be configured to obtain a transmit offset index. At the beginning of a timeslot, the node determines its transmission priority based on the transmit offset index and an absolute slot number (ASN) of the timeslot. If the transmission priority of the node is an early transmission priority, the node transmits data packets according to the normal transmission process of the TSCH network. If the transmission priority of the node is a late transmission priority, the node enters a listen before talk (LBT) mode to listen for incoming communication on the network. If no incoming communications are detected during the LBT mode, the node then transmits data packets according to the normal transmission process of the TSCH network.

title_en: Relay device management based on data priority level
abstract_en: A relay (UE) receives, from a source UE device, a source transmission comprising destination device data and a relay indicator indicating that the destination device data is to be transmitted to a destination UE device. The relay UE device determines whether other communication data is pending transmission to another UE device over a device-to-device communication link. If other communication data is pending transmission, the relay UE device determines whether a destination data priority level of the destination device data is greater than another data priority level of the other communication data. The destination device data is transmitted to the destination UE device in accordance with the priority levels.

title_en: Communication network connection service provision system, and wifi router therefor
abstract_en: To maintain a communication environment even in the event of an unexpected communication failure due to a natural disaster, such as an earthquake and thunderstorm, and a human disaster such as a failure and an accident in communication equipment.SOLUTION: A communication network connection service provision system enables the use of two or more communication lines of different communication service providers (carriers) to provide a connection to a communication network. If each access to the two or more available communication lines is by radio, a priority is put to each communication line to be used, and in a state that connection to the communication network cannot be performed for a certain time, the communication line to be used is changed according to the priority, so that a communication environment is maintained.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Frame structure, node and node communication method of wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frame structure of a wireless self-organizing network, which comprises: a superframe comprising 16 frames and having a length of 16 ms; each frame is 1ms long and comprises 28 symbols; p symbols are used for synchronous detection among nodes; the S symbol comprises necessary information maintained by an interactive network between nodes, resource negotiation information and high-priority service data; the D symbol is used for service interaction between nodes; the G symbol is used for a time protection interval of the transceiving switching reserved between the nodes. The invention can clearly distinguish whether the interference is outside the system or the effective data of other nodes of the system, and further can work normally when serious interference exists in the system; on the other hand, different configurations of the static domain and the dynamic domain in the system frame can flexibly support nodes with different scales, and up to 128 nodes can be supported to work simultaneously.
assignees: XIXIAN JINGWISTONDA SCIENCE AND TECH CO

title_en: Emergency command field global information transmission method and edge intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency command field global information transmission method and edge intelligent equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring information data to be transmitted; selecting a target communication module from the skynet satellite module, the 5G communication module, the WIFI/Bluetooth module and the broadband ad hoc network module according to a preset module priority; and transmitting the information data to be transmitted based on the target communication module. The method provided by the scheme can provide information communication services in different modes for emergency command field personnel, is suitable for various application environments, and can ensure that the emergency command field personnel communication equipment can keep normal communication in various environments.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Satellite constellation cloud processing analysis platform based on big data and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite constellation cloud processing analysis platform based on big data and a using method thereof. The operation management layer provides self-task distribution, self-priority confirmation, airborne processing and distribution capabilities through a big data platform and an artificial intelligence enhanced intelligent control and communication network, the support layer is used for ground command control setting and a user terminal and quick response transmitting service, the navigation layer provides backup positioning, navigation and time service in Beidou and GPS rejection environments, the sensing layer provides space situation sensing, detection and tracking of space targets to help satellite collision, the tracking layer provides tracking, aiming and advanced early warning of missile threats, the monitoring layer provides all-weather trusteeship for all determined time key targets, and the space transmission layer provides a global mesh network of data and communication in all weather. The satellite cluster utilization rate is increased, the reliability and disaster tolerance capability of the inter-satellite big data cloud platform are improved, and the system deployment cost and the personnel operation and maintenance cost are reduced.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for supporting differentiated quality of service in sidelink relays
abstract_en: The disclosure pertains to methods, apparatuses, systems, and/or procedures for supporting differentiated quality of service (QoS) in sidelink (SL) relays in wireless communications. In one embodiment, a method implemented in a relay Wireless Transmit/Receive Unit (WTRU), the relay WTRU to relay data from a plurality of remote WTRUs using a first forwarding configuration, comprises: receiving, from a remote WTRU of the plurality of remote WTRUs, via a device-to-device link, information indicating a priority value associated with the device-to-device link; receiving data from the remote WTRU of the plurality of remote WTRUs via the device-to-device link; determining a second forwarding configuration based on any of: the received priority value, the first forwarding configuration, and a priority threshold value associated with the device-to-device link; and transmitting the data received from the remote WTRU of the plurality of remote WTRUs, using the determined second forwarding configuration.
assignees: IDAC HOLDINGS INC;INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Handling radio access technologies based on core network failures
abstract_en: Systems, devices, and techniques described herein relate to prioritizing access by first user equipment (UEs) connected to a first radio access technology (RAT) type over access by second UEs connected to a second RAT type responsive to a failure of a core network node. A node of the core network, such as a session management node, may determine that another node of the core network has failed based on a negative response or no response from that other node. The node may then prioritize access based on RAT types of requesting UEs.

title_en: Efficient access method for double-layer architecture mobile ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency access method for a double-layer architecture-oriented mobile ad hoc network, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring an application scene of a network, and initializing network parameters; s2: determining nodes of a network according to an application scene, wherein the nodes of the network comprise a backbone node and a common node; s3: dividing the priorities of the nodes to obtain a node priority matrix, and performing time slot allocation on the nodes to obtain an initial time slot allocation matrix; s4: optimizing the time slot allocation of the nodes by adopting a sparrow search algorithm according to the node priority matrix and the initial time slot allocation matrix to obtain an optimal time slot allocation matrix; s5: and carrying out time slot allocation on each node in the network according to the optimal time slot allocation matrix, and accessing the network according to a time slot allocation result. The access method of the invention can meet the service requirements of different nodes in various scenes, can adapt to the requirement of topology change in high dynamic scenes, and has simple realization and high transmission reliability.

title_en: Power-efficient synchronization for long-range device-to-device communications
abstract_en: A communications network may include user equipment (UE) devices. When a first UE device becomes off-grid and has an emergency message, the first UE device may transmit device-to-device signals for receipt by a second UE device. The signals may include one or more preambles that precede the emergency message and that are used by the second UE device to perform synchronization with the first UE device. The second UE device may periodically activate a receiver during a series of windows to listen for the signals, may receive a preamble sequence during one of the windows, and may synchronize its timing to the first UE device for receipt of the emergency message based on the preamble sequence. This may allow the UE devices to be synchronized for transfer of the emergency message over long distances while consuming a minimal amount of power on the second UE device.

title_en: Networking method, equipment and system of wireless grid equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a networking method of wireless mesh equipment, which comprises the following steps: on any wireless mesh node device side, a first access priority of the mesh node device directly connected with the gateway device is higher than a second access priority of the mesh node device connected with any other mesh node device except the mesh node device in the current mesh network, so that the mesh node device becomes: a second network egress other than the Multi-access point Controller Multi-AP Controller node as the first network egress. The method and the device have the advantages that the mesh network has a plurality of network outlets, the bandwidth of the whole mesh network is favorably improved, the bottleneck caused by one network outlet is avoided, and the robustness of the whole mesh network is improved.

title_en: Unmanned ship heterogeneous link multi-scale data security reconstruction system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scale data security reconstruction system for an unmanned ship heterogeneous link, which comprises an unmanned surface vessel and a ground mobile control center, wherein the unmanned surface vessel and the ground mobile control center carry out ship-shore information interaction through a communication link built up by communication equipment. The system transmits state information, audio information, image information and video information of a ship end to a shore end through a Beidou system, 4G/5G signal switching of a public mobile communication system, 900MHz frequency hopping radio station communication, ad hoc network radio stations and other systems; transmitting a control instruction, audio information and the like of the shore end to the ship end to realize the interaction of ship and shore information; using multilink heterogeneous communication, judging the channel quality independently of each other, and giving channel priority to communicate by using a load balancing algorithm; and carrying out time registration on the sensor sampling data by using an interpolation extrapolation method to achieve time consistency. And performing data reconstruction and safe encryption on the ship-shore interaction information by using a DES and MD5 mixed encryption method to realize reliable and safe data interaction.

title_en: Safety Warning System for Underground Workers Using Bluetooth Function
title_ko: 블루투스 기능 활용한 지하층 작업자용 안전경보시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하층 작업자를 위한 안전 경보시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 지하층 내 작업 등에, 특히 2인 1개조 작업의 경우에 블루투스의 이격 거리 제한에 따른 통신 두절 현상을 대응하여 경고방송을 출력시켜 상대의 작업자가 상황을 인지 함으로 작업자의 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 하는 블루투스 기능을 활용한 지하층 작업자를 위한 안전 경보시스템에 관한 것이다

title_en: Fire detecting system using internet of things
title_ko: 스마트 IoT 화재감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart fire detection system using Internet of Things (IoT). The system detects fire occurring in a building to issue a real-time fire signal coordination alarm to another fire detector with a mesh network method, determines a broadband wireless communication network with great signal integrity and transmits a fire situation to a management server to reduce a possibility of failure of fire alarm transmission caused by communication disruption, compensates for shaded areas caused by a failure of a communication module to enable efficient initial fire suppression and minimize loss of properties and lives, and learns various environmental information to determine a non-fire alarm with high reliability and optimizes a sensitivity of a fire detector on the spot to minimize a phenomenon of fire alarm negligence caused by a non-fire alarm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 내에서 발생된 화재를 감지하여 매쉬 네트워크 방식으로 다른 화재감지기에 실시간 화재 신호 연동경보를 발령하고, 신호 건전성이 우수한 광대역 무선통신망을 결정하여 화재 상황을 관리서버로 전송함으로써 통신 장애로 인한 화재 경보 전달 실패 가능성을 낮추고 통신모듈 고장으로 인한 음영구역을 보완할 수 있어 효율적인 초기 화재진압 및 재산과 인명 손실을 최소화하며, 여러 가지 환경정보를 학습하여 신뢰성 높은 비화재 경보를 판단하고 현장의 화재감지기 감도를 최적화여 비화재 경보로 인한 화재 경보 경시 현상을 최소하는 스마트 IoT 화재감지 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Ad hoc network method, processor and device based on two-dimensional Markov chain model
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of communication, in particular to an ad hoc network method, a processor and a device based on a two-dimensional Markov chain model. The ad hoc network method comprises the following steps: determining the priority of an original message to be sent and determining the competition parameter of each priority; setting the counting duration of a backoff counter of each priority through a two-dimensional Markov chain model, wherein the counting duration of the backoff counter of each priority is determined according to the competition parameter of each priority; and after the waiting time of the original message of each priority reaches the counting time corresponding to the priority, sending the original message. According to the technical scheme, the corresponding priority is set for each original message to be sent, and the backoff duration of each message is determined according to the priority, so that when the messages compete internally, the backoff duration is set for the messages according to the priorities of the messages, message collision is avoided, and the communication efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHINA GRIDCOM CO LTD;SHENZHEN SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Electronic Devices with Adaptive Device-to-Device Communication Switching
abstract_en: A communications network may include a relay device that receives device-to-device (D2D) signals. In an ad hoc mode, the relay may consume relatively little power while receiving relatively few messages from relatively few transmitting devices in the D2D signals. In an organized mode, the device may consume relatively high power while receiving many messages from many transmitting devices in the D2D signals. A receiver on the device may transition from the ad hoc mode to the organized mode in response to a first criterion and may transition from the organized mode to the ad hoc mode in response to a second switching criterion. This may allow the device to balance communications load and power consumption while relaying messages such as emergency messages received over D2D signals given that the signals may arrive rarely or in clusters due to an unforeseen event.

title_en: Interstream network coding method, equipment and storage medium based on opportunistic routing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inter-stream network coding method, device and storage medium based on opportunistic routing. When a node receives a data packet, the node reads a candidate set list and corresponding priority parameters of the data packet and determines whether the node is in the candidate set list. Then, when the node does not receive the ACK frame of the node with higher priority, the node is responsible for forwarding the data packet according to the priority selection principle. When the other nodes in the Mesh network get the data packet sending opportunity, the coding condition is detected, and the coding is carried out and the forwarding is prepared. After the inter-stream network coding is introduced, the expectation of the transmission times of two nodes in the wireless Mesh network to the data packet can be effectively reduced, so that the network forwarding success rate and the network throughput are improved.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improvement method based on cooperative micro-grid after natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of restoration and evaluation of a power distribution system, in particular to a toughness improvement method for a power distribution network based on a cooperative micro-grid after natural disasters, wherein the natural disasters cause the power distribution network to fail to normally operate, distributed power supplies in the power distribution network participate in a power distribution network failure recovery strategy to form a plurality of micro-grid isolated islands powered by the distributed power supplies, so that the survival capacity of the power distribution system is improved, and the normal power supply of key loads of the power system is ensured; the method comprises the following steps: s1, setting the position of the distributed power source in the power distribution system; s2, analyzing the fault probability of each node of the power distribution system, and determining a fault node; s3, controlling the states of the switch equipment and the distributed power supply according to the positions of the fault node and the distributed power supply in the power distribution system, and forming a plurality of micro-grids capable of continuously supplying power; s4, recovering the key load in the power distribution network by the aid of the distributed power sources in consideration of the load priority; and S5, evaluating the toughness improvement effect of the power distribution network according to the proposed toughness evaluation index.

title_en: Mesh networking multi-service system and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Mesh networking multi-service realization method, which comprises the following steps: the Mesh network comprises a main route and one or more sub-routes, wherein in the main route, a Backhaul AP interface is used as a downlink port and is bound based on full service, and the service with the Vlan, which arrives at the uplink of the sub-route, is directly forwarded to the corresponding Vlan service through the Backhaul STA interface, so that the main sub-route supports the services of different vlans. The invention realizes multi-service forwarding between Backhaul and frontaul interfaces based on Mesh in a Mesh wireless networking scene: tr069 and other services go through the designated Vlan, and the service data can be subjected to priority limitation; the broadcast domain is limited in one Vlan, so that the bandwidth is saved, and the network processing capacity is improved; the invention also provides a corresponding Mesh networking multi-service system.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for stable P2P IoT communication
title_ko: 안정적인 P2P IoT 통신 제공장치 및 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for stably providing IoT communication, wherein the apparatus comprises: a stabilization device (1); and a specific server S (3), and the specific server S (3) includes an emergency message broker (4), and further comprises a smart power control device (2). By the apparatus for stably providing IoT communication, the method provides stable IOT communication when the public IP is changed and the stabilization device (1) detects the public IP change. In addition, when there is an emergency situation such as a power outage, the public IP address of the Internet router can be changed instantaneously, and communication may be interrupted the moment the public IP address is changed. For P2P communication between devices that are far away from the Internet, if the CPU of the Internet router directly performs the message broker function or if the message broker is operated in the device connected to the back of the Internet router, devices located remotely through the Internet router and Internet may cause communication failures. Accordingly, the present invention is to provide stable communication even at an abnormal moment by using an LPWAN communication device or a smart power control device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안정적으로 IoT 통신을 제공하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서,  
안정화장치(1) 및 특정서버"S"(3)를 포함하고, 상기 특정서버"S"(3)는 비상용 메시지브로커(4)를 포함하고, 스마트전원 제어장치(2)를 더 포함하는 안정적인 IOT 통신 제공장치에 의해 공인IP가 변경되고, 안정화장치(1)가 공인IP 변경을 감지한 경우 등에 있어 안정적인 IOT 통신을 제공하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 정전 등과 같은 비상상황이 있게 되면 인터넷공유기의 공인IP 주소가 순간적으로 바뀔 수 있게 되고, 공인IP 주소가 바뀐 순간 통신이 중단될 수 있어, 인터넷에서 원거리로 떨어져 있는 장치들간에 P2P통신을 위하여 인터넷공유기의 CPU가 직접 메시지브로커 기능을 수행하거나 인터넷공유기 뒷면의 연결된 장치에 메시지브로커가 운용되는 경우, 인터넷공유기와 인터넷을 통하여 원거리에 위치한 장치들은 있는 통신장애가 발생할 수 있는 바, 본 발명에서는 LPWAN 통신장치를 이용하거나 또는 스마트전원제어장치를 이용하여 비정상적인 순간에도 안정적으로 통신을 제공하고자 하는 것이다.

title_en: Emergency communication over non-persistent peer-2-peer network
abstract_en: Various embodiments comprise systems, methods, and apparatus for emergency, non-persistent peer-to-peer communications to support ad hoc use of proximate UE such as in remote areas with PE coverage gaps. Specifically, UE may configured to initiate emergency communications, and accept/support such emergency communications, such that an ad hoc mesh or message relay network is formed thereby in which (hopefully) someone near the source of the emergency communication may render assistance, or at least one UE in the ad hoc network is capable of accessing a base station, eNB, or gNB so that, for example, the mobile network provider or emergency services may be alerted to the emergency situation.

title_en: Secure, efficient and reliable data transmission in mission critical systems
abstract_en: A technique for managing data flow from a mission critical system. Embodiments include receiving a plurality of data values for transmission to a remote system using a unidirectional data communication network. The data values are prioritized according to a plurality of priority levels, and the prioritized plurality of data values are grouped into one or more data updates for each of the plurality of priority levels. Embodiments rank one or more data updates into respective transmission queues corresponding to each of a plurality of priority levels, and transmit the data updates over a unidirectional data communication network in an order determined based on the respective priority levels of the transmission queues.

title_en: System for monitoring and acquring data in smart factory
title_ko: 스마트 공장의 데이터 취합 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a data collecting and monitoring system for a smart factory. The data collecting and monitoring system for a smart factory, according to the present invention, comprises: a control board; an AI processing unit; and an information processing device. According to the present invention, even in case of a power outage or communication interruption of a central control unit, data at a problem time point can be identified by the AI processing unit and restored to a computer of the central control unit.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 스마트 공장의 데이터 취합 및 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로, 이러한 모니터링 시스템은 기존의 입출력 정보 이외에 AI기반의 데이터 로거 기능을 추가할 수 있도록 별도의 AI처리부가 마련된다. 그리고, 또한 중앙 서버의 정전이나 통신 두절의 경우에도 차후에 문제 시점의 데이터를 AI처리부에 의하여 확인하고 이를 중앙 제어부의 컴퓨터로 복구하는 기능을 가진다. 
그리고 또한, 이러한 경우, AI처리부에서 중앙 서버와는 별도로, 일반 공장 또는 HACCP 공장 등에서 다양한 데이터 개더링 및 통신을 이어주는 방식으로 실시간 모니터링을 통해, 공정 이상을 사전에 감지, 대응한다. 그리고, 이에 더하여 데이터 분석으로 알람 경보 지원을 가능하는 데이터 분석 솔루션을 제공한다. 
즉, 일반 공장 또는, HACCP 현장의 각종 데이터를 취합하여 데이터 취합분석기로 이기종의 다양한 프로토콜을 종합적으로 취합 분석하여 원격 모니터링 지원 허브 역할을 제공한다. 
이에 더하여, AI처리부는 SBC(Single Board Computing) 아키텍처 기반 디바이스 하드웨어 구현과 다양한 범용 설비로부터 데이터 수집/처리/전송을 위한 서비스를 제공하고, 제조 설비와 장치(센서)로부터 데이터를 수집할 수 있는 다양한 I/F를 제공하도록 한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 일실시예는 기존의 입출력 정보 이외에 AI기반의 데이터 로거 기능을 추가할 수 있도록 별도의 AI처리부가 마련된다. 그리고, 또한 이에 더하여, 중앙 제어부의 정전이나 통신 두절의 경우에 도 차후에 문제 시점의 데이터를 AI처리부에 의하여 확인하고 이를 중앙 제어부의 컴퓨터로 복구하는 기능을 가진 스마트 공장의 데이터 취합 및 모니터링 시스템을 제공한다. 
그리고 또한, 이러한 모니터링 시스템은 AI처리부에서 중앙 서버와는 별도로, 데이터 수집 및 처리 장치 각종 센서로부터 취득 신호를 수집 처리하며, 분석.진단이 가능하도록 데이터 가공 처리와 분석을 제공한다. 
이에 더하여, 이러한 데이터 수집 및 분석장치는 측정이 복잡하고 연결장치가 많아 사용이 불편한 점을 해결한다. 그래서, 이를 통해 온도/압력/소음/진동 등 다양한 신호를 휴대용 PC나 노트북 등과 연결하여 수집 및 분석할 수 있는 종합적 프로토콜 게이트웨이 역할의 신호 수집 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: QoS guarantee method for mobile ad hoc network based on packet multiplexing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, in particular to a mobile ad hoc network QoS guarantee method based on packet multiplexing. When formally initiating service transmission, based on the current service data volume and the resource evaluation of the nodes of the ad hoc network, the transmission of the service data can fully utilize the available resources of each node of the ad hoc network. When the mobile ad hoc network node resources are found to be shared with other services, the available resources of the ad hoc network node can be flexibly allocated according to the service priority division on the premise of guaranteeing the minimum resources of the original service QoS communication quality in a data packet multiplexing mode, and multi-service concurrency is rapidly realized. By adopting the scheme, the service quality of various services can be ensured, the sending resources can be fully utilized, the data transmission efficiency is improved, the route reselection process or service establishment failure caused by insufficient residual resources of the nodes is avoided as far as possible, and the data reliable transmission requirement is met.
assignees: NO 54 INST CN ELECT SCI & TECH

title_en: Intelligent remote control positioning and alert system
abstract_en: A system for determining a location and an orientation of a remote control unit within a mesh network. A remote control unit (RCU) includes a top wireless orientation beacon at a first end and a bottom wireless orientation beacon at a second end. The top wireless orientation beacon and the bottom wireless orientation beacon provide location information to a controller device. A plurality of wireless mesh beacons are disposed in a predetermined area to form a mesh network, and the controller device uses the plurality of mesh beacons to generate a map of the predetermined area. The controller device processes location information obtained from the RCU to determine a position and orientation of the RCU relative to the controller device in the map of the predetermined area.

title_en: Medicine administration in dynamic networks
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are techniques related to medicine administration in dynamic networks. The techniques may involve identifying an amount of medicine for delivery to a patient and determining a communication path toward a first medicine administration device of a plurality of medicine administration devices in a mesh network. The plurality of medicine administration devices may further include a second medicine administration device that is prioritized over the first medicine administration device for delivering medicine to the patient. The techniques may further involve causing delivery of the amount of medicine to the patient by the first medicine administration device based on communicating the amount of medicine toward the first medicine administration device via the communication path when the amount of medicine remains undelivered by the second medicine administration device.

title_en: Urban rail vehicle service transmission method based on node cost and service priority
abstract_en: The invention provides a urban rail vehicle service transmission method based on node cost and service priority. The method comprises the following steps: the vehicle-mounted service is prioritized according to the requirement on time delay, and cluster head nodes are selected from all clusters in the urban rail vehicle-mounted ad hoc network according to a cluster head election algorithm based on a cost function; the cluster head nodes distinguish the priority of the service reaching the cluster head, and the service with different priority is optimally transmitted according to a low-delay queuing strategy based on the service priority. The invention can ensure low time delay and high reliability communication of train places in train operation by utilizing the mode of dividing service priority and clustering ad hoc network, improves the operation safety and operation efficiency of the train and meets the demands of the next generation urban rail communication network.

title_en: Topology discovery and route issuing method combining wireless ad hoc network and SDN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a topology discovery and route issuing method combining wireless ad hoc network and SDN, belonging to the field of wireless ad hoc network management. The method comprises the steps of sending a link state request in a wireless ad hoc network, after receiving self information and adjacent information fed back by all nodes, constructing an adjacent matrix of the wireless ad hoc network based on the adjacent information, wherein the self information comprises the self model number, transmission capacity and residual capacity of the nodes, calculating the priority of each node according to the adjacent matrix and the self information of the nodes, selecting a plurality of backbone nodes according to the priority of the nodes to form a backbone node set conforming to a minimum support set, designating default backbone nodes of each common node according to whether connection and the electric quantity of the backbone nodes exist between the nodes or not, notifying the default backbone nodes, receiving information uploaded by the backbone nodes, deciding and sending a route. According to the invention, the node endurance is used as a decision factor for selecting the backbone node, the backbone node is used for transmission in an interaction manner, the electric quantity consumption of the common node is reduced, and the efficient endurance of the cluster is realized.
assignees: NO 709 RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LIMITED

title_en: High-mobility ad hoc network dynamic power distribution method based on directional multi-beam antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic power distribution method of a high-mobility ad hoc network based on a directional multi-beam antenna, which is characterized in that aiming at any transmitting node, the lowest transmitting power of each link is calculated and is called as basic power; according to the lowest transmitting power of each link, distributing power for the links forming a receiving and transmitting corresponding state between the nodes, wherein the receiving and transmitting corresponding state means that the nodes at two ends of the link are respectively in a transmitting state and a receiving state under the same time slot; and calculating the sum of the basic power of all the completed power distribution links, comparing the sum with the relation of the total power, and redistributing the power by increasing or decreasing the MCS level. The power distribution algorithm provided by the invention aims at the communication speed requirement among the nodes, can distribute power according to the communication requirement when the power is enough, preferentially ensures the communication requirement of the high-priority node, improves the system throughput by utilizing the improvement of the MCS level, and simultaneously improves the power utilization rate.
assignees: TIANDI INFORMATION NETWORK RES INSTITUTE ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Bluetooth mesh control optimization method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Bluetooth mesh networking technology, and discloses a Bluetooth mesh control optimization method based on edge calculation, which improves the reliability of communication and the execution efficiency of a system while ensuring the control accuracy of the system. The invention establishes a multi-level instruction queue controller, a cache queue controller and an air interface gateway controller at an edge computing end which is in the same local area network with a Bluetooth mesh device; receiving an upper layer instruction through a multi-level instruction queue controller, taking out an executable instruction from a queue according to priority, submitting the executable instruction to an air interface gateway controller for issuing, judging the instruction execution condition by the air interface gateway controller, if the execution fails, putting the instruction into a cache queue, managing the instruction in the cache queue through the cache queue controller by an edge computing terminal, and when no instruction needing issuing exists in the multi-level instruction queue, extracting the cached instruction by the cache queue controller, and submitting the instruction to the air interface gateway controller for instruction retransmission.
assignees: SICHUAN CHANGHONG ELECTRONICS HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN QIRUIKE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Inter-link time slot and power cooperative allocation method for multi-beam directional ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively distributing time slots and power among links of a multi-beam directional ad hoc network, wherein after each network node distributes a time slot state sequence, the power adjustment is preferably carried out among links to adapt to the change of the demand of communication speed on the links, and the adjustment of the time slot state sequence of the node is carried out only when the power distribution can not meet the communication demand of the links, so that the adjustment frequency of the time slot state sequence of the node can be greatly reduced; the method has the advantages that the transmitting power is dynamically distributed among links by taking time slots as units, the method can adapt to the high-speed time-varying requirement of the link communication rate among nodes, the communication requirement of a high-dynamic time-sensitive network is met, the communication capacity of the network is maximized on the basis of meeting the link rate, and the adaptability of the network to different priority services and different transmission reliability requirements is improved through fine scheduling of power resources.
assignees: TIANDI INFORMATION NETWORK RES INSTITUTE ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: PUBLIC SAFETY COMMUNICATION SYSTEM and METHOD PROVIDING REGIONAL DIFFERENCE RECOGNITION
abstract_en: A communication system operating within a public safety network includes a cultural analytics engine configured to receive a video feed from a security camera system or a portable public safety communication device operating within the system. The cultural analytics engine performs primary aggressive behavior video analytics detection on the video feed to detect potential aggressive behavior within the video feed. The analytics engine further performs secondary cultural exception analytics on the video feed to determine whether a cultural exception to the behavior is detected. Audio verification is performed on identified potential exceptions. In response to no cultural exception being detected, an alert is generated indicative of a public safety incident, and in response to a cultural exception being detected, no alert is sent

title_en: Mobile ad hoc network method and system based on TDMA
abstract_en: The invention relates to the networking communication technical field based on TDMA, and particularly discloses a mobile ad hoc network method and a system based on TDMA, wherein the system comprises a network management module, a resource allocation module, a route management module and a reliable transmission module; the network management module is used for realizing the multi-hop direct network connection, the multi-hop relay network connection and the network withdrawal of the common node; the resource allocation module is used for supporting static time slot allocation and dynamic time slot allocation (JBPNI-DTSA algorithm); the routing management module is used for customizing a routing table data structure and realizing the insertion and deletion of the routing table according to the network topology structure maintained by the node broadcasting; the reliable transmission module is used for designing the maximum timeout retransmission time according to the hop count, setting the maximum retransmission times and ensuring the acknowledgement of the data packet to the greatest extent possible. The system ensures the reliable transmission of high-priority service as much as possible, solves the problem of service packet collision among nodes, reduces the overall packet loss rate of the system, and improves the network throughput and the channel utilization rate of the system.

title_en: Multi-hop TDMA time slot allocation method suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless ad hoc networks, and particularly discloses a multi-hop TDMA time slot allocation method suitable for an unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network, which comprises the following steps: dividing each TDMA time frame into a reservation subframe and a data subframe according to time sequence, wherein the reservation subframe comprises K reservation periods, and the data subframe comprises N data time slots; defining a control short frame, a service long frame and a time slot occupation table; fixedly occupying a reservation period according to the ID and the priority of the node; each node which completes network access sends a reservation application frame and a reservation notification frame to the data time slot in the occupied reservation period according to the current service demand and the time slot occupation condition; each node which completes network access maintains a local time slot occupation table according to the reservation notification frame; after the reserved subframe of one TDMA time frame is finished, the reserved data time slot among the nodes transmits a service long frame for communication. The method realizes the allocation of the TDMA channels according to the needs and simultaneously preferentially meets the channel demands of the nodes with high priority and meets the timeliness of the data.

title_en: Heterogeneous ad hoc network method suitable for modern emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous ad hoc network method suitable for modern emergency communication, which relates to the field of wireless ad hoc networks for emergency communication and comprises the following steps: a heterogeneous ad hoc network is formed by command vehicle nodes and common individual nodes; and constructing an active-passive hybrid hierarchical route, and planning a path based on a priority routing decision. Respectively establishing a hierarchical frequency-division and power-division network structure consisting of command vehicle nodes and individual soldier nodes in an ad hoc network; the command vehicle node uses an active routing algorithm to establish a routing table of all nodes of the whole network, and the common individual nodes use a passive routing algorithm to establish the routing table only when specific service is required; when the message forwarding route is decided, the node preferentially selects a path formed by taking the command vehicle node as the forwarding node according to the route table path. The invention ensures the safety, smoothness, robustness, destruction-resistant self-healing and networking time of the network in the emergency disaster site, thereby solving the problems of network safety and network topology flexibility of MANET in modern emergency communication.
assignees: CHENGDU QUANJING XINGKE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Video transmission method, device, video transmission equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video transmission method, a device, video transmission equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the code rate of a video to be transmitted in a mesh networking and determining the transmission priority of the video to be transmitted; transmitting the code rate and the transmission priority level step by step among the node devices through a connection management message so as to determine a target transmission link corresponding to the video to be transmitted; and transmitting the video to be transmitted based on the target transmission link in the mesh networking. The invention further subdivides the video service, avoids the phenomenon of poor video effect such as video on demand or live broadcast blocking, mosaic and the like, and improves the quality of video transmission when transmitting the multipath video service.

title_en: Preventative workplace injury alerting system utilizing mmwave 5G positional localization
abstract_en: In an approach for monitoring a user's in-flight activity and/or a pattern of movement of a user and warning the user of an in-flight activity or a pattern of movement that could lead to a potential short-term or long-term injury, a processor monitors a body movement and a posture of a user through an application of micro-location analysis enabled by a mesh network of 5G sensors over a period of time. A processor determines whether the body movement and the posture detected can lead to an activity or a series of activities that can result in a potential injury. Responsive to determining a pre-set threshold of risk has been reached, a processor issues a real time alert to the user to warn of the potential injury.

title_en: Low-delay multi-priority service data sharing method in directional wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: A low-latency multi-priority service data scheduling method in a directional wireless ad hoc network fully utilizes the multi-beam forming capability of a multi-beam antenna of the directional transmission wireless ad hoc network aiming at low-latency full-to-full broadcast service, constructs a transmission link table and a data information table to eliminate repeated receiving and repeated sending by extracting network topology information, and then preferentially schedules link and service data in the highest priority color in each time slot through coloring and priority judgment, thereby effectively reducing redundant transmission and transmission latency in the full-to-full broadcast process. The invention utilizes the multidirectional transmitting capacity of the multi-beam antenna, integrates network topology information extraction and data priority judgment coloring, optimally schedules data and links, and realizes effective and reliable sharing with low time delay.

title_en: Cognitive Wireless Vehicular Emergency Response System for first responders
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an advanced emergency response system that minimizes physical risk to the first responder and yet allows them to maintain national safety and security within the country. The apparatus involves receiving alerts through the dispatch system located in the first responder car. The first responder car, upon receiving an alert, is dispatched to the appropriate address and is parked within a safe distance from the emergency location. The first responders then dispatch the autonomous rover from their vehicle using a vehicle dashboard. The rover is equipped with cameras, an object detection system, location sensors, and it shares live feeds for situational awareness with the public safety agencies and first responders. It also enables real-time bidirectional communication for first responders, public safety agents and allows them to communicate with the suspects and the victims located at the hazard/emergency site. The system also uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms to detect safety and security anomalies associated with the emergency situation in the field and shares this information with the public safety agents. If the suspect decides to run and take off, this system allows the first responders to launch a swarm of drones using cognitive vehicle dashboard that keep track of the suspect and provide situational awareness to the first responders and the public safety agents. All components involved in this system use Public Safety Grade FCC Band 14 Telecom Network for wireless communication dedicated to public safety agents and this network provides mission-critical reliability and security. The assembly is easy to install, safe to use, and suitable for all public safety agents and first responders.

title_en: Unicast data transmission method for wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unicast data transmission method for a wireless ad hoc network, which comprises the steps of detecting and updating a routing link table of a source node and detecting and updating routing link tables of forwarding and target nodes, periodically broadcasting routing link information by the source node to maintain a route by adopting an AODV mode, updating a routing link table stored by the forwarding and target nodes, receiving unicast IP data packets by the source node, assembling the unicast IP data packets into UCP (user control protocol) and storing the UCP data packets into corresponding transmission FIFO (first in first out) and transmitting the UCP data packets according to priority and transmission weight, analyzing and judging to receive or forward the unicast data packets by the forwarding and target nodes, and solving the problems of low data transmission reliability and reliability in the establishment and updating rate of the routing link of the traditional wireless ad hoc network.
assignees: ZHONGKE HUAJUN BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: System and method for introducing a new emergency alert using modular tag device
abstract_en: A system and method to utilize modular device and mesh network to send emergency alert that could be delivered to the cloud and sent to the user even though the cloud itself is not reachable directly from the device are provided. The disclosure uses modular sensors, internet of things (IoT) application and cloud server, and an emergency protocol that may enable devices within the mesh network to find the best route to cloud and produce reliable emergency alert even though the connection between device and cloud is unreliable.

title_en: Directional ad hoc network dynamic power distribution method based on time slot sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional self-organizing network dynamic power distribution method based on time slot sequence, each node in self-organizing network distributes a time slot sequence, the time slot sequence is a binary sequence, the sequence length is equal to the time slot quantity Q of service sub-frames, each bit '0' and '1' of the time slot sequence respectively represent a receiving time slot and a transmitting time slot, and when the corresponding bit of the sequence between two nodes is '0' and '1', the two nodes can be paired for communication; the power demand of the nodes in the whole communication period is considered by adopting a hierarchical time slot-by-time slot power distribution strategy in the service period, and the power demand can be adapted according to the node and the demand change in the network, so that the power distribution method is suitable for a dynamic self-organizing network; the service priority of the node is considered, so that the communication requirement of the node with high service priority can be met preferentially; the scheme has low complexity and low calculation cost, and is suitable for the networking nodes with limited energy.
assignees: TIANDI INFORMATION NETWORK RES INSTITUTE ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing priority service to UEs in a wireless network
abstract_en: Embodiments herein provide a method for providing priority services to UEs by an AMF. The method comprises the following steps: a request message is received from a UE, subscription data for the UE is received from a Universal Data Management (UDM), and an accept message for the priority service is sent to the UE in response to receiving the request message based on identifying that the subscription data includes information related to the priority service and that the request message does not include an establishment cause associated with the priority service. The priority service includes at least one of a Multimedia Priority Service (MPS) or a mission critical service (MCX).

title_en: Intelligent traffic-oriented mobile ad hoc network data transmission system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a mobile ad hoc network data transmission system and method for intelligent traffic, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an initialization subsystem, a sending node subsystem and a receiving node subsystem; the initialization subsystem is used for initializing a network node, wherein the network node comprises: a plurality of transmitting nodes and a plurality of receiving nodes; the transmitting node subsystem is used for generating a non-empty data packet by utilizing the transmitting node and broadcasting the non-empty data packet; the receiving node subsystem is used for monitoring the non-empty data packet by utilizing the receiving node, processing the non-empty data packet to obtain the final data packet forwarding priority, and finishing data transmission. The method and the system adopt a probability forwarding strategy to control the broadcasting behavior of the self-organizing network node, the communication node acquires information such as a preset path, a position, a speed, a running direction and the like in real time, and a comprehensive decision mechanism is utilized to judge whether and when data broadcasting is performed.

title_en: Air Rights-Based Safe Operation System and Method for Network-Disconnected Aircraft
title_ko: 공중권 기반 운항 중 네트워크 단절 비행체의 안전 운항 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for safely operating a network disconnected flight vehicle during a public ticket-based operation, which can safely operate even in a network disconnection situation. The operation unit 500 safely stores the path data in the local storage, verifies data integrity in connection with the blockchain server 300 and the verification unit 200, and automatically performs synchronization after network recovery. In addition, safety is enhanced by analyzing the possibility of path collision through a machine learning-based path search algorithm and setting an avoidance path. The present invention provides safe and efficient operation by integrally performing path maintenance, alarm transmission, data synchronization, path collision analysis, and avoidance setting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 네트워크 단절 상황에서도 안전하게 운항을 지속할 수 있는 공중권 기반 운항 중 네트워크 단절 비행체의 안전 운항 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 조작부(500)는 경로 데이터를 로컬 저장소에 안전하게 저장하고, 블록체인 서버(300) 및 검증부(200)와 연계하여 데이터 무결성을 검증하며 네트워크 복구 후 자동으로 동기화를 수행한다. 또한, 머신러닝 기반 경로 탐색 알고리즘을 통해 경로 충돌 가능성을 분석하고 회피 경로를 설정하여 안전성을 강화한다. 본 발명은 경로 유지, 경보 발송, 데이터 동기화, 경로 충돌 분석 및 회피 설정을 통합적으로 수행함으로써 안전하고 효율적인 운항을 제공한다.

title_en: Dynamic bandwidth pre-allocation method and node for wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic bandwidth pre-allocation method and nodes of a wireless ad hoc network, wherein the scheme calculates the dynamic weight of each node in the wireless network topology; based on the calculated node dynamic weight, periodically pre-distributing different bandwidths for the service flows with different priorities; when the reserved bandwidth of the service flow is smaller than the request bandwidth, the high-priority service data packet is sent preferentially by judging the priority of different services. And meanwhile, calculating and updating the time of the next round of service flow pre-allocation period according to all the service arrival rates, and dynamically updating the service flow pre-allocation period. The scheme of the invention can more efficiently support the variability of the topology and the service flow of the wireless ad hoc network through the dynamic adjustment of the non-fixed period.
assignees: THIRD RES INST MINISTRY PUBLIC SECURITY

title_en: Power emergency Mesh network communication resource allocation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for distributing communication resources of an electric power emergency Mesh network, belonging to the technical field of electric power emergency communication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: registering terminal equipment in advance, and carrying out ID allocation according to the type of the terminal equipment; the terminal equipment is connected with Mesh equipment closest to the terminal equipment, each Mesh equipment is automatically networked, and a root node builds Mesh network topology; the Mesh equipment node identifies the service type borne by the terminal equipment according to the terminal equipment ID; and the Mesh equipment nodes connected with the terminal equipment report information in sequence according to the order from high to low of the priority of the service types, and wait for the root node to determine the optimal route and channel allocation scheme according to the current network state and the channel resource allowance, and complete the service transmission. The invention realizes that the Mesh equipment node perceives the type of the carried service, can distribute route and channel resources to different services in a grading way, and preferentially ensures the transmission of the service with high priority.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Ad hoc network method and system based on wifi decentralization
abstract_en: The application discloses an ad hoc network method and system based on wifi decentralization, relating to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: judging the network access state of the wifi home gateway, if the wifi home gateway cannot normally access the internet, performing ad hoc network with other wifi home gateways, and constructing a network topology by the wifi home gateway in the ad hoc network; in the process of self-networking, the network topology evaluates and votes through the CPU computing power of the respective wifi home gateway to acquire the node priority of the wifi home gateway; the network topology tests the ad hoc network through a spanning tree protocol, and an optimal line and a backup line are selected. According to the self-networking method and system based on wifi decentralization, the robustness and stability of the self-networking are improved, and the efficient communication of the self-networking is ensured.
assignees: HUNAN YILIAN WUXIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: SC-FDE waveform-based dynamic TDMA protocol design method
abstract_en: The application relates to a dynamic TDMA protocol design method based on SC-FDE waveforms. The method comprises the following steps: detecting a beacon frame in the wireless ad hoc network, entering a first node beacon frame competition stage to send the beacon frame, if collision occurs, carrying out back-off until the node competition successfully sends out the beacon frame, and then entering a beacon frame non-competition stage in the wireless ad hoc network, alternately sending the beacon frame for counting the priority of each node, and entering a second time slot; the nodes with high priority are sequentially output according to the numbers in the second time slot, and the nodes with high priority response priority in the current time slot send related data according to the sequence of the broadcast frames to complete the high priority response and then enter the third time slot; and the data of the low-priority node in the third time slot is transmitted through the competition of the CSMA/CA protocol. The method can reduce time expenditure.
assignees: HUNAN ZHILING COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Full duplex automatic relay intercom special for fire rescue commander
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full duplex automatic relay interphone special for a firefighting rescue commander, which relates to the technical field of interphones and comprises an interphone main body, wherein a main board is arranged in the interphone main body, one side of the interphone main body is provided with a PTT key A and a PTT key B, the front side of the interphone main body is provided with an emergency rescue key and a three-gear control key, the interphone main body can simultaneously work in two independent intercom channel groups through setting the PTT key A and the PTT key B, a user can be ensured to receive an upper order in time and simultaneously command a lower team to perform actions, the communication signal global coverage during public network paralysis or public network blind area rescue is realized by the aid of the relay ad hoc network intercom function, the emergency rescue key can be arranged to rapidly improve the priority of the user for emergency broadcasting, and the three-gear control key can be arranged through different gear control priorities to ensure that all members are in a full duplex state and the command efficiency is improved.
assignees: BAISE CITY TIANYANG DISTR FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE

title_en: Dual Control System for Underpass Drain Pump
title_ko: 지하차도 배수펌프 이중 제어시스템
abstract_en: An underpass drainage pump dual control system according to the present invention is composed of a dual control system consisting of an on-site control device placed in a sump pump room at an underpass site and a remote control device installed in an underpass manager situation room, and is characterized by two control systems that complement and correct each other. In particular, the present invention relates to a system in which a level controller, which functions to activate the pump by receiving a signal from a water level gauge, is placed in the underpass sump pump room, and is directly connected to a pump operation panel to primarily control a drainage pump according to the water level in the sump, and a remote control panel connected to a PLC, etc. compares and analyzes each of a pump activation water level value and a pump activation status, monitors any abnormalities in the level controller, and alerts an operator and provides secondary control of the pump manually/automatically at the same time. As a measure to prevent paralysis of a drainage function due to failure of the control system, which is one of the key factors in flooding of underground roads, the drainage pump control system is most effectively and stably doubled. Thus, compared to similar methods that cause system complexity due to a high cost of dual (backup) installation of a PLC system and a configuration of additional devices, such as installation of additional monitoring devices for PLC abnormalities, the present invention is not only simple and economical to build, but also can solve a fundamental problem of a remote control method such as communication failures.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 지하차도 배수펌프 이중 제어시스템은, 지하차도 현장의 집수정 펌프실에 배치되는 현장제어장치와, 지하차도 관리자 상황실에서 구비되는 원격제어장치의 이중 제어시스템으로 이루어지는 것이 특징이며, 두 개의 제어시스템으로 상호 보완 보정하는 것이 특징이며, 구체적으로는, 수위계의 신호를 받아 펌프를 기동시키는 기능을 하는 레벨콘트롤러를 지하차도 집수정 펌프실에 배치하고 펌프기동반과 직접 연결하여 집수정의 수위에 따라 배수펌프를 1차적으로 제어하고 PLC 등으로 연결된 원격제어반이 각각의 펌프기동 수위값과 펌프기동상태를 비교·분석하여 레벨콘트롤러의 이상여부를 감시하여 운영자에게 경보함과 동시에 수동/자동으로 펌프를 2차적으로 제어하는 시스템에 대한 것으로 지하차도 침수발생의 핵심요인 중의 하나인 제어시스템의 고장으로 인한 배수기능의 마비를 방지하는 대책으로 배수펌프 제어시스템을 가장 효과적이고 안정적으로 이중화함으로써 PLC시스템의 이중(백업)설치에 따른 고비용 및 PLC 이상여부에 대한 감시장치 추가설치 등 부가장치 구성에 따른 시스템의 복잡화를 유발하는 유사방식에 비해 단순하고 경제적으로 구축할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 통신 장애와 같은 원격제어방식의 근원적인 문제도 해소할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-link operation controller for mesh network and corresponding method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multi-link operation (MLO) controller for a mesh network and an MLO method for the controller, the method comprising the operations of: establishing a connection of a plurality of links with a first non-access point (non-AP) MLO device within the mesh network according to an initial traffic identifier (traffic identifier, TID) to link mapping and channel list, wherein priority traffic is sent on a high priority link according to the initial TID to link mapping; configuring a plurality of thresholds for a respective plurality of operating parameters of a plurality of links; disabling traffic on the corresponding link when one of the operating parameters changes relative to the configured threshold; and performing service allocation according to the updated operation parameters and updating the TID-to-link mapping for the connection of the plurality of links.

title_en: Dynamic link management in multi-link operation for mesh network
abstract_en: A multi-link operation (MLO) controller for a mesh network includes: a processing unit, including: establishing a multi-link connection with a first non-access (AP) point MLO device within the mesh network according to an initial traffic identifier (TID) to link mapping and a channel list, wherein the multi-link connection includes an associated link containing information of all other links, and priority traffic is sent on a better or best affiliated link configured by a TID to link mapping; configuring a plurality of thresholds for a respective plurality of operating parameters of the multi-links; when one of the operating parameters changes with respect to the configured threshold, disabling traffic on the corresponding link; and performing traffic distribution according to updated operating parameters and updating the TID to link mapping for the multi-link connection.

title_en: A system for supporting high-throughput and/or high-reliability in concurrent transmission-based networks
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media for synchronizing and controlling concurrent transmission-based multi-radio devices to support higher throughput or higher reliability communications in a synchronous flooding mesh network. A host device (202A) in a wireless communication network can include multiple radio devices (210A-N), with each radio device being part of a concurrent transmission (CT)-based flooding network (N1, N2, N3) configured to concurrently transmit data to one or more corresponding receiving radios (214A-N) with corresponding radio nodes (212A-N) of other devices (202N) in the wireless communication network. Data packets can either be fragmented via a packet fragmentation process or replicated via a packet replication process to prioritize either throughput or redundancy for data transmission. The host devices (202A, 202N) in the network can synchronize a time for transmitting data and distributing any of a set of orthogonal radio frequency channels for each CT flooding network in transmitting data.
assignees: TECH INNOVATION INSTITUTE – SOLE PROPRIETORSHIP LLC

title_en: Wireless communication control method and platform for threaded control instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless communication control method and a wireless communication control platform for a threaded control instrument.
