The invention comprises a computer, a wireless receiver, an ad hoc network controller and a threaded control instrument, wherein the communication control method comprises the steps of realizing wireless ad hoc network of a tree topology structure of the wired program control instrument by using the ad hoc network controller, determining the ad hoc network grade of the threaded control instrument according to the priority of the instrument and the strength of signals, gradually issuing a control instruction to the corresponding threaded control instrument according to a link table in an ad hoc network platform, gradually uploading instrument data to the computer according to a connection link table in the ad hoc network platform, and determining the uploading sequence of the instrument data according to the priority of the instrument. The invention realizes wireless communication control of the tree topology structure of the wired program control instrument by utilizing the ad hoc network controller, unifies different communication interfaces of the wired program control instrument, simplifies complex connection of different communication cables between a computer and the wired program control instrument, and widens the connection distance between the computer and the wired program control instrument.

title_en: 5G deterministic bearer networking method for electric power service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid service resource scheduling, in particular to a 5G deterministic bearer networking method for power service, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power service scene; adding a service priority mapping function in 5G network service; adding a priority queue management function in 5G network service; determining a QoS flow corresponding to a data packet and a time delay requirement of the data packet; performing service modeling according to a delay sensitive network and a delay tolerant network which are generated by the power service in a corresponding system; and (5) networking scheduling. The invention builds a network model, determines the network performance boundary of the delay sensitive network model by utilizing a random network algorithm, obtains the allocation strategy of deterministic delay guarantee based on the network performance boundary of the network model, builds a differentiated resource mapping scheduling scheme meeting the requirement of high-priority power service on real-time performance and service quality by dividing the priority.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Flight ad hoc network resource allocation method and device based on interference suppression
abstract_en: The invention provides a flight ad hoc network resource allocation method and device based on interference suppression. The scheme comprises the following steps: step one, calculating the number of effective links and determining the number of transmission time slots according to the service flow of the unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network, and introducing a spatial filtering technology to relieve inter-machine communication interference when describing the transmission rate; and secondly, maximizing the network capacity of the flight ad hoc network to obtain an objective function, and solving a nonlinear programming problem of the objective function by adopting a Lagrange dual method to obtain an optimal solution of the problem. The second step includes the relaxation of time slot variable, the determination of Lagrangian function and the conversion of dual problem, optimizing the transmitting power according to KKT condition, calculating the link transmission rate according to the optimizing result, and finally solving the optimal strategy of time slot allocation. The method can realize the maximization of the system capacity and obtain the network time slot resource allocation scheme under the constraint conditions of meeting the requirements of the maximum transmitting power of the communication link nodes, the transmission rates of the links with different priorities and the like.

title_en: Mesh-link traffic segmentation based on priority
abstract_en: A root access point (RAP) that communicates with one or more mesh access points (MAPs) via two or more concurrent mesh links (or paths) in a mesh network is described. Notably, during operation, the RAP may communicate, via a mesh link in the two or more concurrent mesh links, packets or frames with the one or more MAPs, where the mesh link uses a band of frequencies, and where the packets or frames have a priority. Moreover, the RAP may communicate, via a second mesh link in the two or more concurrent mesh links, second packets or second frames with the one or more MAPs, where the second mesh link uses a second band of frequencies that is different from the currently selected band of frequencies, and where the second packets or second frames have a second priority that is less than the priority of the packets or frames.

title_en: Multi-hop clock synchronization method based on redundant paths
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clock synchronization communication of unmanned aerial vehicle formation ad hoc networks, in particular to a multi-hop clock synchronization method based on a redundant path, which comprises the steps that a main node periodically sends a link detection message; each slave node establishes an arrival time table according to the arrival time of the link detection message, and determines the priority of the forwarding path of each slave node; the target slave node determines a shortest path and a redundant path to the master node according to the priority; the master node sends a synchronous message; each slave node carries out abnormality detection on the received synchronous message, if the abnormality detection is passed, the synchronous message is forwarded to the target slave node according to the shortest path, and if the shortest path fails, the synchronous message is forwarded to the target slave node according to the redundant path; each slave node analyzes the received synchronous message, adopts a hardware time stamp as a clock count, and adopts a dynamic frequency correction algorithm to adaptively compensate the clock frequency deviation. The invention improves the reliability of clock synchronization and reduces the influence of crystal oscillator frequency deviation on clock synchronization.

title_en: Method for dynamically optimizing communication path of multistage wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically optimizing a communication path of a multi-level wireless ad hoc network, which relates to the technical field of network communication and comprises the steps of normalizing factors influencing communication to generate loss values; and calculating the loss value between the father node and the child node according to the loss parameter to finish the dynamic optimization of the communication path. The invention takes the number of stages of the communication equipment as the highest priority evaluation standard, selects the optimal communication path between the two communication equipment, and simultaneously dynamically adjusts the communication path of the communication equipment by comparing the influence of a plurality of path loss values and historical communication success rate on the loss values, thereby realizing self-repairing and self-optimizing of the path and rapid path switching. The invention ensures that communication success is ensured as much as possible under any abnormal condition between communication devices, and the flow of calculating the loss value of the path is the operation period of the devices, so that no extra calculation amount is needed in the actual switching flow, and the switching speed of the communication path is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIERDA INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic network time slot allocation method based on directional antenna and network simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic network time slot allocation method based on a directional antenna and a network simulation system; the method comprises the following steps: neighbor discovery, frame reservation and data transmission are carried out between nodes in the dynamic ad hoc network based on a time division multiple access protocol of directional beams; carrying out power level negotiation and time slot reservation confirmation among nodes in a neighbor discovery period; the method comprises the steps of carrying out re-linking and time slot confirmation between nodes in a frame reservation period; data transmission between nodes is carried out in a data transmission period to negotiate power and reserve time slots; in the dynamic Ad hoc network data transmission process, the service quality of each node data transmission size, transmission time delay and service priority is guaranteed; and respectively carrying out time slot allocation according to the priority of the neighbor nodes from the packets with high priority to the packets with low priority through the established node list based on the different priority groups so as to meet the output transmission service requirements among the nodes. The invention improves the network service quality and the anti-interference capability.
assignees: COMPUTER APPLICATION TECH INSTITUTE OF CHINA NORTH INDUSTRIES GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Outdoor operation command scheduling method, system, equipment and medium based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention provides an outdoor operation command scheduling method, system, equipment and medium based on an ad hoc network, wherein the method comprises the steps of after an operation command scheduling network is constructed by deploying a Mesh node ad hoc network comprising mobile terminal equipment and an unmanned aerial vehicle according to a target outdoor operation environment, dividing temporary task groups according to acquired equipment information and position information of each mobile terminal equipment, issuing an initial operation scheduling instruction to the temporary task groups according to a preset operation execution plan, analyzing and processing transmission data of mobile terminal equipment in each temporary task group received in real time according to task processing priority to obtain task execution states, comprehensively analyzing each task execution state to obtain an operation scheduling strategy, and converting the operation scheduling strategy into the operation scheduling instruction to be sent to each temporary task group. The invention can realize real-time reliable monitoring of the operation risk and the process and reasonable command and dispatch of the task, and effectively improve the working efficiency, quality and safety of outdoor operation.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;GUANGZHOU HAIGE COMMUNICATION GROUP INC CO

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle on-the-fly network transmission method for channel sorting by predicting time delay
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) femto-based transmission method for channel sorting by predicting time delay, which belongs to the unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network field, and comprises the steps of firstly dividing an UAV group into a master machine and a slave machine, receiving the same data packet according to a specified frequency, detecting the transmission rates of different channels in real time and sorting the channels according to a descending order of the transmission rates, judging the channels of the corresponding grade for different transmission data according to the priority when the master machine receives a plurality of data packets, determining the predicted time delay according to real-time environments such as the used channels, so as to define a time gap for the data transmission of the slave machine, forcibly cutting off the data transmission if the time gap is exceeded during transmission, and continuously transmitting the overtime data transmission to the channel with the lower rate.

title_en: Networking method based on wireless communication and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking method based on wireless communication and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, distributing unique IP addresses to each accessed sub-device through a sub-device IP address distribution program based on a concentrator; s2, constructing a self-organizing Bluetooth Mesh network for connecting the concentrator with each piece of sub-equipment in a multi-hop communication mode; step S3, data transmission between devices is carried out by utilizing the established Bluetooth Mesh network; and S4, controlling the concentrator to switch the communication mode according to the priority of data transmission through a dynamic priority scheduling mechanism and a dual-mode autonomous switching mechanism, and simultaneously responding to the high-priority task. The invention ensures the wireless data transmission efficiency and accuracy between the concentrator and the sub-equipment, solves the problems of resource redundancy and signal superposition interference of wireless transmission data, improves the reliability and safety of equipment connection in the networking, prolongs the service life of the concentrator and effectively reduces the running cost of the equipment in the networking.

title_en: Alarm system with a backup communication link between peers
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alarm system (10-1) and a monitoring method. The alarm system comprises at least one intrusion detector (11), a central unit (13-1) configured to communicate with a remote monitoring server (20) via a first communication protocol, and a backup module (12-1). The method comprises the following steps: - detecting an intrusion; - determining that the central unit is not able to reliably transmit an alert message to the remote monitoring server via the first communication protocol; - transmitting an alert message, by the backup module (12-1), to a peer backup module (12-2) of another alarm system (10-2), via a second communication protocol; - transmitting the alert message to the remote monitoring server (20) by the other alarm system (10-2).

title_en: Dynamic on-demand adjustment method for directional ad hoc network distributed time slot resources
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic on-demand adjustment method for directional ad hoc network distributed time slot resources, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an initial network node randomly selects a time slot allocation state serial number, performs neighbor discovery, connects network nodes, and enters the next step; judging whether the state serial number adjustment is needed or not; each calculating a new state sequence number to be selected and an adjustment priority; selecting a node with higher adjustment priority to adjust the state sequence number; and the node needing to be regulated notifies the state change information to the neighbor node until receiving the response information sent by the neighbor node. The invention is convenient for the rapid construction of the network, and satisfies the QoS requirements of different types of services under the high-speed dynamic change scene of the network topology; the dynamic adjustment is implemented by adopting the minimum cost judgment criterion, a new state sequence number can be found, and the communication requirement of the neighbor node is met, so that the network topology structure is influenced in a minimized way while the network capacity is optimized.

title_en: Flight ad hoc network opportunistic routing decision-making method based on fuzzy logic prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight ad hoc network opportunistic routing decision method based on fuzzy logic prediction, and relates to the technical field of flight ad hoc networks. The method comprises the following steps: basic information of each node in the flight ad hoc network is obtained; based on the basic information of each node, predicting the future position of each node by adopting a Gaussian Markov model; calculating normalized position factors, speed factors and energy factors of all nodes according to future positions and basic information of all nodes, inputting the position factors, the speed factors and the energy factors into a fuzzy logic reasoning system, and outputting a candidate forwarding node set; calculating a distance factor, a delivery probability factor, a normalized speed factor and an energy factor of each candidate forwarding node in the candidate forwarding node set, and calculating a priority value of each candidate forwarding node by adopting a priority function; and determining the candidate forwarding node corresponding to the maximum priority value as the forwarding node, and completing the opportunistic routing decision. The invention can effectively improve the network performance and the data transmission efficiency of the flight ad hoc network.

title_en: Method and system for near-field pairing on a current limited portable communication device
abstract_en: A method and system for dynamically managing wireless pairing of a portable radio device and an accessory are provided. A multi-stage wireless pairing mode applies a first BT pairing stage that utilizes NFC and BT communication, while disabling low-priority, high-current communications of the portable radio device. The second BT pairing stage turns off the NFC pairing, maintains BT, and re-enables the low-priority, high-current communications. Any occurrence of a high-priority, high-current mission critical event disables the multi-stage pairing mode and services the event. User notifications and are dynamically managed to avoid user interference during the pairing.

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network optimization method and ad hoc network equipment based on MIMO technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ad hoc networks, and in particular relates to a wireless ad hoc network optimization method and ad hoc network equipment based on MIMO technology, comprising the following steps: link duration prediction is associated with logic characteristics of the MIMO system, link duration prediction and route reconstruction are carried out by using a mean difference interpolation method, and a model combining the predicted link duration with a backup mechanism is established; a routing method based on dynamic topology evolution is designed by combining the QoS grade of the power emergency communication service, and service priority communication service guarantee is realized by optimizing the channel allocation and content distribution strategy of the wireless ad hoc network.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Scalable realtime mesh network with universal artificial intelligence safety devices
abstract_en: A safety monitoring AI system comprising interconnected safety AI wearable devices and a remote monitoring AI server to handle real-time data prioritizing urgent safety signals to optimize response time, wherein the safety wearable devices comprise multiple sensors (GPS, temperature, heart rate, humidity, VOC etc), advanced communication capabilities (LTE 4G, NB-IoT, LTE-M, NTN) and can be worn in various versatile configurations without any modification (belt, armband, ankle, helmet, etc); and wherein the AI devices form a peer-to-peer mesh network architecture exchanging relay signals to eliminate single points of failure, share safety-critical data through neighboring devices and preprocess data at device level. The invention allows to enhance workplace safety across various industries by offering a scalable, integrated solution that can adapt to different wearing configurations and operational requirements while maintaining robust communication and monitoring capabilities.

title_en: Worksite alert system
abstract_en: This invention is directed to an ad-hoc peer-to-peer wireless worksite alert system with transceiver devices that communicate with each other using radio signals encoded with a unique identifier for each of the transceiver devices and provide light and audio alerts for worksite workers using the transceiver devices. Each transceiver device includes an alert indicator light, an audio speaker for emitting a siren, and a processor for scanning and transmitting status and alert radio signals. The ad-hoc peer-to-peer wireless worksite alert system does not require a centralized receiver unit and employs a mesh network for direct peer-to-peer communication. The simplicity of a peer-to-peer mesh network provides reliability and the ability to expand the mesh network as needed without additional and expensive equipment for centralized network control and relay.
assignees: CHAND AARON;EVANS II THOMAS JAMES;JONES SALVADOR BAYLEE MARIE;KEITH JUSTIN JAMES;KLINGER MIKAYLA LAUREN;LOPEZ MARCUS RAY;MARDO RACHEL EVE;MARDO SARIAH ELIZABETH;RYEN NOLAN ALEXANDER

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network anti-interference method, device and equipment based on wide and narrow band waveforms
abstract_en: The application relates to a wireless ad hoc network anti-interference method, device and equipment based on a broadband and narrowband waveform. The method comprises the steps of carrying out distributed networking on a plurality of nodes by adopting a TDMA protocol at an initial working frequency to form a wireless self-networking, dividing a TDMA time slot of a MAC layer of the wireless self-networking into a control time slot respectively adopting a narrowband waveform and a service time slot adopting a wideband waveform, and adopting a TD-FDMA protocol to fuse the wideband waveform and the narrowband waveform to realize wireless self-networking anti-interference based on the wideband-narrowband fused waveform, wherein the TDMA protocol is adopted and the narrowband frequency hopping waveform is utilized to carry out wireless self-networking maintenance and ultra-high priority narrowband service transmission under the control time slot, and the FDMA protocol is adopted and the wideband self-adaptive frequency selecting waveform is utilized to carry out wideband service transmission under the service time slot. The method can improve the scale of the wireless ad hoc network and the anti-interference performance and effectiveness of the network.
assignees: HUNAN ZHILING COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Computerized systems and methods for an adaptive multi-link operation mesh network
abstract_en: Disclosed are systems and methods that provide a computerized network management framework that adaptively configures a network at a location to optimize network usage and application operation thereon. The disclosed framework enables the implementation of MLO functionality within WiFi 7 enabled mesh networks based on end user activity. The disclosed network management framework can leverage information related to the detection of application instances on a network, in addition to determinations of such applications' priority of operations on the network, and dynamically activate MLO links across certain branches of the topology of a location's network (e.g., the locations' operational mesh network). This, among other benefits, can provide faster speeds, lower latency and increased capacity for the network and the devices operating therein/thereon.

title_en: Mesh network redundancy optimization method, mesh network distribution method and state reporting method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a Mesh network redundancy optimization method and device, a Mesh network distribution method and device, a state reporting method and device, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that a first client associated with an intelligent terminal sends a broadcast frame to a Mesh network through the intelligent terminal, constraint conditions for devices with different priorities are included in the broadcast frame, so that second clients associated with the devices with different priorities respectively determine devices matched with the corresponding constraint conditions as target devices, and the associated operations are executed for the target devices in sequence according to priority information of the target devices. By the scheme, redundant broadcasting of the Mesh network is reduced, air resources are utilized efficiently, interference of the redundant broadcasting to surrounding air signals is avoided, transmission efficiency of the Mesh network is improved, and use experience of users is further improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG AIKESI JINGLING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic resource allocation method and device of self-organizing network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic resource allocation method and device of an ad hoc network and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that any node obtains first priority codes according to a preset priority rule, the first priority codes are sent to all neighbor nodes in a resource application time slot, each neighbor node carries out conflict detection on all received first priority codes, if the detection result is judged to be that no conflict occurs, no information is sent in a conflict resolution time slot, if the detection result is judged to be that the conflict occurs, the priorities of all the first priority codes are compared to obtain second priority codes, the second priority codes are returned to the corresponding neighbor nodes in the conflict resolution time slot, any node monitors the conflict resolution time slot, and when the monitoring result is judged to be that no information is received or the priority of the received second priority codes is lower than the first priority codes, the resource application is determined to be successful, so that resource allocation is completed. And the user experience is improved.

title_en: Backhaul path configuration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a backhaul channel configuration method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, by the method, the target channel suitable for being used as a special backhaul channel can be determined from backhaul channels according to a preset priority strategy and backhaul parameters of each channel, and the target channel is configured as the special backhaul channel of an access point, so that smoothness of the backhaul channel can be effectively ensured, the network performance of the special backhaul channel is ensured because multiplexing of the backhaul channel is not needed, the problem that the backhaul channel affects the network performance can be solved, the stability and reliability among access points of a Mesh network are effectively improved, the configuration process is convenient and easy to implement, and the method is suitable for the scene of configuration of various backhaul channels and has strong universality.

title_en: Network coverage method and monitoring system based on Mesh networking equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network coverage method and a monitoring system based on Mesh networking equipment, which comprise the steps of taking single Mesh networking equipment as networking nodes, generating Mesh networking sublinks through virtualization by adjusting a networking node connection mode, combining a plurality of networking nodes to form a single sublink unit group, selecting the networking nodes from each sublink unit group as link nodes, connecting each link node to form Mesh networking sublinks, wherein the number of the Mesh networking sublinks is not less than that of the networking nodes in the single sublink unit group, the Mesh networking sublinks generate wireless coverage layers with the same number as that of the Mesh networking sublinks, connecting the Mesh networking sublinks through the networking nodes, dividing transmission data into the same grades as that of the Mesh networking sublinks, and determining transmission priority according to the grades of the transmission data. The monitoring system comprises an acquisition layer, a network layer and an application layer. The invention realizes the low-cost arrangement of the wireless transmission network in the cable tunnel with weak communication signals, and improves the network transmission efficiency.
assignees: HENAN POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for improving performance of wireless Mesh network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for improving the performance of a wireless Mesh network, which relate to the field of intelligent control of the wireless Mesh network, and the method comprises the steps of setting a random delay time when the state of equipment changes by establishing a state reporting mechanism of the equipment end, and reporting the state of the equipment after the random delay; the method comprises the steps of carrying out congestion detection according to a report result of equipment state, monitoring the data packet receiving quantity in a Mesh network in real time, counting the data packet receiving quantity per second, comparing with a set threshold value to judge whether the network is congested, carrying out congestion treatment according to the congestion result, further delaying the report of the equipment state when the network is detected to be congested, and dynamically adjusting the delay additional time according to the actual network condition to relieve the network congestion. According to the invention, through the comprehensive application of the equipment-side state reporting mechanism, the air packet congestion detection and processing and the instruction priority mechanism, the problem of network congestion is effectively relieved, the stability and the control instantaneity of the system are ensured, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Networking protocol implementation method and system applied to ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of networking protocol realization methods, in particular to a networking protocol realization method and a networking protocol realization system applied to an ad hoc network, comprising the following steps of creating an Rf channel table; the method comprises the steps of creating an Rf node table, creating an Rf forwarding table, creating an Rf control table, storing and managing data information of a networking channel through the Rf control table, dynamically adjusting data transmission priorities through a data priority strategy to ensure that data with different priorities meet preset transmission requirements in a transmission process, and sequentially realizing multi-layer progressive control and dynamic optimization of the communication node priorities through algorithms based on a composite mathematical model, adaptive weight calculation, dynamic expansion threshold setting, progressive ordering and Markov chain regression prediction in the communication node management process, wherein the adaptive weight model can update the node priorities in real time, flexibly respond according to weight adjustment requirements of the nodes in different network states, and the response capability of the network to burst loads is improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing mcptt service
abstract_en: An example method for providing a Mission Critical Push To Talk (MCPTT) service may include receiving a message created from any one user among users of an MCPTT group, analyzing the message, and setting a floor priority of the users of the MCPTT group, based on a result of analyzing the message. The analyzing of the message includes classifying a type of the message. The classifying of the type of the message includes identifying whether the message is an interrogative type message or an imperative type message.

title_en: Ad hoc network dynamic networking method and system based on MAC layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of networking methods, in particular to an ad hoc network dynamic networking method and system based on an MAC layer, which are used for acquiring topology relation information of nodes in a network, acquiring distance information among the nodes, generating a topology sensing matrix based on the topology relation information, calculating a priority matrix according to the topology sensing matrix, evaluating service capacity of each node based on the priority matrix and the distance information, calculating reliability of each node according to the service capacity, distributing time slots for each node based on the reliability, generating a route optimization matrix according to the priority matrix, the reliability and the distance information, outputting priority, the service capacity, the reliability, a time slot distribution result and route optimization information of each node, and taking into account the direct connection relation of the nodes, capturing the position and influence of the nodes in the whole network by introducing an innovative priority matrix calculation method, so that network resource distribution is more reasonable, and the overall throughput of the network is remarkably improved.

title_en: Intelligent construction site networking and monitoring method based on WAPI technology and MESH network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent construction site networking and monitoring method based on a WAPI technology and a MESH network, which comprises the steps of collecting operation data of super nodes in a construction site environment, dividing a region according to the operation data, obtaining power consumption of the super nodes by using a self-adaptive energy consumption optimization method based on the operation data of the super nodes, adjusting task allocation of the super nodes according to the power consumption, obtaining weighted priorities of the tasks of the super nodes by combining a weighted priority adjustment method after the task allocation adjustment, adjusting transmission weights of the tasks of the super nodes, evaluating comprehensive task cost of the super nodes by using a comprehensive task cost evaluation method after the transmission weights of the tasks are adjusted, and carrying out task scheduling and topology adjustment of the super nodes to finish construction site networking and monitoring. The invention can adapt to topology change in complex dynamic environment, improve network stability, prolong service life of network node, and effectively manage task flow and resource allocation.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight route design method and system suitable for chain broadband wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight route design method and a lightweight route design system suitable for a chain broadband wireless ad hoc network. The system comprises a configuration network node, a definition node routing architecture, a configuration data packet classifier module, a delay module, a general module, a neighbor list module, a neighbor information manager module, a delay estimator module, a data packet queue module, a queue processing module, a MAC receiver module and a MAC transmitter module. The method comprises the steps of classifying and calculating the queuing of delay data packets and general data packets according to a data frame structure, periodically updating a neighbor list according to the data packets with adjacent relations, estimating the time required by local queue transmission, queuing delay data and general data according to priorities, and establishing a forwarding link. The nodes automatically complete path planning and queue sequencing in real time according to the routing protocol architecture, do not need to be uniformly and intensively scheduled by an upper layer route, and do not occupy network resources. The method ensures the maximum utilization of node resources on the basis of communication delay.

title_en: Transmission resource scheduling method of wireless ad hoc network and wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission resource scheduling method of a wireless ad hoc network and the wireless ad hoc network, the method comprises the steps of carrying out message transmission on each original service to be processed in a cyclic response end-to-end retransmission mode according to the sequence from high service priority to low service priority in a public network access stage, wherein each original service to be processed corresponds to the service priority, each service priority corresponds to a threshold, establishing a task sub-network and adjusting the service priority of each target service to be processed in the task sub-network in response to a task sub-network establishment request, acquiring a system busy degree statistical value, accessing the target service to be processed into a target channel and sending the target channel if the threshold corresponding to the service priority of the target service to be processed is larger than the system busy degree statistical value, and executing random back-off operation on the target service to be processed if the threshold corresponding to the service priority of the target service to be processed is smaller than or equal to the system busy degree statistical value. The invention can ensure the success rate of the transmission of the high-priority service and has low time delay.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGKE XUNDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: RRC connection control method under network fault condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an RRC connection control system and method under the condition of network failure. The method comprises the following steps of setting an IMSI white list of a high-priority user, judging whether the user is the high-priority user through an IMSI number section, transmitting a user grade and the IMSI to an RRC connection release batch calculation module, calculating a release batch of the user by the RRC connection release batch calculation module according to the user grade and the 4-bit number after the IMSI, and dynamically adjusting the time interval of batch release according to the batch. The invention identifies the IMSI number segment to determine the user type, and carries out discrete batch on the user based on a specific formula, thereby ensuring that the user with high priority can be released preferentially, optimizing network resource management and improving disaster recovery capability.

title_en: Methods for a tiered deployment of mission critical applications in a multi-access edge computing (mec) environment
abstract_en: A tiered deployment of mission critical applications in a multi- access edge computing (MEC) environment is provided herein. In an example, a wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may receive a request for a MEC host status of the WTRU. Further, the WTRU may receive configuration information, including priority information for one or more service applications. Also, the WTRU may report a first level of operation, for a first service application of the one or more service applications, based upon one or more current signal conditions. Moreover, the WTRU may receive an instantiate application message responsive to the reported first level of operation. In an example, the first instantiate MEC application message is an instantiate mission critical MEC application message.

title_en: Service priority guaranteeing method for relay access of ad hoc network terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of 5G communication, and particularly relates to a service priority guaranteeing method for relay access of an ad hoc network terminal. The method of the invention carries out packet detection on high priority service such as voice service of the self-organizing network terminal through the N3IWF network element, and sends a special stream creation instruction to the PCF network element where the relay terminal is located when the SIP signaling of voice initiated by the self-organizing network terminal is detected, thereby triggering the relay terminal to establish special stream with the 5G base station and the 5G core network and guaranteeing the voice service priority transmission of the self-organizing network terminal. According to the service priority guaranteeing method for relay access of the ad hoc network terminal, the no-3GPP access technology and the ADC technology of the 3GPP are effectively combined, the problem of guaranteeing high-priority service transmission of specific users is solved under the relay access frame of a private network application scene, the whole system under the ad hoc network and 5G network fusion networking has the capability of end-to-end differential data transmission, and the user experience is greatly improved.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Self-discovery ad hoc network control method based on hong Meng operating system
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-discovery ad hoc network control method based on a hong operation system, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of extracting identification information and communication parameters of equipment from all equipment to be networked based on the hong operation system; the method comprises the steps of judging compatibility of communication protocol versions and maximum supported bandwidths among devices, determining a control relation between a master device and slave devices, dynamically distributing communication resources for each device by adopting a distributed channel distribution algorithm in combination with task requirements and network bandwidth information of the devices, periodically synchronizing resource states of the devices, updating networking candidate data and redefining a networking control relation after the master device releases corresponding communication resources when the slave device sends a request for exiting networking, and automatically taking a device with the highest priority from the slave devices when the master device exits to complete reconstruction of the networking control relation.
assignees: HANGZHOU MIAOLIAN INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ad hoc network-based unmanned aerial vehicle nest communication method and device supporting audio and video hierarchical transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle nest communication method and device supporting audio and video hierarchical transmission based on an ad hoc network, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission. The method comprises the steps of setting service priority, judging whether received data belong to the device or not based on an ID (identity) in the received data, if not, putting the received data into a transmission waiting queue with different service priorities according to service types, if so, forwarding payload data in the received data to peripheral equipment of the device, simultaneously receiving the peripheral equipment data of the device, putting the data into the transmission waiting queue with different service priorities according to service types, and when a transmission time slot of the device arrives, transmitting the data which does not exceed available bandwidth in the transmission waiting queue according to the service priorities.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV POWER TRANS COMPANY;UNIV CIVIL AVIATION FLIGHT CHINA

title_en: Controlled interception area width determining method integrating competition mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a controlled interception area width determining method integrating a competition mechanism, and belongs to the field of wireless ad hoc networks. In the establishment phase of the controlled interception area, a control message mechanism is utilized to combine the transmission hop count and the priority parameter, so that N can be increased when important information is transmitted preferentially or transmitted with large hop count, more cooperative communication nodes are introduced, and the network user capacity can be prevented from being influenced by occupying too many nodes through proper N when the transmission of small hop count is performed, and in addition, when the establishment of the controlled interception area fails, the invention can dynamically adjust N to reestablish connection. The invention optimizes the confirmation method of the controlled interception area width, merges the competition mechanism, solves the problem of sudden network congestion, can dynamically adjust N according to actual conditions to meet different information transmission requirements, and improves the QoS guarantee of the relay network.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Fire scene auxiliary decision support system based on mobile ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene auxiliary decision support system based on a mobile self-organizing network, which particularly relates to the technical field of fire decision, and comprises the steps of constructing the mobile self-organizing network based on fire according to a fire occurrence area, determining fixed nodes, movable nodes and substitute nodes, determining the dangerousness and influence of the substitute nodes through map analysis, analyzing the uncertainty entropy value of fire information data, collecting node importance data of the substitute nodes, determining the delay time of fire spread through the autocorrelation analysis of the temperature and time at the lost nodes, comparing the delay time with the time from the substitute nodes to the lost nodes, collecting the node timeliness data of the substitute nodes, comprehensively evaluating the node importance data and the node timeliness data, and quantifying the priority of each substitute node.

title_en: building management control system
title_ko: 건물 관리 제어 시스템
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a building management control system capable of stably controlling and driving a remote control panel in consideration of the current situation of the building and the characteristics of the building. A building management control system comprises: a remote control panel for controlling a field device provided in a building; and a management device for managing a plurality of the remote control panels provided in the building. The remote control panel includes a housing, a main module, and a signal module. The management device includes: a setting unit for checking an operation load of the field device allocated to each of the plurality of remote control panels and allocating a priority to the plurality of remote control panels in consideration of the operation load related to each of the remote control panels; and an operation unit for controlling a power cut-off order of the remote control panel or a backup load between the plurality of remote control panels according to the priority allocated to each of the remote control panels when a special situation including at least one of communication failure, fire occurrence, and emergency evacuation occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 관리 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건물에 마련되는 기계설비, 전기설비 및 통신설비 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 현장기기를 제어하는 원격제어반; 및 상기 건물에 마련되는 다수의 상기 원격제어반을 관리하는 관리장치;를 포함하며, 상기 원격제어반은, 하우징과, 상기 하우징 내측에 설치되며 상기 현장기기를 제어하기 위한 메인모듈과, 상기 메인모듈과 전기적으로 연결되고 상기 현장기기로부터 인가되는 데이터 신호를 수신하여 상기 메인모듈로 전달하거나 상기 현장기기의 작동을 제어하기 위한 데이터 신호를 상기 현장기기로 전달하는 신호모듈을 포함하며, 상기 관리장치는, 다수의 상기 원격제어반마다 할당되는 상기 현장기기의 작동 부하를 확인하고, 각각의 상기 원격제어반과 관련된 상기 작동 부하를 고려하여 다수의 상기 원격제어반에 대하여 우선순위를 할당하는 설정부; 및 통신장애, 화재발생, 긴급대피 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 특수상황 발생 시, 각각의 상기 원격제어반에 할당된 우선순위에 따라 상기 원격제어반의 전원 차단순서 또는 다수의 상기 원격제어반 상호간의 백업 부하를 제어하는 작동부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Directional ad hoc network node receiving and transmitting state distribution method based on service priority
abstract_en: A method for distributing receiving and transmitting state of directed ad hoc network node based on service priority includes querying highest priority of transmitting service in all wave beams of next time slot by each node in network in service queue first, obtaining highest priority of transmitting service to said node by all neighbor nodes in next time slot through network node information table, determining receiving and transmitting state of said node by high priority service, updating service queue finally and updating service priority and destination node number of said node in next time slot to network node information table as for same network node, setting at least one receiving time slot between two transmitting services. The method for distributing the receiving and transmitting states of the directed ad hoc network nodes is simple in implementation mode and high in practicability, not only can meet communication requirements according to service priorities, but also can reduce information interaction and corresponding communication time delay required by adjusting the receiving and transmitting states of the nodes.

title_en: System and method for detecting threats
abstract_en: Disclosed implementations provide a system of sensing modules that can operate in conjunction with a Software as a Service (SaaS) backend to detect and alert of various threats. The sensing modules can be installed at fixed locations or can be mobile. All sensing and detection processing can be accomplished by the sensing module or by several sensing modules cooperating on a mesh network or other network communication architecture. Privacy is preserved because all raw sensor data collected for analysis is processed locally at the sensing module(s) and deleted immediately following the completion of analysis. Accordingly, raw sensor data is inaccessible outside of the sensing module(s) which can be secured through hardware and software security techniques.

title_en: Intelligent gateway equipment interconnection method and system of Bluetooth ad hoc network protocol
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gateway equipment interconnection method and system of a Bluetooth Ad hoc network protocol, which are applied to the field of communication data processing; the invention ensures the stability and load balance of communication, avoids the generation of network bottleneck by self-adaptive node management, updating the network topology structure in real time and optimizing the connection priority, and simultaneously can uniformly distribute data among a plurality of intelligent gateways by intelligent data flow distribution, thereby avoiding overload of part of the gateways, improving the efficiency of the whole system, optimizing the response speed by local execution of edge calculation, reducing delay, cooperatively processing key control tasks such as equipment linkage, data distribution, abnormal response and the like by a distributed computing architecture, and improving the flexibility and processing capacity of the system.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUATENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain forest fire prevention communication networking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain forest fire prevention communication networking method and system, and belongs to the technical field of networking communication. The method comprises the following steps of transmitting field audio and video data to an arm wearing terminal and a command center in real time by a central monitoring platform, generating a fire spreading trend chart based on the field data, obtaining fire spreading indexes in all directions of a fire based on the fire spreading trend chart, sending fire extinguishing priority to the command center, and analyzing a fire area danger index based on fire spreading conditions and field environment data. According to the invention, the fire spreading index and the regional danger index are obtained for the forest fire scene in regions, so that the optimal allocation of fire scene extinguishing resources is realized, the safety and the flexibility of extinguishing teams are improved, and the problem that the fire extinguishing efficiency is lower because the communication efficiency is improved only through the ad hoc network in the prior art and the firefighters cannot be reasonably and dynamically adjusted and allocated according to the burning condition of the forest fire scene is solved.
assignees: YIYUAN EMERGENCY RESCUE COMMAND SUPPORT SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Temperature control type network optimization method and system for wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature control network optimizing method and system of wireless ad hoc network, which comprises installing a temperature acquisition module and a heat dissipation device at wireless ad hoc network node, sampling node related information according to preset period, generating adjacent node detection message at the node, broadcasting detection message to the adjacent node, transmitting detection reply message to the node by the adjacent node, and sequentially writing related information of the node and the adjacent node into a temporary data queue, calculating link quality average values of the node and the adjacent node to generate a node link quality priority list, controlling the heat dissipation device according to the difference value of the link quality average values and the threshold value, generating a control message according to the link connection relation, and updating the link and the network topology according to the control message. The method and the system effectively control the working temperature and the energy consumption of the node equipment, avoid the equipment performance reduction caused by long-term high-load work, and solve the problem of network delay caused by the reduction.

title_en: Cluster unmanned aerial vehicle multi-terminal remote control conflict detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cluster unmanned aerial vehicle multi-terminal remote control conflict detection method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a Mesh networking is established by a cluster unmanned aerial vehicle measurement and control terminal, and the terminal is added into a default Mesh networking when started. And then, when the terminal acquires the remote control rights of the cluster unmanned aerial vehicle, the terminal sends the serial number of the cluster unmanned aerial vehicle for acquiring the remote control rights to the Mesh networking. Secondly, after receiving the serial numbers of the clustered unmanned aerial vehicles, other terminals in the Mesh networking are compared with the permission of the unmanned aerial vehicle controlled by the terminals. And finally, popping up a prompt box when the remote control permission conflict of the cluster unmanned aerial vehicle exists, and carrying out remote control permission substitution coverage on the low-priority cluster unmanned aerial vehicle measurement and control terminal by the remote control permission of the high-priority cluster unmanned aerial vehicle measurement and control terminal under the default condition, otherwise, not carrying out operation. According to the invention, when the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster performs flight task control, the authority operation of the measurement and control terminals of all the clustered unmanned aerial vehicles can be autonomously monitored and treated, and the problem of conflict of remote control authorities of the clustered unmanned aerial vehicles is effectively solved.
assignees: NO 60 INST OF CHINA RONGTONG GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: In-vehicle wireless network system and interworking method between in-vehicle device nodes
title_ko: 차랑내 무선 네트워크 시스템과 차량내 디바이스 간 무선 네트워크 연동 방법 방법
abstract_en: A wireless network system within a vehicle according to one embodiment of the present invention is a wireless network system within a vehicle comprising a plurality of device nodes including a source node and a target node, wherein the source node compares a first message ID that it intends to transmit to the target node with a second message ID that the target node is currently processing, and if the first message ID has a higher priority than the second message ID, the source node transmits a first data packet containing the first message ID and the content of the first message to the target node, and if the first message ID has a lower priority than the second message ID, the source node withholds the transmission of the first data packet to the target node. According to an embodiment of the present invention, even if the connection between two device nodes is severed, a connection can be established through another device in the wireless mesh network, thereby providing a more reliable wireless network environment within the vehicle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 하나의 실시예에 따른 차랑내 무선 네트워크 시스템은 소스 노드와 타겟 노드를 포함하는 복수의 디바이스 노드들이 속하는 차랑내 무선 네트워크 시스템으로서, 상기 소스 노드가 상기 타겟 노드에 전송하고자 하는 제1 메시지 ID와 상기 타겟 노드가 현재 처리하고 있는 제2 메시지 ID를 비교하고, 상기 제1 메시지 ID가 상기 제2 메시지 ID보다 우선 순위가 높은 경우, 상기 소스 노드가 상기 1 메시지 ID와 제1 메시지 내용을 포함한 제1 데이터 패킷을 상기 타겟 노드에 전송하고, 상기 제1 메시지 ID가 상기 제2 메시지 ID보다 우선 순위가 낮은 경우, 상기 소스 노드가 상기 제1 데이터 패킷의 상기 타겟 노드에의 전송을 보류한다.  
본 발명의 실시예에 따르면 두 디바이스 노드 사이에 연결이 끝기는 경우에도, 무선 메쉬 네트워크에 있는 다른 디바이스를 통해 연결이 가능하므로 보다 신뢰성 있는 차량내 무선 네트워크 환경을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Wireless intercom and intelligent home integrated system oriented to intelligent community and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless intercom and intelligent home integrated system facing an intelligent community and a control method thereof, an ad hoc network wireless local area network is constructed through an ESP-WIFI-MESH protocol, and comprises an outdoor host, a wireless repeater and an indoor extension. The system adopts mesh topology to realize multi-hop redundant transmission, automatically selects an optimal path, ensures communication reliability, and supports dynamic priority scheduling of alarm, voice, video and intelligent home control data, wherein alarm signals are highest in priority. The indoor extension is integrated with a multi-protocol gateway, is compatible with Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/ZigBee equipment, and realizes intelligent home wireless access of water and electricity meters and the like. The district integrated management platform monitors the state of equipment in a centralized way and supports remote management, abnormal detection and emergency linkage. The system has the advantages of low cost, easy expansion, short construction period and the like, effectively solves the problems of complex wiring, signal shielding and the like in the transformation of old communities, and improves the intelligentization of community security.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN AOMIN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ad hoc network wireless intercom system and method facing old community transformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ad hoc network wireless intercom system and method facing old community transformation, wherein the system is composed of an outdoor wireless digital host, a wireless repeater and a wireless indoor extension, an ad hoc multi-hop wireless local area network is built based on an ESP-WIFI-MESH protocol, redundant communication is realized by adopting a MESH topological structure, and the problems of high wiring cost and poor wireless signal coverage in the prior art are solved. The talkback method marks the alarm instruction as the highest level through a priority transmission mechanism, the preemption channel ensures zero delay of emergency signals, and the voice and video data are scheduled in a grading way, so that the real-time performance and the bandwidth are balanced. The wireless repeater dynamically allocates IP addresses, supports extension plug and play, and realizes cross-building communication and remote management by combining with a local area network of a cell.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN AOMIN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network upgrading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless ad hoc network upgrading method which comprises the steps of demand analysis and preparation, upgrade package preparation, local wireless equipment selection, upgrade package uploading and classification, version inquiry and comparison, upgrade sequence planning, upgrade task pre-allocation, verification and preparation before upgrade, upgrade task slicing and parallel processing, dynamic upgrade progress adjustment and retry mechanism, equipment grouping and priority management, safety verification and encrypted transmission. According to the invention, an upgrade target is definitely analyzed through careful demand, an upgrade package is prepared to fully improve the integrity, high-performance equipment is selected to be stable, orderly upgrade and balance promotion are performed according to network topology, task segmentation is accelerated in parallel, retry and dynamic adjustment are reliable, encryption is verified safely, and the upgrade efficiency and the overall safety of the wireless ad hoc network are effectively improved.

title_en: Centerless ad hoc network emergency communication command method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a centerless ad hoc network emergency communication command method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing communication frequency, channel resources, power control parameters and routing strategies for all nodes in a network; the method comprises the steps of generating an initial connection relation table among nodes and an initial topological structure of a network according to communication frequency and channel resources, distributing route paths leading to other nodes for each node and recording, collecting real-time communication load data of links on the route paths, calculating link communication congestion degree, updating the node connection relation and the route paths according to the congestion degree, generating an emergency communication task model, determining task priority and distributing tasks to nodes meeting the conditions, synchronously updating the communication frequency, the channel resources and the route paths of the nodes, starting the nodes in an ad hoc network to execute the emergency communication tasks, and improving network performance and task scheduling reliability.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY HUAXIASHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-organizing network communication system of no signal area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal-free area ad hoc network communication system, which particularly relates to the technical field of wireless communication and is used for solving the problem that the connectivity critical state caused by node density or mobility change in a low-density network is not fully considered in the existing dynamic routing protocol, pre-judging the network connectivity critical state by acquiring node position coordinates and communication radius in real time and combining average node spacing and moving direction dispersion, screening high-priority detection nodes based on obstacle avoidance cooperative angle variance and virtual pheromone concentration in the critical state, adaptively adjusting the sending frequency of detection messages according to the moving speed of the nodes, constructing a path stability assessment model by fusing the survival time of the links, node residual energy and signal strength fluctuation rate, dynamically screening high-stability paths as main transmission links and the rest as standby links, and rapidly switching to a path with optimal comprehensive stability in the standby links under abnormal states by monitoring the fluctuation characteristics of the main link signals in real time.
assignees: INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Data store and forward operation, apparatus and computer readable medium
abstract_en: A wireless communication method includes a first communication node transmitting a first message to a second communication node, the first message including at least one of a store and forward indication, data to be forwarded, or a forward priority, and the first communication node receiving a second message from the second communication node in response to the first message. Another wireless communication method includes a first communication node receiving data to be forwarded from a second communication node, the data to be forwarded from a third communication node, and transmitting at least one of a delivery indication or a delivery time.

title_en: Satellite broadband Ad hoc network converged communication method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite broadband ad hoc network fusion communication method and a system, which belong to the technical field of wireless communication networks, and comprise the steps of obtaining signal quality parameters of satellite communication links and distribution density parameters of ad hoc network nodes, performing feature extraction to generate a network state feature vector, generating a dynamic switching decision instruction by combining a preset spectrum interference threshold value and satellite coverage parameters to perform dynamic switching operation of the satellite links and the ad hoc network links to generate a switching result parameter, performing routing weight distribution on satellite transmission paths and ad hoc network relay nodes to generate fusion routing paths, and performing priority split charging and encryption compression on heterogeneous data streams to generate self-adaptive transmission data packets. The invention adopts the network state feature vector extraction, dynamic switching decision instruction generation and fusion route path distribution technology, can realize the efficient coordination of satellite and ad hoc network resources under complex electromagnetic environment and dynamic topology scene, and remarkably improves the communication reliability and the frequency spectrum utilization rate.
assignees: JIANGSU ANRUIXUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Communication ad hoc network method and system applied to capital construction no-signal field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication ad hoc network method and a system applied to a signal-free field of a foundation, belonging to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the spatial distribution of node equipment to obtain each initial planning path; creating a four-dimensional spectrum map, dynamically adjusting a modulation mode, determining the quality of each initial planning path, building a service priority, judging whether energy supply is needed, building a communication-energy consumption optimization algorithm to obtain a network optimization scheme, building a node equipment trust degree model, determining an optimal transmission path, building a node fault prediction model, predicting node equipment faults and triggering maintenance instructions. The invention can quickly build a stable communication network, reduce cost, improve communication reliability and safety, optimize energy consumption management, prolong the service life of the node equipment battery, ensure the continuity of key business, adapt to dynamic construction environment and realize intelligent automatic communication management.
assignees: BEIJING HUALIAN ELECTRIC POWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD;ENGINEERING MAN BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Heterogeneous mobile ad hoc network distributed network clustering method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heterogeneous mobile ad hoc network distributed network clustering method and system, which comprise the steps of responding to the starting of an enhancement node or a common node, controlling the enhancement node or the common node to broadcast attribute information thereof and receiving attribute information of a neighbor node to acquire delay distance data and priority data, determining a priority core node based on the delay distance data and the priority data of the enhancement node or the common node, establishing a cluster attribution relation of the enhancement node or the common node and density association information exchange among the priority core nodes, constructing an initial cluster structure in a distributed mode, screening the enhancement node from the priority core node as a cluster head candidate, selecting a cluster head from the cluster head candidate, and controlling the enhancement node or the common node to join in a cluster and allocate a network address through the cluster head based on a clustering mechanism of the enhancement node and the common node. The invention improves the interconnection efficiency between the intra-cluster autonomy and the inter-cluster, and ensures the orderly, efficient and stable structure of the cluster control in the dynamic environment.

title_en: WIFI mesh channel dynamic allocation method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a WIFI Mesh channel dynamic allocation method and device, which are used for intelligently adjusting RU size and position allocation by monitoring network flow, equipment density and channel interference in real time, improving channel resource utilization rate, adopting a four-dimensional candidate channel scoring model and a decision engine to perform channel allocation and interference prediction, realizing millisecond-level RU dynamic scheduling, meeting low-delay service requirements of AR/VR, 4K video and the like, determining global channel state by signaling interaction and collaborative decision among Mesh nodes, avoiding conflict and performance bottleneck caused by local optimization, supporting RU flexible division mechanism of Wi-Fi 6/6E/7, adapting different frequency bands and bandwidth configuration, and ensuring high-efficiency access of heterogeneous equipment. In a word, the scheme solves the problems of stationarity, inefficiency and interference existing in RU allocation in the existing WiFi Mesh network, and achieves intelligent channel resource management with high reliability and low delay through dynamic priority layering, service type adaptation and interference avoidance technology.
assignees: HARBIN CIRCE SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network communication system based on high dynamic routing protocol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless ad hoc network communication system based on a high dynamic routing protocol, which relates to the field of wireless communication and comprises a data encapsulation module, a path generation module, a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a path selection module and an abnormality detection module; the data encapsulation module encapsulates information by binary codes and TCP protocol, the path generation module generates a transmission path by AODVjr protocol, the data acquisition module acquires node operation and path data, the data processing module calculates an electric quantity indicated value, a signal indicated value, a memory indicated value and a priority value of the node, the path selection module obtains a path comprehensive index according to the path data and the node priority value, a screening path is obtained according to the path comprehensive index, the abnormality detection module monitors data frame transmission and carries out corresponding processing, the data transmission path can be optimized, the accuracy and the stability of the data transmission are ensured, and the transmission efficiency of the wireless ad hoc network is improved.

title_en: Instruction set online circulation method
abstract_en: The application provides an instruction set online circulation method. By acquiring real-time disaster data and generating a standardized instruction set through a preset instruction process, the core defect of poor adaptability of the traditional system is overcome. Further, based on the hierarchical communication protocol and the dynamic priority scheduling algorithm, accurate transmission of instructions in the multi-level node architecture is achieved, and continuity is maintained through node ad hoc network particularly when communication is interrupted. And the execution link performs identity authentication and role matching dual verification through a permission white list mechanism, and acquires running state data in real time by combining the structured identification to form an execution effect evaluation closed loop. The method realizes the full-flow optimization from intelligent generation, robust transmission to safe execution and dynamic tracking of the emergency instruction, radically eliminates information island and response delay, and remarkably improves the flexibility and reliability of disaster response.

title_en: Ad hoc network time slot allocation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an ad hoc network time slot allocation method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of constructing a topological structure of a communication system, dividing the communication system into a plurality of clusters, carrying out inter-cluster frequency spectrum division on the clusters, carrying out intra-cluster time slot division on the clusters, wherein the time slot division adopts a time slot allocation algorithm, the time slot allocation algorithm predicts a channel according to channel state information and adjusts according to priority and code rate requirements of communication tasks so as to calculate a time slot allocation vector adapting to the channel state, and carrying out route construction based on the topological structure, the inter-cluster frequency spectrum division and the intra-cluster time slot division, thereby completing the networking of the communication system. And predicting the channel according to the channel state information through a time slot allocation algorithm, and comprehensively adjusting according to the priority of the communication task and the code rate requirement to calculate an optimal time slot allocation vector which can adapt to the channel state, thereby achieving the purpose of improving the channel utilization rate and the flexibility.
assignees: SILU FANTIAN GANSU COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic topology ad hoc network method based on environment perception and self-adaptive optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic topology self-networking method based on environment perception and self-adaptive optimization, which relates to the field of wireless sensor networks, and the invention is characterized in that parameters (such as temperature, obstacle distribution and node energy consumption) of nodes are collected in real time, constructing a multidimensional quantization parameter matrix comprising an obstacle coverage matrix, an energy consumption distribution matrix and a signal attenuation coefficient matrix, and generating a node weight value by adopting a self-adaptive weight calculation mechanism to integrate and calculate path loss, communication delay and node energy consumption so as to dynamically adjust the priority of a communication link. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system remarkably improve the self-healing capacity and instantaneity of the network in the complex environment, reduce the overall computing overhead, improve the instantaneity and expansibility of the system, realize the dynamic optimization of node layout and communication paths, and balance the load and stability of the network.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD;SIMUTECH INC

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle Ad hoc network cluster control system based on intelligent street lamp and satellite communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network cluster control scheme design based on intelligent street lamp and satellite communication, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network cluster control system based on intelligent street lamp and satellite communication. The intelligent street lamp comprises an intelligent street lamp subsystem, a satellite communication subsystem, an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster node and a dynamic cooperative control platform. The method comprises the steps of (1) enabling a multimode communication gateway to realize seamless conversion between a satellite protocol and a ground Internet of things protocol, (2) enabling a street lamp sensor to generate a dynamic risk map to guide a cluster to avoid an obstacle, (3) enabling a rapid clustering algorithm based on geometric topology to support signal interruption emergency networking, (4) enabling task priority to drive time slot allocation to improve communication efficiency, and (5) enabling a satellite-street lamp-relay unmanned aerial vehicle multistage redundancy guarantee system to be continuously controllable. The scheme remarkably enhances the communication reliability, environmental adaptability and coordination capability of the cluster in a complex urban area.
assignees: QINGDAO SEIVING NEW ENERGY RESOURCES CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic topology ad hoc network multipath forwarding method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and particularly discloses a dynamic topology ad hoc network multipath forwarding method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining node state and link connection information, generating a connection diagram and a state perception diagram, extracting link elements based on a diagram structure, constructing a link cost function model, generating a scoring diagram, screening candidate paths through the scoring diagram, calculating a path set structure, setting multipath forwarding priority according to the path set and the service type, completing channel scheduling and resource allocation, executing multipath concurrent data forwarding, detecting conflicts, updating forwarding records, and finally adjusting link cost function parameters based on conflict information to achieve model self-adaptive updating. The invention obviously improves the routing scheduling precision and the multipath forwarding efficiency of the ad hoc network in a dynamic environment by introducing the path priority scoring model and the optimal scheduling mechanism, and has stronger topological adaptability and resource allocation optimizing capability.
