title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle anti-collision method and system based on LoRa communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle anti-collision method and system based on LoRa communication, and belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle risk avoidance; the method comprises the steps of constructing an ad hoc network communication architecture, realizing flight state broadcasting and synchronization, adopting a space-time alignment algorithm to fuse multi-source data, constructing a dynamic airspace situation map taking a local machine as a center, calculating the time window and space overlapping probability of an expected intersection point, calculating a multi-priority dynamic negotiation protocol, supporting autonomous decision of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in a scene without a center node, and dynamically adjusting a flight path, speed and height through a collaborative obstacle avoidance algorithm. The invention realizes over-the-horizon communication coverage of more than 10km level through a spread spectrum modulation technology and a self-adaptive power control mechanism, realizes millisecond recognition and grading response of collision threat through fusing a kinematic prediction model and a risk quantization algorithm, achieves a global optimal avoidance strategy, effectively avoids communication delay and calculation bottleneck caused by centralized decision, and ensures real-time collaborative obstacle avoidance capability under a complex airspace.

title_en: Ground satellite signal distributed cooperative processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed cooperative processing method and a system for ground satellite signals, which relate to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a user MAC address hash value, an emergency priority code and a frequency spectrum occupation matrix from a synchronous network to generate a triplet feature vector; the three-tuple feature vector is transmitted through a double-layer Mesh network, two reference target points with fixed geographic coordinates on the ground of a disaster area are selected, three-dimensional coordinates of the two reference target points are obtained, a space reference straight line is constructed, the vertical projection distance from each node to the space reference straight line is calculated according to real-time position data of each node, a node offset parameter is generated, a refraction correction coefficient of a signal propagation path is dynamically generated based on a comparison result of the node offset parameter and a preset threshold value, and when the offset exceeds the threshold value, a piecewise linear interpolation method is adopted to increase correction weight. The invention can realize high-reliability low-delay emergency communication coverage.
assignees: BEIJING SIGONG HUIZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cluster wireless ad hoc network method for intelligent port operation equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a cluster wireless ad hoc network method of port intelligent operation equipment, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the steps of initializing a port communication system layering architecture, achieving port intelligent operation equipment neighbor discovery, recording neighbor equipment access information packets and channel quality index information, performing cluster head node election through a maximum score priority rule to form a local cluster structure composed of cluster head nodes and terminal equipment, introducing a cluster wireless ad hoc network completion judging mechanism after the intelligent operation equipment cluster head nodes are elected, and finally performing multipath construction, standby path caching and main and standby path seamless switching mechanisms. The invention supports dynamic election of cluster head nodes, supports multipath cache, can realize seamless communication switching, and solves the problems of slow remote control response speed and high failure rate of intelligent operation equipment of ports.

title_en: A Smart Distributed Emergency Alert Broadcasting System
title_ko: 스마트 분산형 비상 안내방송 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 등 비상 상황에서 메인 방송설비에 장애가 발생하거나 중앙 시스템과의 통신이 단절된 경우에도, 각 층에 설치된 비상 인터페이스 장치가 독립적으로 대피 안내 방송을 수행할 수 있도록 구성된 스마트 분산형 비상 안내방송 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이 시스템은 중앙의 메인 방송설비와 함께, 각 층별로 비상 인터페이스 장치를 구비하여 이원화된 방송 송출 구조를 형성하며, 메인 방송설비의 신호 수신 여부를 자가진단하고, 자체 저장된 음원을 기반으로 방송을 수행할 수 있도록 한다. 각 비상 인터페이스 장치는 방송 신호 감지부, 화재 감지 포트, 음원 저장부, 음량 조절기, 오디오 DSP, 무정전 전원장치, MCU 등으로 구성되어 있으며, 정전 및 통신 두절 상황에서도 안정적으로 작동한다. 
또한 본 발명은 중앙 관제 서버가 화재 수신기, 소화전 발신기, 카메라, 잔류인원 감지수단 등으로부터 수집한 데이터를 기반으로 층별 위험도를 실시간 예측하고, 건축 구조 정보와 연계된 대피 경로를 분석하여 맞춤형 피난 안내 정보를 생성한다. 이 정보는 TTS 또는 MP3 음원, 디스플레이 시각정보 등으로 변환되어 메인 방송설비를 통해 송출되거나 각 비상 인터페이스 장치에 사전 저장된다. 
특히, 각 층의 비상 인터페이스 장치는 간이 판단 로직 또는 경량화된 AI 알고리즘을 내장하여, 감지기 데이터를 분석하고 인체 잔류 여부를 자율적으로 판단함으로써, 방송 내용과 방식 자체를 실시간으로 조정하는 고도화된 반응형 방송을 구현할 수 있다. 
결과적으로 본 발명은 중앙 제어와 층별 자율 대응을 병행하는 이중 안전 구조를 통해, 재난 상황에서도 중단 없는 방송과 정밀한 대피 유도를 실현함으로써, 인명 피해를 최소화하고 재난 대응의 실효성을 극대화할 수 있는 스마트 비상 방송 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: KIM HWAN BAE;MICRONIC SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: In-field transfer robot communication method and device based on mesh communication
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for communication of in-field transfer robots based on mesh communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a mesh network, controlling each transfer robot to broadcast respectively, determining distances among nodes in the mesh network, constructing a dynamic neighbor list, decomposing a transfer task into a plurality of task instructions, issuing the task instructions to the corresponding transfer robots through the mesh network, determining transmission priority according to data types of data to be transmitted in the transfer process, calling a corresponding multi-hop routing algorithm, selecting an optimal data transmission path according to position information, electric quantity information, load states and the dynamic neighbor list of each transfer robot, and transmitting the data to be transmitted among the transfer robots through the optimal data transmission path. The application can effectively improve the communication stability and fault tolerance of the in-situ transfer robot and ensure the operation efficiency and reliability of the robot cluster.
assignees: ZHONGYI SHENZHEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shipborne digital wireless ad hoc network method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless networking, in particular to a shipborne digital wireless ad hoc network method and a system, which comprise the following steps: and acquiring ship communication equipment information, constructing a hierarchical mark matrix, generating a node role identification set, monitoring response time delay, judging a connection relationship, establishing a communication topology, optimizing spectrum allocation according to an interference ratio and an overlapping coefficient, completing channel matching and path completion, executing AES (advanced encryption standard) encryption packaging data frames, decrypting according to a key index by a receiving end, and verifying a time delay record effective data frame. The invention improves the accuracy of connection priority and hierarchical mapping among nodes by combining the node equipment information and the hierarchical mark established by the communication role, improves the stability of a communication path and the utilization rate of the channel by double detection of the interference ratio and the frequency spectrum overlapping coefficient of the channel, ensures the integrity of a network by complementing the breakpoint of the path in the node link matching process, and improves the security level of data encryption transmission by combining the key index and the channel number embedded into a security header field.
assignees: FUJIAN FEITONG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power air-ground ad hoc network dynamic anti-destruction routing method and system based on ant colony optimization
abstract_en: The application discloses an ant colony optimization-based dynamic anti-destruction routing method and system for an electric air-ground ad hoc network, which are characterized by comprising initializing an OLSR parameter and an ant colony algorithm parameter, determining a transmission period dynamic interval updating strategy of HELLO information and TC information, dividing an electric communication service into conventional data, telemetry data and relay protection service, dynamically adjusting service priority weights and real-time factors according to network loads, normalizing the service priority weights to obtain service comprehensive weights, calculating path selection probability by combining pheromone concentration, heuristic information and heuristic factors, outputting a path selection result, carrying out local pheromone updating by ants in the path selection process, carrying out global pheromone updating by the ants after all ants are completed, leading an algorithm to converge to a global optimal solution, obtaining optimal communication paths among nodes, and generating a dynamic anti-destruction routing table. The application can improve the reliability and the resource utilization efficiency of the dynamic anti-destruction routing protocol in the power air-ground ad hoc network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Efficient wireless forwarding method and system for unmanned ship cluster rapid ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned ship communication, in particular to a high-efficiency wireless forwarding method and a system for an unmanned ship cluster fast ad hoc network, which are used for monitoring the wireless channel state in real time and dynamically selecting an optimal channel through a self-adaptive channel selection technology; the method comprises the steps of adopting a topology maintenance mechanism based on a distributed algorithm and combining a rapid networking protocol with regular and event triggering to realize rapid networking and topology updating of an unmanned ship cluster, adopting a multipath parallel transmission technology to divide data into a plurality of sub-data streams for parallel transmission and combining and restoring at a receiving end, designing a node scheduling algorithm based on task priority and resource allocation for a large-scale unmanned ship cluster, establishing a node state monitoring mechanism, and adopting a power control algorithm, an optimized protocol frame structure and a dormancy mechanism to reduce communication energy consumption. The invention improves the communication stability, increases the communication bandwidth, enhances the large-scale node management capability, avoids communication conflict and congestion, reduces the energy consumption and prolongs the unmanned ship duration.

title_en: Multi-network integrated emergency communication rapid ad hoc network method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid self-networking method and system for emergency communication integrating multiple networks, and relates to the technical field of tobacco processing equipment, wherein the method encodes multiple source states and information into a token sequence through a windowed token step, and obtains context representation through calculation of a weighting coefficient matrix based on content and structure through a self-adaptive context aggregation step; the aggregation weight is injected with the difference correlation indication quantity based on the reversible bloom lookup table sketch priority analysis set difference through the difference guiding aggregation and synchronous coupling step, cross-layer control vectors including cross-link scheduling scores, coding redundancy, layering confirmation threshold values, forward error correction sheet distribution plans and the like are decoded through the cross-layer parameter synchronous decoding and issuing step, accurate difference restoration, stable performance guarantee and efficient multi-network coordination can be achieved, and convergence speed and reliability of the emergency communication ad hoc network are remarkably improved.
assignees: YUNNAN YANBEN INFORMATION SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ad hoc network method, device and equipment for electrical equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electrical equipment, and discloses an ad hoc network method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium of the electrical equipment, wherein the ad hoc network method of the electrical equipment acquires identification information and running state parameters of target electrical equipment and generates random parameters based on the identification information; the method comprises the steps of calculating the priority of target electrical equipment according to running state parameters, generating competition information by combining random parameters, scheduling communication resources according to the competition information and network scale information, sending competition messages in scheduled sending time slots, determining master-slave roles of the target electrical equipment based on interaction results of the competition messages, and completing self-networking operation through allocation and confirmation of communication addresses. The method of the application can avoid conflict caused by the fact that the devices simultaneously send the competition message at the same time, ensure the ordering and the robustness of the network establishment process, and realize the high efficiency of address allocation and the stability of the networking process on the premise of no additional hardware cost.

title_en: Q learning-based multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative relay selection and path optimization system and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative relay selection and path optimization system and an implementation method based on Q learning, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication; the method comprises the steps of storing, carrying and forwarding data packets by using an unmanned aerial vehicle as a relay node according to dynamic network environments such as an unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network, respectively managing path planning and relay selection by introducing a plurality of Q tables, designing a reward function by combining dynamic indexes such as channel state, transmission consumption, data packet emergency degree and the like, iteratively optimizing and deciding by a Q learning algorithm, adopting multi-resolution path planning under a polar coordinate system, improving the movement efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle, supporting a data packet parallel-serial mixed transmission mode, and dynamically adjusting transmission priority according to the emergency degree. The invention obviously improves the reliability and efficiency of network communication in a complex environment, reduces the moving distance of an unmanned plane path, reduces the urgency of a multi-data packet sending conflict condition, and reduces the packet loss rate in a low signal-to-noise ratio environment.

title_en: Vehicle ad hoc network post-disaster emergency data transmission method based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance
abstract_en: The application relates to a vehicle ad hoc network post-disaster emergency data transmission method based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance, which comprises the steps of obtaining running information of nodes in an unmanned aerial vehicle-vehicle ad hoc network and state information of emergency data to be transmitted, calculating a reference track path according to preset network topology information and a data transmission destination, screening neighbor nodes meeting preset conditions based on the moving track path of the neighbor nodes of the nodes, constructing a candidate relay node set of a ground vehicle and an air unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network, calculating evaluation parameters of the candidate relay node set, evaluating data transmission capacity, determining a target relay node based on data priority and the data transmission capacity, and transmitting post-disaster emergency data. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the network connection is assumed to be continuous or semi-continuous, the high intermittence of the network after the disaster and the rapid change of the topological structure are difficult to deal with, relay selection depends on geographic information and moving direction, the transmission capability of the node is lack of multidimensional parameter evaluation and the like are solved.

title_en: Time division multiplexing communication method and device of wireless Mesh network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time division multiplexing communication method and device of a wireless Mesh network, and relates to the field of network communication. The method comprises the steps of synchronizing clocks of all nodes of the whole Mesh network, dividing time slots based on a preset period to obtain a plurality of fixed time slots, generating random numbers according to unique IDs and synchronous time stamps of all the nodes, judging signal receiving and transmitting states of all the nodes in each fixed time slot based on a preset state judging algorithm according to the random numbers, setting Y fixed time slots as common competition time slots in each continuous X fixed time slots, wherein the common competition time slots are common competition channels of all the nodes to complete data receiving and transmitting, and determining transmission priority in the common competition time slots according to delay time of data packets in a transmission queue of all the nodes, wherein X is larger than Y. The invention solves the technical problems of communication blocking caused by large communication delay, frequent retransmission and multiple conflicts due to suddenly increased number of nodes or suddenly increased forwarding data volume in the Mesh network in the prior art.

title_en: Emergency communication method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network, which belong to the technical field of emergency communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of decomposing an emergency communication task into sub-tasks when an instruction for starting the emergency communication is received; the method comprises the steps of activating subtasks, performing bidding by each body of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster based on the self state to autonomously and cooperatively execute the subtasks, dynamically setting bidding qualification and adaptively adjusting the weight of the unmanned aerial vehicle for executing the subtask to complete efficiency according to the priority of each subtask and the resource state of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in the bidding process, so that each unmanned aerial vehicle body obtains the self bidding price, continuously receiving and executing the activated subtasks, continuously monitoring in the task executing process, and autonomously deciding to return to a base or participate in subsequent bidding after the unmanned aerial vehicle body completes the tasks. The invention can guide the optimal allocation of tasks, has high autonomy, reduces the dependence on people, and is particularly suitable for emergency communication with poor communication conditions.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Emergency repair audio communication system based on TurMass and public network integration
abstract_en: The emergency repair audio communication system based on TurMass and public network integration can automatically construct a private network through the external TurMass wireless communication module when the public network is interrupted, ensure that communication is not interrupted in an extreme environment, support full duplex and low-delay voice communication by utilizing TurMass technical advantages, and overcome the defect of the traditional LPWAN. And through the unique ID, point-to-point accurate calling in the ad hoc network is realized, broadcasting confusion and interference of irrelevant communication are avoided, and the cooperation efficiency is effectively improved. When the calling party equipment judges that the public network is interrupted, the first TurMass wireless communication module is automatically started to carry out private network communication, so that the perceivless smooth transition of 'public network priority and private network backup' is realized. The external modularized design is adopted, the external modularized design is quickly connected with the existing calling party equipment through a universal interface, the upgrading cost is obviously reduced, and the external modularized design is lighter.

title_en: Multilink cooperative real-time data transmission method based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-link collaborative real-time data transmission method based on an ad hoc network. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing data to be transmitted and packaging a custom protocol by constructing a multilink, processing data conflict by an escape mechanism, realizing priority scheduling based on data types, dynamically adjusting transmission rate by combining link states, and guaranteeing data integrity by buffer memory and CRC check. The application is suitable for a network-free infrastructure scene, solves the problems of packet loss and unstable speed of multi-link transmission, realizes real-time transmission of high-priority instructions, is suitable for a scene of interaction between multi-person voice calls and equipment such as emergency rescue, field operation and the like, and has the advantages of high stability, wide compatibility and high-efficiency scheduling.
assignees: HUNAN ZHILING COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Event information transmission-oriented vehicle ad hoc network local exploration routing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of self-organizing networks of Internet of vehicles, and in particular relates to a local exploration routing method of a vehicle self-organizing network facing event information transmission, which comprises the steps of firstly, periodically exchanging state information by vehicles and monitoring events, carrying out priority identification on the event information based on security level, positioning the nearest vehicle as an information source vehicle and creating an initial routing table; and then, combining Manhattan distance, link service life, transmission period and distance limit calculation heuristic cost and actual movement cost among vehicles to construct a route cost function, dynamically selecting a relay node through a local exploration strategy, updating an initial route table into a relay route table, and finally updating the heuristic cost by taking a time slot as a unit to realize predictive maintenance optimization of an optimal route table. Simulation shows that the routing overhead of the method is reduced by 30.77% compared with that of the traditional Mozo method under the high-density scene, and the running time of the long-distance transmission route is reduced by 24.55%.

title_en: Wireless communication apparatus and method for mission critical transmission and delay-tolerant transmission
abstract_en: This management apparatus comprises: an acquisition unit that acquires an execution request for requesting execution of one of a plurality of QoS controls; and a quality control unit that, when resources for executing a QoS control of a start candidate indicated by the execution request are not insufficient, executes the QoS control of the start candidate, and that, when some or all resources are insufficient due to ongoing execution of one or more QoS controls other than the QoS control of the start candidate among the plurality of QoS controls, determines whether to execute the QoS control of the start candidate, on the basis of the execution priority order of the QoS control of the start candidate and the execution priority order of the currently executed QoS controls.

title_en: Ad hoc network dynamic authorization method and system based on improved FP-Growth optimized RBAC
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ad hoc network dynamic authorization method and system based on improved FP-Growth optimized RBAC, the method comprises the steps of determining key attributes of ad hoc network equipment, constructing an access control RBAC model based on roles according to different roles of the ad hoc network equipment in a border environment, defining roles and corresponding authorities thereof, collecting key attributes of the equipment and data of the corresponding roles, adopting a FP-Growth algorithm with the minimum support degree to mine strong association rules between the key attributes of the equipment and the roles, screening the strong association rules for role dynamic allocation, solving role allocation conflicts based on priority matching rules, constructing authority levels according to equipment trust evaluation values, refining authorities corresponding to the roles, and realizing fine-grained authorization of the ad hoc network equipment.

title_en: Power grid monitoring-oriented power self-adaptive congestion control method
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power distribution network monitoring, and provides a power self-adaptive congestion control method for power grid monitoring, which comprises the steps of obtaining network performance indexes and power grid operation parameters of a power grid monitoring data transmission network, and determining the congestion state of a current network through a preset congestion evaluation model; the method comprises the steps of taking a 5G ad hoc network node connection strength coefficient, a new energy monitoring data priority label, a Western electric east-send channel tide fluctuation coefficient and an area vulnerability index as decision variables, taking minimized weighted transmission delay, packet loss rate and maximized new energy consumption responsiveness as objective functions, generating a control strategy corresponding to the current network congestion state according to a hybrid intelligent optimization model integrating reinforcement learning and genetic algorithm, executing the control strategy to dynamically adjust network resources, monitoring the executing effect of the control strategy, and feeding back the result to the model to update parameters, so that the requirements of multi-objective optimization and different service quality under a complex power grid monitoring scene are met.

title_en: Emergency rescue vehicle ad hoc network communication and co-location method for network disconnection environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue vehicle ad hoc network communication and co-location method for a network disconnection environment, which relates to the technical field of communication location, and comprises the steps of searching and verifying that a communication location node forms an ad hoc network by using a rescue vehicle, and transmitting multi-source data; and correcting the fusion positioning result, optimizing transmission priority and forwarding frequency according to task types and node distribution, and synchronizing positioning information. According to the invention, key elements are accurately identified through multi-source data, a space-time registration strategy is adaptively adjusted, fusion weights are dynamically allocated, positioning information transmission parameters are optimized by combining terrain correction positioning results, data deviation is eliminated, algorithm limitations are made up, high-precision positioning results are ensured to be efficiently and stably transmitted, high-precision positioning is finally realized in a network breaking scene, and positioning requirements of emergency rescue are met.
assignees: GUANGZHOU WEIBANG SPECIAL VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic management method for fire-fighting robot network interface based on dual-mode configuration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting robots, and particularly relates to a dynamic management method of a fire-fighting robot network interface based on dual-mode configuration, which comprises the steps of full-level monitoring of network states, namely, analyzing through a communication module hardware interface, a network protocol stack statistical function and a video stream; the intelligent link switching decision comprises a strategy of combining threshold triggering switching and load balancing switching, switching execution and fault tolerance processing, namely seamless link switching realized by a pre-connection mechanism and data cache concurrent, communication resource dynamic scheduling, namely bandwidth resource allocation according to data service priority, and network interface security assurance, namely data encryption, role-based access control and security audit monitoring. The invention can automatically select the optimal communication link under the complex environment, avoid communication failure caused by single network interruption, obviously improve the communication reliability of the fire-fighting robot, adapt to the communication requirements of different rescue scenes and can be according to the priority of different services and the real-time network state.
assignees: NANJING FIRE PROTECTION ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle formation communication and emergency management system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle formation communication and emergency management system and method, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent transportation and Internet of vehicles. The application aims to solve the problems that the prior art cannot achieve both high-bandwidth data transmission and low-delay instruction response and is lack of an autonomous emergency safety mechanism when communication is interrupted. The system and the method comprise the steps that a master vehicle-mounted unit and a slave vehicle-mounted unit jointly construct a vehicle-mounted self-organizing Wi-Fi Mesh network, a first data stream for remote monitoring and a second data stream for vehicle control are transmitted concurrently based on a preset priority, the priority of the second data stream is higher than that of the first data stream, the slave vehicle-mounted unit monitors the state of a communication link between the master vehicle-mounted unit and the slave vehicle-mounted unit, and when the state of the communication link is lower than a preset threshold value, preset safety operation including safety braking is triggered autonomously. The application can give consideration to high bandwidth and low delay, and provide autonomous fault protection, thereby greatly improving the real-time performance and safety of remote connection pipe.
assignees: SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT UNITED NETWORK AUTOMOBILE TECH CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Sidelink transmission of wireless messages using store-and-forward operations
abstract_en: Techniques are described for forwarding emergency alert messages between user equipments (UEs) using store-and-forward operations. In some aspects, at a first time, a UE may receive and store an emergency alert message that indicates an alerting event. The UE may transmit, to a second UE via a sidelink interface and at a second time that occurs after the first time, an indication of the emergency alert message and a store-and-forward operation. The UE may transmit, via the sidelink interface and at a third time that occurs at or after the second time, the emergency alert message to the second UE. The transmission may occur via unicast or broadcast and may be conditional, such as based on the UE being out of network coverage or being within a certain geographic area. The second UE may similarly transmit the emergency alert message to additional UEs. Numerous other aspects are described.

title_en: Road traffic vehicle dynamic command system based on multi-agent cooperative control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road traffic vehicle dynamic command system based on multi-agent cooperative control, which relates to the field of intelligent traffic systems and comprises a vehicle dynamic ad hoc network layer, a road side region cooperative layer and a cloud global planning layer, wherein the vehicle dynamic ad hoc network layer is used for carrying out inter-vehicle state sharing, formation control and emergency obstacle avoidance, uploading collected vehicle state data to the road side region cooperative layer, the road side region cooperative layer is used for carrying out aggregation processing on the vehicle state data to generate signal lamp dynamic adjustment and vehicle behavior instructions, uploading regional traffic state data to the cloud global planning layer, and the cloud global planning layer is used for carrying out macroscopic traffic flow optimization, cross-region coordination and global priority arbitration, generating cross-region optimization instructions and sending the cross-region optimization instructions to the road side region cooperative layer and the vehicle dynamic ad hoc network layer. The system improves road traffic efficiency, safety and hybrid traffic flow coordination capacity through multi-agent three-level coordination control and dynamic priority arbitration.

title_en: Networking method for side service of multi-path connection system of ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking method for multi-path connection system side service of an ad hoc network, which comprises the steps that an access device is connected with an external network, a network link between the access device and the system is established through a tunnel mode, a route information packet is generated in a link state and broadcasted, a priority value of a route is calculated and recorded in a route table after a business device receives the route information packet, meanwhile, the route with the largest priority value is selected as the external link of a local network route, a confirmation message is sent to the access device of the route, the access device receives route update information of the business device, meanwhile, the system side route device is informed of the system side route device through the external link, the route update instruction is received by the system side route device, the route information of a target business device address is updated, the connection reliability is checked periodically and the optimal route is switched automatically after the connection is successful, the invention rapidly converges to confirm the optimal route and establishes the periodic check based on a priority value algorithm, and networking efficiency and stability are remarkably improved.
assignees: NANJING PANDA COMM TECH CO LTD;NANJING PANDA ELECTRONICS CO

title_en: Wireless networking communication method and system for battery monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless networking communication method and system for battery monitoring, and belongs to the technical field of battery monitoring and wireless communication. The method comprises the steps of initializing a battery monitoring wireless communication node, selecting a wireless signal access point mode, combining a wireless group network state configuration network identifier and encryption parameters, distributing dynamic connection signals, selecting a node with highest signal strength as a father node, establishing a wireless mesh network, updating local network topology information after connection is successful, monitoring signal difference before and after connection according to a communication feedback loop, maintaining a connection state when the signal difference is within a safe range, terminating weak signal connection through a signal priority selection method when the signal difference exceeds safe communication strength, combining an onion routing mechanism to package a monitoring data packet, unpacking and forwarding data layer by layer on each intermediate node, and transmitting battery monitoring data of child nodes to a battery monitoring management cloud.
assignees: Shanghai shineng electrical equipment co ltd

title_en: System and method for integrated wired-wireless time-sensitive networking
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes a Time Sensitive Networking (TSN) network integrating wired and wireless TSN agents to ensure deterministic communication for mission-critical Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The TSN network includes the TSN agents, each configured to manage packet transmission and adjust priority classes based on flow schedules and Quality of Service (QoS) feedback report. TSN agents dynamically adapt to network conditions using feedback mechanisms, such as Buffer Status Report Polling, and Bandwidth Query Reporting. The TSN controller employs a reinforcement learning model, which is continually retrained/fine-tuned using the QoS feedback report, to generate optimized flow schedules, enhancing latency, reliability, and efficient use of resources.

title_en: Decoy package alarm for theft deterrence
abstract_en: A decoy package that outwardly resembles a delivered parcel includes one or more internal motion sensors, a controller, and an audible alarm. When armed, the controller classifies sensed motion using multi-sensor fusion to distinguish incidental disturbances from removal attempts and, in response, actuates the audible alarm to emit a high-volume alert (90-105 dBA) after a short delay (0.5-3 seconds) to obscure the source. Embodiments include adaptive thresholds via machine learning, strobes, voice warnings, anti-tamper detection, GPS geofenced safe zones, remote arming via app, customizable exteriors, weight simulation, and mesh networking of multiple decoys for coordinated alarms. Methods for deterring theft using such devices, including community deployment and home security integration, are disclosed. This invention applies a honeypot tactic from cybersecurity to physical package theft, leveraging psychology for cost-effective deterrence.

title_en: Digital license plate and system with expedited acquisition and display of alert notifications
abstract_en: A digital license plate includes a display, a cellular modem, a chipset coupled to the cellular modem, and a processor coupled to the cellular modem and the display. The display displays notices based on notification commands. The cellular modem communicates with a server through a communications network to receive notification commands from the server. The chipset communicates with a user device through a mesh network, and in response to receipt of an alert notice from the user device through the mesh network, causes the cellular modem to establish a communication session with the server through the communications network during which the cellular modem receives an alert notification command associated with the alert notice. Establishment of the communication session occurs within an expediated communication time window. The processor processes the alert notification command received through the cellular modem, and causes the display to display a notice.

title_en: System and Method for Detecting Threats
abstract_en: Disclosed implementations provide a system of sensing modules that can operate in conjunction with a Software as a Service (SaaS) backend to detect and alert of various threats. The sensing modules can be installed at fixed locations or can be mobile. All sensing and detection processing can be accomplished by the sensing module or by several sensing modules cooperating on a mesh network or other network communication architecture. Privacy is preserved because all raw sensor data collected for analysis is processed locally at the sensing module(s) and deleted immediately following the completion of analysis. Accordingly, raw sensor data is inaccessible outside of the sensing module(s) which can be secured through hardware and software security techniques. An app can include an alert button and the ability to live stream video images. The sensors can include AI agents and the system can include a drone dispatch module.
